Why This Is a Great Opportunity

  • 100% remote opportunity! Work from anywhere in the United States while building your career in a sophisticated legal practice.

Location

100% Remote | Nationwide, United States

Work from anywhere in the U.S.! We welcome qualified attorneys licensed in any U.S. state. No relocation or Georgia Bar admission is required.

Note

Candidates must have an active law license in any U.S. state and 2+ years of experience in bankruptcy, restructuring, creditors' rights, workouts, distressed transactions, or related commercial litigation. This is a fully remote opportunity open to attorneys nationwide.

About Us

Confidential Employer

We are an established, highly respected business law firm providing sophisticated legal services to businesses, lenders, and other clients. Our team combines the depth of a sophisticated legal practice with a collaborative, supportive environment where attorneys can take ownership of meaningful matters and advance their careers.

Job Description

We are seeking a motivated Bankruptcy & Restructuring Associate Attorney to join our team. In this role, you will:

  • Represent clients in bankruptcy, restructuring, creditors' rights, and distressed business matters.
  • Handle bankruptcy proceedings, creditor disputes, workouts, and related commercial litigation.
  • Draft motions, briefs, pleadings, and other legal documents.
  • Conduct legal research and develop strategies for complex financial and commercial disputes.
  • Assist with negotiations, settlements, and restructuring solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced attorneys while managing substantive legal responsibilities.

  • Active license to practice law in at least one U.S. state.
  • 2+ years of bankruptcy, restructuring, creditors' rights, workouts, distressed transactions, or related commercial litigation experience.
  • Strong legal research, writing, and analytical skills.
  • Experience drafting litigation documents, motions, or pleadings.
  • Familiarity with bankruptcy proceedings and complex financial disputes is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote team environment.

Why You Will Love Working Here

We believe talented attorneys deserve challenging work, supportive colleagues, and the flexibility to thrive professionally.

You'll enjoy the opportunity to work on sophisticated matters, collaborate with experienced attorneys, and continue developing your expertise without sacrificing the flexibility of remote work.

We offer a $200,000 to $300,000 base salary, depending on experience and seniority, with opportunities for meaningful professional development and long-term career growth.

Ready to advance your legal career from wherever you call home? Apply today!

raw.description:
Who we are:

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.


We support 100% remote work for this role!


We’d love to hear from you if:

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a TV, Video, Audio & Display (TVAD) Specialist you will help build, launch, and improve TV, video, audio, and display campaigns (CTV/OTT, online video, digital audio/podcasts, programmatic display) to grow new customers and revenue while keeping efficiency on track. You’ll apply Tinuiti Way best practices, turn performance and media learnings into next actions, and try small, safe innovations before wider rollout. You’ll partner closely with Client Leadership, senior channel colleagues, and additional channel teams (Search, Social, Commerce/Retail Media) in your Pod, communicate clearly, and document what works so the team can reuse it. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.


Key responsibilities


Client‑Centric

  • Share clear, on‑time updates and help prepare weekly/Monthly/QBR inputs; explain what happened and what we’ll do next in simple, business‑friendly language.
  • Make approved changes (for example: promo dates, budgets, pacing, basic frequency caps) and ask your manager or lead when trade‑offs or bigger plan changes are needed.

The Tinuiti Way

  • Apply solid but developing TVAD craft: build hands‑on skill in audience selection, placement/inventory quality, frequency control, creative rotations and formats. Ask for feedback, apply it, and show clear improvement in your day‑to‑day work.
  • Grow awareness of how TVAD connects to Search, Commerce, Social, and Creative.
  • Apply the Tinuiti Way playbooks and best practices: follow the standard SOPs, checklists, and templates for TVAD setup, QA, delivery checks, and weekly readouts to meet our quality bars (frequency, viewability/IVT, brand safety).
  • Escalate deviations promptly, capture outcomes in the standard readout format, and share feedback through existing channels.

Product‑Led

  • Check performance daily/weekly and track what you monitor (reach, frequency, cost‑per‑result, delivery) through reporting platform.

Data & Measurement‑Driven

  • Try small, safe improvements (for example: a modest audience tweak or a creative rotation) and watch results before suggesting a wider rollout. Document what you did and what you learned to support process improvement.
  • Build accurate recurring reports. When asked, run a basic side‑by‑side test with a clear success rule and a simple readout date.
  • Help keep delivery healthy (budgets on track, campaigns delivering as planned) and let your lead or manager know quickly if something looks off.

Owner Mindset

  • Keep a clear to‑do list, meet deadlines, and confirm when work is done.
  • Reduce avoidable rework and non‑converting spend (for example: rotating tired ads, avoiding audience overlap, fixing simple tracking issues). Close the loop by noting the fix and the outcome.

Ways of working and values

  • Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, and embrace new tools and AI.
  • Clients grow, we grow: Focus on outcomes, evidence, and simple explanations.
  • Culture of ownership: Move fast, cut waste, and own results end‑to‑end.

Professional & Technical Qualifications

  • 2–3+ years in TV/video/audio/display execution (or 1–3 in finance/consulting/analytics with strong data skills) with hands‑on builds, launches, pacing, and optimizations.
  • Comfortable with GA4 and platform analytics and can turn data into clear next steps. SQL familiarity is a plus.
  • Basic testing literacy (A/B, simple lift concepts, statistical significance awareness).
  • Strong communication and collaboration; confident contributing to client updates with support.
  • Advanced Excel/Sheets and presentation tools
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

KPIs

  • Growth support: Contribute to qualified reach/new‑household acquisition and revenue/LTV from TVAD.
  • Quality: Reduce unmanaged frequency and overlap.
  • Innovation: Deliver small, safe innovations (audience/data, inventory quality, format/creative, frequency/quality) and record decisions and learnings.
  • Product/AI adoption: Pilot and adopt optimization features and Bliss Point‑guided adjustments with proven incremental impact.
  • Efficiency (guardrail): Maintain or improve CPx/CAC/ROAS while growing profitable volume.

The hiring salary range for this role is $60,000 - $70,000 plus a discretionary performance bonus.

Hiring salaries are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, parity with other team members, and alignment with market data. We will provide more information on our benefits, incentive pay, and equity upon request. Disclosure as required by the Colorado Equal Pay for > Equal Work Act, C.R.S. § 8-5-101 et seq.

FLSA Classification: Exempt

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.


Benefits:


Unlimited PTO: At Tinuiti, we believe you deserve time to rest, recharge, and enjoy life unplugged. When you prioritize time for yourself, you're able to bring your best self to work. That’s why we offer unlimited paid time off, a fully remote environment, and flexibility to take the time you need, when you need it. On top of that, we provide 20 paid holidays, including multiple long weekends, to ensure you have dedicated time to step away and disconnect. We're proud to offer above-industry standard work-life balance, consistently rated as one of the most loved benefits by Tinuitians year after year.

Healthcare: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life & Disability, Flex Spending Accounts

Retirement: Match up to 4% of your contributions at 100%

Perks and Wellness: Fringe, Forma, Unlimited Telemedicine and Teletherapy available at no cost, Thankful giving, Equity

Parental Leave: Birthing parents receive 16 weeks of leave with 100% pay (partners 12 weeks) after the birth or adoption of a child.

Learning and Development: On-demand learning, mentorship program, leadership and management development programs and resources

raw.description:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

Job Description:

Remote Counsellor/Psychotherapist – Young People

Fully remote - UK* only

Permanent

Minimum 2 days a week

Flexibility to work evenings and weekends, with both part-time and full-time opportunities available


We make health happen


At Bupa, we’re here to help people live longer, healthier, happier lives — and to create a better world. That’s why our Young Persons Talking Therapies Team plays such an important part in what we do.


As a Remote Counsellor/Psychotherapist in the young persons department, you’ll support children and adolescents aged 11–17 by offering high‑quality therapeutic care through safe, effective, and compassionate online sessions.

This role matters because the support you provide helps young people build resilience, confidence and improved emotional wellbeing. You’ll be joining a team driven by care, clinical excellence, and the belief that mental health support should be clear, warm, and accessible. Your expertise will help shape the right pathway of care for each young person and their family.


Key Responsibilities


In this role, you will:


  • Deliver remote counselling to young people, offering short, medium, or longer‑term support depending on their needs.
  • Complete assessments and formulations to determine the right evidence‑based interventions and care pathways.
  • Provide therapy via video sessions while working within Bupa’s clinical governance and case‑management processes.
  • Communicate effectively with key stakeholders such as parents, carers, schools, and local authorities when appropriate.
  • Offer risk assessment, safeguarding awareness, and safety planning with support from senior clinical leads where needed.
  • Signpost or refer onward when another service or treatment is more suitable.
  • Provide occasional adult counselling support when business needs require it.
  • Lead wellbeing workshops or psychoeducation sessions online for groups where appropriate.
  • Work autonomously while collaborating with colleagues across our clinical and operational teams.
  • Attend supervision, team meetings and continuous professional development in line with Bupa and your professional body requirements.

What We’re Looking For


Essential:

  • Fully accredited with BACP, NCPS or UKCP.
  • Has at least 450 supervised counselling hours and significant experience working with children or adolescents.
  • Brings at least three years of post‑qualification clinical experience, with two years dedicated to young people’s mental health.
  • Has strong IT skills and confidence using electronic medical record systems.
  • Demonstrates excellent communication, clinical judgement, and the ability to work independently while managing a structured caseload.
  • Can adapt to the needs of young people with warmth, clarity and professional empathy.

Desirable:

  • Additional training or accreditation in specialist psychological treatment areas, leadership experience, or incident‑support training.

Benefits


Our benefits are designed to make health happen for our people. Viva is our global wellbeing programme and includes all aspects of health — mental, physical, financial, social and environmental. We support flexible working and have a range of family‑friendly benefits.


Joining Bupa in this role you will receive the following benefits and more:


  • 25 days holiday (pro rata if part-time), increasing through length of service, with option to buy or sell
  • Bupa health insurance as a benefit in kind
  • Long Service - For every milestone at Bupa we will reward you with ecards, extra holidays and money!
  • Interest- free annual travel Loan to enable the purchase of public transport annual season tickets
  • Wagestream - Have early access up to 40% of your earned wages within minutes
  • Competitive Pension plans and Parental leave options as well as access to unique products such as our Menopause plan
  • My Bupa Extras - discounts at your favourite retailers, plus a huge range of tools, content and information to support you with your wellbeing

Why Bupa?


We’re a health insurer and provider. With no shareholders, our customers are our focus. Our people are all driven by the same purpose – helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives and making a better world. We make health happen by being brave, caring and responsible in everything we do.


We encourage all of our people to “Be you at Bupa”, we champion diversity, and we understand the importance of our people representing the communities and customers we serve. That’s why we especially encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences.


Bupa is a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. This means we aim to offer an interview/assessment to every disabled applicant who meets the minimum criteria for the role. We’ll make sure you are treated fairly and offer reasonable adjustments as part of our recruitment process to anyone that needs them.


* Please note that while this is a remote position, you must be based in and working from within the UK at all times.

Part time

Clinical Services

Locations:

Home Based North c/o Bupa Place, Nationwide

raw.excerpt: SmartBug Media is one of the most respected names in the HubSpot ecosystem — and we've earned it.
raw.description:
SmartBug Media is one of the most respected names in the HubSpot ecosystem — and we've earned it.

We didn't get here by accident. SmartBug has built a reputation that most agencies only aspire to: HubSpot North American Partner of the Year, a fully remote team of specialists who punch well above their weight, and a client base that doesn't just hire us — they stay with us. That last part is the one we're most proud of.

Remote by design and strategic by nature, we've never believed that great work requires a corner office or a campus cafeteria. What it requires is the right people, deeply aligned on outcomes, working with clients who trust them to deliver. That's the culture we've built — one where expertise travels, relationships run deep, and the work speaks for itself.

We're obsessed with client outcomes. Not vanity metrics. Not feel-good reports. Real, measurable growth that makes our clients look like heroes inside their own organizations. When SmartBug is in your corner, your team wins — and that's exactly why our clients keep coming back.

We're growing, our client portfolio is expanding, and the relationships we've built are stronger than ever. What we need next is a leader who understands that the hardest part of this business isn't winning clients — it's becoming so embedded in their success that leaving simply isn't an option. If you've built that kind of loyalty before, if you know what it takes to transform a good client relationship into a decade-long partnership, and if you're energized by the idea of architecting that function at scale — we want to meet you.

About the role

The Solutions Consultant is a technically deep delivery role responsible for scoping integrations between HubSpot and

the third-party systems clients operate, including ERPs, ticketing platforms, e-commerce, field service, and industry-

specific software. This role establishes technical feasibility, integration approach, and effort before an engagement is

sold.

The core competency is integration scoping: assessing an unfamiliar platform, determining whether and how it can be

connected to HubSpot, identifying the failure points, and producing a defensible estimate within the timeframe of an

active sales cycle. Speed to a sound answer matters more than prior experience with any single platform.

The role operates primarily alongside Sales — leading technical discovery, mapping data flows, sizing effort, authoring

the technical content of the Statement of Work, and presenting the estimate to client technical stakeholders. It

partners closely with the Solutions Architecture team: CRM Strategists own multi-hub design, while this role owns the

connection between HubSpot

What you'll do

Integration scoping and solution design

  • Lead technical discovery with client stakeholders to establish what a project actually requires
  • Assess feasibility from an unfamiliar platform's own API documentation — what it exposes, what it doesn't, rate limits, webhooks versus polling, and whether an existing connector is any good
  • Choose the integration approach — native connector, iPaaS, custom build, or a phased combination — and explain the trade-off in cost, maintainability and risk
  • Identify failure modes before they happen: source of truth by record, conflict handling, sync failure detection and reconciliation, and the gap between the data quality a client describes and the data quality they have
  • Build the scoping artifacts: systems diagrams, data maps, integration approach, and a phased plan where the work warrants one
  • Scope AI and agent projects alongside integrations. Assess whether a use case is feasible, whether the client's data can support it, and whether it calls for HubSpot-native agents, LLM APIs, or a custom build

Estimation and scope integrity

  • Size the effort using our estimating model, with assumptions and dependencies documented alongside every number
  • Write or review the technical sections of the Statement of Work before it goes to the client
  • Present and defend the estimate in the room, including with a buyer's CTO or technical lead
  • Flag when a deal should be reshaped, phased, or declined — early, and with the reasoning
  • Identify genuine expansion the client needs, without growing the number to grow the deal

Technical validation and proof

  • Support proof-of-concept builds and integration demos that show viability against the client's own systems
  • Validate API access and behavior in sandbox before build hours are committed
  • Review data relationships, automation triggers and sync rules across systems to confirm data integrity
  • Act as subject matter expert on integration frameworks, HubSpot APIs and middleware architecture

Sales partnership and enablement

  • Serve as the technical point of contact on new and expansion opportunities, from first discovery call through signature
  • Turn a verbal conversation into a written scope inside the agreed turnaround, so opportunities don't stall waiting on us
  • Educate the sales team on technical positioning, so deal confidence and scope accuracy improve between engagements rather than deal by deal
  • Maintain the reference material sales needs: what we integrate with, what we have built before, and what we will not take on

Delivery continuity and practice contribution

  • Hand off with documented requirements, assumptions and open questions — nothing relearned after signature
  • Stay engaged through kickoff as the person who holds the client's original context
  • Apply the design standards the Solutions Architects own, and route anything above the sign-off threshold through architect review before the SOW is issued
  • Pull a Platform Architect into discovery when a deal turns on how the Hubs themselves are designed, rather than on what sits outside them
  • Feed estimate variance and broken assumptions back into the model, and share integration patterns with the wider team

Required Qualifications

Integration scoping — the core of the role

  • Demonstrated ability to assess an unfamiliar platform's API and determine what can and cannot be connected, and at what cost
  • Demonstrated ability to choose between integration approaches and defend the choice on cost, maintainability and risk
  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate failure modes — identity, conflict handling, sync failure, data quality
  • Demonstrated ability to convert all of the above into hours a delivery team can build against
  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google), including prompt engineering and structured outputs

Technical experience

  • 4+ years of professional experience in technology, revenue operations, or professional services
  • 3+ years scoping or delivering system integrations and data migrations in a consulting or agency environment
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs and webhooks, including authentication patterns, pagination and rate limiting
  • Experience with middleware and iPaaS platforms such as Workato, Celigo, Tray, Boomi or Zapier
  • SQL and data warehousing experience — able to reason about data structures outside the CR
  • Strong data modelling skills: object structures, field mapping, transformation logic, and the integrity risks in each
  • Experience planning data migrations, including deduplication, historical data and cutover approach
  • Working knowledge of HubSpot as one side of the integration: objects, associations, properties, and the limits of the platform

Client-facing and commercial

  • Experience leading technical discovery with client stakeholders, including engineers and technical leads
  • Experience producing systems diagrams, data maps and developer-ready technical documentation
  • Experience scoping and estimating work that other people then deliver against
  • Exceptional ability to translate technical constraint into business consequence for a non-technical buyer
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with the systems that come up most in our work: NetSuite, Salesforce and Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics or Great Plains, Zendesk, Keap, Creatio, Procore, Snowflake, and industry-specific or point-of-sale platforms
  • Integration experience in another CRM ecosystem such as Salesforce, Dynamics or NetSuite — the scoping judgement transfers
  • Proficiency in JavaScript or Node.js and Python, sufficient to prototype and to scope custom work accurately
  • Deeper HubSpot breadth across multiple Hubs — useful, though our Platform Architects own multi-hub design
  • Experience in regulated environments — healthcare, financial services, or similar — where compliance shapes the data model
  • Background in software development, with enough depth to scope tasks a developer can pick up without further clarification
  • Experience with GraphQL or SOAP in addition to REST
  • Familiarity with diagramming tools such as Lucidchart, Visio, or Miro
  • Relevant certifications — HubSpot Solutions Partner, Salesforce Architect, or equivalent — or a degree in a technical field

raw.excerpt: 🌎 About UsTeamSnap is made up of innovators, technologists, builders, and problem-solvers shaping the future of youth sports.
raw.description:
🌎 About Us

TeamSnap is made up of innovators, technologists, builders, and problem-solvers shaping the future of youth sports. We’ve been setting the standard in youth sports technology since we were founded in 2009.

We hire for big ideas and tiny egos — which is part of how we landed on Outside Magazine's Best Places to Work, Built In's 100 Best Remote-First Places to Work and, for several years running, Sports Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in Sports.

TeamSnap is hiring a Senior Product Manager, Media & Consumer Monetization to make TeamSnap ONE the place where youth sports families watch the game, and to turn that engagement into a thriving consumer subscription business.

Every weekend, millions of families show up for games, and plenty of grandparents, parents on the road, and fans wish they could be there too. TeamSnap ONE lets families live stream those games. This role owns two outcomes that feed each other. The first is making live streaming and video sharing a weekly habit: more teams going live, more people tuning in, more people coming back. The second is growing TeamSnap+, our premium subscription, by driving acquisition, conversion, and retention through premium media and content features.

You'll partner closely with Design, Engineering, Data, and Marketing. You'll report to the VP of Product.

What You'll Do:

    Media adoption and engagement

    • Grow live streaming and video usage. Increase the number of teams that stream, the viewers per stream, and how often people come back to watch. Find and fix the drop-offs along the way, from discovering streaming to setting up a first stream, from going live to getting viewers watching, and from watching to coming back next week.

    • Turn raw game video into memories families want to keep. A two-hour stream is footage. The shot on goal, the first hit, and the season recap are memories. Build the experiences that turn one into the other: highlights, clips, recaps, and personalized moments that families want to save and share.

    • Build engagement loops around video. Notifications, sharing to family and social channels, and team- and user-level moments that bring people back between games and seasons.

    Subscription growth

    • Drive TeamSnap+ acquisition and conversion. Own the in-app trigger points where users meet a premium media or content feature and are invited to upgrade: where those moments appear, when they fire, and how clearly they show the value of TeamSnap+.

    • Own subscriber retention. Understand why subscribers stay and why they churn. Build the in-app engagement and renewal experiences that keep them, and make sure subscribers keep getting value between seasons.

    • Shape packaging: what's free and what's premium. Partner with Product Marketing to decide which media and content features belong in the free experience to drive adoption and which belong in TeamSnap+ to drive revenue.

      • How you'll work

      • Balance adoption and monetization. These goals reinforce each other, but sometimes they conflict. Gating a feature can lift conversion while slowing adoption. We expect you to model those tradeoffs, bring a clear recommendation, and back it with data and user insights.

      • Use data to set direction. Live in Amplitude, interrogate your own funnels and cohorts, and build the cases that tell us where to invest next.

      • Bring partners along. Work with Product Marketing on the subscription experience, lifecycle, and go-to-market, with Finance on revenue forecasting, with Customer Success on feedback from the field, and with leadership on how the media and premium vision fits into the broader TeamSnap ONE strategy.

What Will Set You Up for Success:

    • 5–8 years in product management, with a track record of moving both engagement and revenue metrics in a consumer product.

    • Subscription or freemium growth experience. You've driven subscription conversion or retention in a consumer product, through upgrade moments, trials, packaging, or churn reduction, and you can show the results. You understand subscription economics: LTV, payback, trial-to-paid, and churn cohorts.

    • Consumer mobile app experience. You've shipped on iOS and Android and understand the realities that come with it: release cycles, store policy, in-app purchase, push notifications, and device fragmentation.

    • Analytics fluency. You don't wait for an analyst to tell you what's happening. You're hands-on in Amplitude and similar tools, comfortable enough with data to answer your own questions, and you can dig into funnels and cohorts, find the insight that matters, and turn it into a product decision the team can rally behind.

    • Strong judgment on user experience. You can drive monetization without degrading the product users rely on, and you can explain where you draw the line between free and paid.

    • Clear communication in a remote-first environment. You write well, make tradeoffs explicit, and keep a cross-functional team aligned on why we're building what we're building.

    • Comfort with ambiguity. You can take a broad goal like "make live streaming a habit," break it into a sequenced plan, and adjust as the data comes in.

Bonus:

    • Experience with live streaming, video, OTT, or creator/UGC products

    • Experience designing and running A/B tests.

    • Experience with app store subscription mechanics

    • Familiarity with youth sports, community platforms, or products used by families.

Compensation:

We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $150,000, inclusive of base and commission, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.

🖥 Location

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you'll need to be comfortable working with people in other time zones.

We're always expanding, but we can't currently hire in Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, or Utah. We can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

🚀 Opportunities to Grow

We work hard on a culture built on trust, accountability, and inclusion — one where you can take on more, make a lasting impact, and have some fun doing it.

🎩 Total Rewards

  • Remote-first since 2009
  • Flexible PTO and parental leave
  • 100% premium coverage of medical, dental, and vision for you and your family
  • 401(k) to invest in your future
  • $1,500 annual learning and development reimbursement
  • Travel to all-company meetings and team events
  • Generous home office allowance
  • TeamSnap swag when you start, plus a $50 store credit on every work anniversary
  • Monthly health and wellness reimbursement, and more
  • TeamSnap Total Rewards
🏆 Award-winning Culture

At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit – you're a culture add. Read our Culture Playbook to see how we play, what we ask of each other, and what drives us.

🧡 Inclusion and Diversity

Creativity and innovation don't come from cookie-cutter teams. We hold ourselves accountable for building a culture where everyone is valued.

Need any accommodations during the interview process? Just ask. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

AI Notice

We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and resumes or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team; they don't replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by people. Contact us if you'd like more information about how your data is processed.

We are a leader in supply chain software solutions, helping organizations streamline operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency.

As a Senior Database Administrator, you will be responsible for planning, operating, and continuously improving our database landscape, with a focus on PostgreSQL and Oracle. You will help ensure high levels of performance, availability, security, and automation across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. Working closely with development, operations, and business teams, you will proactively identify improvements, resolve complex database challenges, and support a stable and reliable service. This role combines hands-on database administration with performance optimization, high-availability solutions, security, monitoring, automation, and clear operational documentation.


What a day in the life looks like:

  • Administer, configure, upgrade, and maintain PostgreSQL and Oracle databases, including backup and recovery processes.
  • Analyze and optimize database performance using execution plans, indexing, bloat and lock management, and wait-event analysis.
  • Build and operate high-availability and replication solutions, including Streaming Replication, Patroni, Data Guard, and HAS.
  • Implement patches and security measures such as TDE, hardening, and auditing, and conduct regular recovery tests.
  • Manage monitoring, capacity, storage, SLA reporting, and database health reporting.
  • Automate operational processes using Shell, Python, and Ansible, and create runbooks, playbooks, and post-mortems.

What you bring to the team:

  • At least five years of experience as a Database Administrator in enterprise environments, with strong PostgreSQL and Oracle expertise.
  • Proven experience with database administration, upgrades, patching, backup and recovery, and performance analysis using tools such as Explain/Analyze and AWR/ASH.
  • Practical knowledge of high-availability and replication technologies, including Data Guard, HAS, Streaming Replication, or Patroni.
  • Experience with CheckMK monitoring, storage and tablespace management, capacity planning, and structured incident handling.
  • Automation skills using Shell and Python, ideally including Ansible, together with foundational knowledge of security and compliance.
  • Fluency in German and strong English skills; experience with Oracle AQ, PL/SQL, and Oracle GoldenGate is an advantage.

At Infios, we're not just looking for employees; we're looking for partners in innovation, growth, and purpose. Since day one, BioVid’s formula for success has been driven by a collaborative, high-performing, and growth-focused culture, where talented individuals are empowered to push their limits and excel. We believe in challenging ourselves and each other to go beyond what’s expected and deliver meaningful impact.

If you're an ambitious, growth-minded Market Access professional who enjoys solving complex client challenges and working across strategy research and consulting, we invite you to explore our Senior Manager, Market Access Consulting role.

This role is ideal for someone with strong Market Access expertise who can manage client engagements, design and execute qualitative and quantitative research, translate complex findings into strategic recommendations, and contribute to proposals and new-business opportunities. You’ll work closely with senior Market Access leaders while taking meaningful ownership of project delivery and client relationships.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Market Access Analysis & Strategy:

  • Collaborate with senior Market Access leaders to design and execute payer research, pricing, reimbursement, and broader Market Access engagements across the product lifecycle, therapeutic areas and markets.
  • Translate client business questions into clear solutions using qualitative, quantitative, and secondary data sources and strategic advisory experience as appropriate.
  • Design and facilitate primary research with national and regional payers, HTA experts, employers, hospitals/health systems/IDNs, KOLs, and other relevant access stakeholders depending on market.
  • Analyze and synthesize primary and secondary research, market dynamics, and access considerations into clear strategic implications and actionable client recommendations.

Project & Client Delivery:

  • Serve as the day-to-day client lead, building trusted relationships, managing expectations, and proactively addressing questions, risks, and changing project needs.
  • Develop high-quality, client-ready deliverables that connect rigorous research and analysis to clear strategic recommendations.

Business & Team Contribution:

WHO YOU ARE

  • 5–8 years of relevant experience in Market Access, pricing and reimbursement, payer strategy, healthcare consulting, pharmaceutical market research, or a related field.
  • Experience managing Market Access or healthcare consulting engagements and client-facing workstreams.
  • Strong understanding of the US healthcare and payer environment, including familiarity with key payer channels and access stakeholders; global pricing, reimbursement, or HTA experience is a plus.
  • Experience with primary market research and confidence working across both qualitative and quantitative approaches.
  • Strong analytical and strategic-thinking skills, with the ability to move from data and research findings to clear business implications and recommendations.
  • Strong project-management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, and stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing and presenting client-ready recommendations.
  • Experience contributing to proposals, scopes of work, or new-business opportunities.
  • Collaborative, intellectually curious, and comfortable working in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  • Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the broader strategic question.

Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and other standard business tools.

raw.description:
ABOUT QUORSO

Quorso is one of retail's most exciting SaaS scale-ups. Our intelligent management platform translates terabytes of data into smart, personalized daily actions across more than 60,000 stores worldwide. Backed by Summit Partners, we're scaling fast and building the data foundations that will shape the future of retail performance.

Join Quorso at a pivotal moment in our growth. We're helping some of the world's most respected retailers rewire how they make operational decisions. Using Quorso's intelligent management platform, you'll help turn terabytes of raw store data into personalized, actionable insights, sent in near real time directly to frontline users.

We're already powering performance for some of the biggest names in retail, including Dollar General, PetSmart, Tractor Supply Company and Circle K, and we're now growing our Implementation team in the US to support new global growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

In your first six months at Quorso, you will help rewire how global retail giants like Dollar General, PetSmart, Tractor Supply, and Circle K make operational decisions. You’ll work with terabytes of real-world store data, help find millions in operational savings, and turn them into personalized, actionable insights across more than 60,000 stores worldwide. You won’t be maintaining dashboards or sending email reports hoping someone will read them. Instead, you’ll work at the heart of near real-time, targeted, data-driven actions, sent directly to frontline users.

The best part of this role, and the hardest, is the application. Retail data reaches us raw and unstructured, and you will build pipelines to clean, join supplementary data and write logic to power the application , creating this in SQL. Once customers are live, you support and enhance the configuration, investigating failure alerts, handling support requests, and partnering with colleagues to develop new data flows. This is data-shaping, exception finding, and data-led operations at scale.

You’ll learn alongside experienced implementation leads. Learn new systems, contribute to and enhance new ways of working, and let your curiosity flourish. Implementation is a team of individuals striving to push the bounds of what is possible.

This is a fully remote role based in the US. We can only consider candidates based in the Eastern or Central time zones, to ensure good working-hours overlap with both our US and UK-based teams, including the Director of Implementation.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Manage retail data from enterprise clients, shaping it in SQL into something usable: cleaning, joins, restructuring and layering on predefined and bespoke logic.

  • Monitor live customers for data failures and use case up-time, investigating issues in SQL and fixing or escalating them.

  • Manage support requests across customers and escalate to the appropriate channels.

  • Work with customer teams and senior Implementation colleagues to understand client operations and build data-led use cases.

  • Configure Quorso’s application to highlight store performance, flag improvement opportunities and measure results.

  • Work with Product, Customer and Implementation team members to create a constant learning and improvement feedback loop that connects to business priorities.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Hands-on SQL used to transform data, with and without AI assistance: joins, CTEs, window functions, and restructuring multi-source data. Be ready to walk us through a specific query you have written and the problem it solved. Shortlisted candidates will also be asked to complete a live SQL test.

  • Experience working with large datasets and reading SQL written by others.

  • The ability to turn a business problem into a well-thought-out, scalable query.

EVEN BETTER IF YOU HAVE

  • Retail, FMCG or other operational data experience.

  • Experience improving processes or influencing decisions through data.

  • Experience working with HTML.

  • Experience in a support or operations environment.

IS THIS YOU?

  • You reach for SQL to solve a data problem before you reach for anything else.

  • You love learning new products and tools, and when one doesn’t exist or doesn’t work the way you need, your instinct is to vibe code something that does.

  • You are relentlessly curious, and you default to solving problems rather than reporting on them.

  • You enjoy tracing a broken number back to its root cause and making sure it stays fixed.

  • You enjoy working with data, working directly with stakeholders, and turning analysis into measurable impact.

  • You stay accurate and organised when juggling several customers and requests at once.

PAY AND BENEFITS

The base salary range for this role is $90k - $110k per year. The final offer will depend on job-related factors such as skills, experience and location.

Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance; 401(k); paid time off and paid holidays; paid parental leave; other benefits.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Quorso is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on the skills, experience and potential people bring to the role. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please let us know.

raw.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a deeply curious team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We're customer-obsessed — we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What's the position?

We are looking for a Senior Data Product Manager to join our Quantitative Sports (QS) team, reporting to the Director of Quantitative Sports. QS builds and owns the in-house pricing models that set the odds on sporting events across our sportsbook. We are bringing pricing that is currently supplied by a third-party provider into our own infrastructure, and you will own the delivery of that transition end to end — turning business and trading needs into clear, engineer-ready Jira tickets and keeping a cross-functional program on schedule.

Once the transition is complete, you'll run the day-to-day product operations of a fully functioning in-house pricing team and help drive the expansion of the sports and markets covered by QS. This is a fully remote, US-based role with significant autonomy. If you're a self-starter who knows the sportsbook space and loves getting complex projects over the line, you'll feel at home here.

What You'll Do

  • Own the onboarding and transfer of a third-party pricing provider into our infrastructure, from discovery and knowledge transfer through to production go-live

  • Translate business and trading needs into well-scoped technical Jira tickets, with clear acceptance criteria, enabling our engineers to work with autonomy

  • Build and maintain project plans, milestones, and dependencies, and deliver against agreed timelines

  • Act as the bridge between quantitative analysts, engineers, traders, and other technical and non-technical stakeholders across departments

  • Manage the QS backlog and workflows in Jira, prioritizing work in line with team and business goals

  • Run the day-to-day product operations of the in-house pricing team once the transition is complete

  • Scope and plan the expansion of the QS domain into new sports, competitions, and markets

  • Use data to track delivery, understand pricing outputs, and inform prioritization decisions

  • Communicate progress, risks, and blockers clearly to the Director of QS and wider leadership

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • 5-8 years of experience in product management, technical project management, or a similar delivery-focused role

  • Experience in the sports betting industry

  • In-depth understanding of sportsbook products and the pricing of sporting events, both at Hard Rock and across other operators in the US market, with hands-on experience working in those areas

  • Proven ability to write technical Jira tickets that translate a business need into work an engineer can pick up and deliver

  • Extensive experience working with Jira and other project management tools across different workflows

  • Proven track record of delivering projects on time

  • Strong data familiarity, with the confidence to work with data to validate requirements, review outputs, and measure outcomes

  • Ability to work across departments with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • College degree in any discipline

Bonus Points

  • Experience managing a migration project

  • Hands-on experience with SQL or Python

  • Experience using Grafana and other observability tooling

  • Familiarity with sports data feeds such as Radar & Genius

Job Description

Position: Contracts Manager

Location: Remote

Overview: Silicon Ranch develops, builds, owns, and operates utility-scale solar energy projects, and the agreements behind those projects are how our work gets done. As Contract Manager, you are the commercial owner of the contracts that bring our projects to life. This includes EPC and construction services agreements, consulting agreements, and professional services agreements. You will lead sourcing and negotiation, manage supplier relationships and performance, and identify and mitigate commercial risk, all in close partnership with our Legal, Engineering, Finance, and Delivery teams.

This is a hands-on commercial role for someone who enjoys both the deal and the disciplined follow-through that makes a contract perform.

Main Responsibilities:

Sourcing & RFP process

  • Lead the RFI/RFP process end to end: build bid/solicitation packages with engineering, finance, project management, and development, and ensure complete, accurate bid documents.
  • Facilitate pre-bid meetings and manage communication with bidders throughout the solicitation.

Bid evaluation & award

  • Coordinate cross-functional bid evaluation and lead bid analysis across price, schedule, scope, and commercial risk.
  • Coordinate and lead internal and external bid review meetings and present award recommendations to leadership.

Negotiation & contracting

  • Serve as the external communicator in negotiations with contractors and suppliers, leading negotiations and making commercial recommendations.
  • Identify and mitigate commercial and contractual risks.
  • Draft, redline, and negotiate commercial terms and conditions partnering with Legal and other departments.
  • Maintain a library of standard templates, fallback positions, and a negotiation playbook in coordination with Legal.
  • Coordinate contract execution: signature routing, execution, and distribution of fully executed agreements.

Supplier & risk management

  • Manage EPC/supplier performance through scorecards and periodic business reviews.
  • Identify and mitigate commercial and contractual risk across the lifecycle

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of contract management, commercial, or procurement experience, including at least 2 years working directly with EPC or construction contracts.

  • Familiarity with EPC/construction services agreement structures.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration with delivery, engineering, finance, development, and legal teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, business, finance, supply chain, engineering, economics, or a related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

You could be a recruiting coordinator anywhere. Why Jerry.ai?

  • Join a pre-IPO startup with capital, traction, and runway: We are tackling a $2T market, have $240M in funding, 60X revenue growth, and we’re profitable.

Why contract-to-perm?

At Jerry.ai, we move quickly and our hiring bar is high. We treat coordination like white-glove operations rather than just admin support. The contract phase (3 months) is a chance for both sides to see if we’re the right match. You’ll get a front-row seat to our "high ownership, high impact" culture. If you thrive on urgency and precision, the path to a permanent role here is clear.

About the opportunity:

You will be the operational backbone of our recruiting engine, owning the logistics and making sure every candidate experiences a seamless, high-touch process end to end.

We’re looking for a high-velocity operator who doesn’t just execute tasks, but anticipates what’s next, removes friction before it appears, and helps the recruiting team move faster, smarter, and more effectively. You’ll act as a true force multiplier for our recruiting engine, your work will directly shape our ability to attract and hire top talent at Jerry.ai.

How you will make an impact:

  • Provide "white-glove" service to candidates by sending personalized pre-interview info and managing LinkedIn outreach

  • Manage the lifecycle of take-home assignments, maintain candidate profiles in Ashby ATS, and ensure all candidate documents are accessible to those who need them

  • Manage recruiter calendars with precision, rearranging interviews on the fly to prioritize high-impact candidates and maximize our daily capacity

  • Act as the point person for leadership’s urgent recruiting needs, whether it's updating compensation bands, posting new job reqs, or coordinating the training/shadowing of new interviewers

Who you are:

  • You can’t stand inefficiency: You’re always spotting ways to automate, streamline, and level-up how work gets done, and you enjoy turning messy processes into clean, scalable systems.

  • You have an intense sense of urgency: You don't wait for things to happen, you make them happen. You move quickly, close loops fast, and thrive in environments where priorities shift and speed matters.

  • Your attention to detail is impeccable: You catch the small things that others miss. Your written communication is clear, polished and professional, and you keep processes tight so nothing slips.

  • You are a proactive problem solver: You’re calm under pressure, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You can handle high-stakes, time-sensitive requests from leadership without losing focus or pace.

Ideal profile:

  • Prior experience in a fast-growth startup or a high-volume agency environment is strongly preferred

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

Job Summary:

The Senior Accountant – Capital Assets owns the end-to-end fixed asset accounting function, including capitalization, depreciation, reporting, and compliance. This role drives financial accuracy, strengthens internal controls, and partners with business leaders to optimize capital allocation decisions.

In addition to core accounting responsibilities, this role leads process improvement and automation initiatives, leveraging data analytics to enhance visibility, reduce manual effort, and support Shared Services transformation objectives.


ssential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Fixed Asset Accounting Ownership

  • Own the full lifecycle of fixed assets across SAP S/4HANA and legacy systems, including capitalization, depreciation, transfers, and retirements.
  • Ensure timely and accurate completion of month-end and year-end close activities.
  • Prepare and review journal entries, reconciliations, and asset rollforwards.
  • Maintain fixed asset subledger integrity and alignment to the general ledger.

2. Capital Spend Governance & Business Partnership

  • Partner with FP&A, Procurement, and business leaders to review and validate capital expenditures.
  • Ensure proper capitalization versus expense treatment in accordance with US GAAP and company policy.
  • Provide insights into capital spend trends, project status, and return expectations.
  • Support the development and tracking of annual capital budgets, including expansion of capital tracking and workflow tools.

3. Compliance, Controls & Reporting

  • Ensure compliance with US GAAP, SOX requirements, and internal capitalization policies.
  • Design, execute, and continuously improve internal controls over fixed assets.
  • Prepare quarterly (10-Q) and annual (10-K) disclosures and supporting documentation.
  • Lead audit support for internal and external auditors.

4. Process Improvement & Automation (Transformation Focus)

  • Identify and implement automation opportunities across fixed asset processes, including reconciliations, reporting, and asset tracking.
  • Develop dashboards and reporting to enhance transparency of capital activity and asset performance.
  • Standardize processes across ERPs and drive adoption of best practices.
  • Partner with IT and Shared Services leadership to deliver efficiency gains tied to transformation objectives.

5. Data Analytics & Reporting

  • Deliver actionable reporting and insights to support decision-making across Finance and Operations.
  • Analyze capital project trends, asset utilization, and depreciation impacts.
  • Build and maintain data models, reports, and dashboards using tools such as Excel and Power BI.

  • Mentor junior team members and support knowledge transfer.

  • Responsible for forecast management and accuracy
  • Manage product detail page content including titles, bullets, descriptions, images, videos, A+ Content and other digital assets.

  • Analyze performance by ASIN, brand, category and time period to identify opportunities and potential risks.

raw.description:
Come Be Part Of A Mission that Matters!


From inside the farm gate to our dinner plates, Neogen protects the world’s food supply. Through a variety of animal healthcare products, to food safety solutions for dangerous bacteria, allergens, toxins, drug residues and much more, Neogen is there — and you can be too.

Job Summary:

The Senior Accountant – Capital Assets owns the end-to-end fixed asset accounting function, including capitalization, depreciation, reporting, and compliance. This role drives financial accuracy, strengthens internal controls, and partners with business leaders to optimize capital allocation decisions.

In addition to core accounting responsibilities, this role leads process improvement and automation initiatives, leveraging data analytics to enhance visibility, reduce manual effort, and support Shared Services transformation objectives.


ssential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Fixed Asset Accounting Ownership

  • Own the full lifecycle of fixed assets across SAP S/4HANA and legacy systems, including capitalization, depreciation, transfers, and retirements.
  • Ensure timely and accurate completion of month-end and year-end close activities.
  • Prepare and review journal entries, reconciliations, and asset rollforwards.
  • Maintain fixed asset subledger integrity and alignment to the general ledger.

2. Capital Spend Governance & Business Partnership

  • Partner with FP&A, Procurement, and business leaders to review and validate capital expenditures.
  • Ensure proper capitalization versus expense treatment in accordance with US GAAP and company policy.
  • Provide insights into capital spend trends, project status, and return expectations.
  • Support the development and tracking of annual capital budgets, including expansion of capital tracking and workflow tools.

3. Compliance, Controls & Reporting

  • Ensure compliance with US GAAP, SOX requirements, and internal capitalization policies.
  • Design, execute, and continuously improve internal controls over fixed assets.
  • Prepare quarterly (10-Q) and annual (10-K) disclosures and supporting documentation.
  • Lead audit support for internal and external auditors.

4. Process Improvement & Automation (Transformation Focus)

  • Identify and implement automation opportunities across fixed asset processes, including reconciliations, reporting, and asset tracking.
  • Develop dashboards and reporting to enhance transparency of capital activity and asset performance.
  • Standardize processes across ERPs and drive adoption of best practices.
  • Partner with IT and Shared Services leadership to deliver efficiency gains tied to transformation objectives.

5. Data Analytics & Reporting

  • Deliver actionable reporting and insights to support decision-making across Finance and Operations.
  • Analyze capital project trends, asset utilization, and depreciation impacts.
  • Build and maintain data models, reports, and dashboards using tools such as Excel and Power BI.

6. Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for fixed asset accounting.
  • Mentor junior team members and support knowledge transfer.
  • Drive a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement within Shared Services.

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • High attention to detail and organizational discipline.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder engagement.
  • Cultural Savvy: Demonstrates and lives One Neogen Pillars of Trust: Openness, Honesty, Credibility, Respect, and Service through all actions, behaviors, and communication.
  • Communication: Communicates effectively through all necessary messaging and actively listens to others.
  • Decision Making and Problem Solving: Identifies information needed and makes timely decisions. Has the knowledge needed to perform responsibilities.
  • Driving Performance: Drives performance by remaining focused, consistently showing up, being timely, meeting productivity standards, thinking outside the box, and asking for help when needed.
  • Organizational Strategy: Understands their role and is actively curious about how it fits within the organization.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance required.
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including fixed assets or general accounting.
  • Experience in a SOX-controlled, publicly traded environment preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP, including fixed assets, capitalization, depreciation, and impairment.
  • SAP S/4HANA experience strongly preferred; multi-ERP experience is a plus.
  • Experience with fixed asset systems, such as Thomson Reuters Fixed Assets CS, preferred.

Data & Tools

  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, Power Query, and data modeling.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, such as Power BI, preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience driving automation and process improvements.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • CPA or CPA-eligible.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

description: Ready to be part of something special?  Join our Family!

raw.title: Amazon: Digital Merchandiser & Sales Analyst
raw.excerpt: Ready to be part of something special?  Join our Family!
raw.description:
Ready to be part of something special?
Join our Family!

The Amazon Catalog, Digital Merchandising & Sales Analyst supports the day-to-day management and growth of the company's Amazon business. This role combines Amazon catalog management, forecast management, digital merchandising, sales analytics, operational support and account management.

The individual will be responsible for maintaining best-in-class product detail pages, troubleshooting catalog and availability issues, analyzing sales and profitability trends, supporting forecasting and inventory management, and identifying opportunities to improve Amazon sales, conversion and overall account performance.


This is an ideal role for someone with 1–3 years of Amazon, eCommerce, digital merchandising, sales analytics or CPG experience who is highly analytical, detail-oriented and interested in developing broader Amazon account-management expertise.


Responsibilities:


Amazon Catalog, Forecast & Digital Shelf Management

  • Own day-to-day maintenance and accuracy of the company's Amazon product catalog, including new item setup, item additions, discontinuations, transitions, variations and catalog corrections.
  • Responsible for forecast management and accuracy
  • Manage product detail page content including titles, bullets, descriptions, images, videos, A+ Content and other digital assets.
  • Regularly audit Amazon detail pages for content accuracy, item availability, discoverability, conversion opportunities and brand consistency.
  • Identify and resolve catalog issues including incorrect product information, suppressed listings, broken variations, duplicate ASINs, UPC/GTIN conflicts, contribution conflicts and other detail-page errors.
  • Use Amazon bulk-upload tools and flat files to execute catalog changes efficiently when appropriate.
  • Open, track and escalate cases with Amazon support teams until issues are resolved.
  • Coordinate with internal Brand Marketing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Customer Service and other teams to ensure accurate setup and availability of new and existing items.
  • Ensure assets are delivered with sufficient lead time to support new item launches, promotions and media campaigns.
  • Work with content and syndication partners/agencies when needed to create, optimize and publish Amazon content.

Amazon Sales & Business Analysis

  • Pull and analyze Amazon reporting to understand sales, shipments, POS/consumer demand, traffic, conversion, inventory, availability and item-level performance.
  • Develop recurring weekly and monthly Amazon performance reporting and identify key drivers behind gains and declines.
  • Analyze performance by ASIN, brand, category and time period to identify opportunities and potential risks.
  • Monitor out-of-stocks, lost buy box where applicable, availability issues and other barriers to sales.
  • Assist with demand planning and forecasting by communicating Amazon trends, promotional activity and emerging business risks.
  • Identify underperforming or high-potential ASINs and recommend actions to improve sales.
  • Support analysis of Amazon promotions, deal events, merchandising activity and media programs.
  • Assist the Amazon team with annual planning, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews and customer presentations.
  • Develop a strong understanding of Amazon's business model and how sales, traffic, conversion, price, availability, content, media and profitability work together to drive account performance.

Amazon Account & Operational Management

  • Become a key day-to-day user of Amazon Vendor Central, Brand Registry and, where applicable, Seller Central.
  • Partner with the Amazon sales lead/manager on the execution of account plans designed to achieve revenue, profitability and market-share objectives.
  • Monitor account activity and proactively identify issues requiring internal or Amazon follow-up.
  • Support item setup, cost changes, promotional submissions and other Amazon account-management processes.
  • Coordinate with Supply Chain and Logistics on inventory availability, purchase-order or fulfillment issues, forecasting and new-item readiness.
  • Maintain clear trackers for open Amazon issues, responsibilities, actions and resolution dates.
  • Assist with monthly and quarterly Amazon business reviews and joint planning activities.
  • Build productive working relationships with relevant Amazon contacts and internal cross-functional partners.

Digital Marketing & Retail Media Support

  • Partner with the Amazon Sales/Marketing lead and Amazon media partners to execute Amazon marketing programs.
  • Support Amazon trade promotions and merchandising initiatives.
  • Coordinate product, content and inventory readiness before major Amazon promotional or media events.
  • Help identify opportunities where content/merchandising or promotional activity could improve Amazon performance.

Insights & Opportunity Identification

  • Monitor Amazon category, competitive and search trends and communicate relevant findings to the broader team.
  • Identify opportunities to improve product discoverability, content quality and conversion.
  • Translate Amazon data into clear business insights and recommended actions, rather than simply reporting numbers.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to grow the Amazon business and improve operating efficiency.

Experience, Skills, Education:


  • Bachelor's degree required in Analytics, Business, Marketing, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of professional experience in eCommerce, Amazon, digital merchandising, sales analytics, CPG or a related field within a CPG environment is required.
  • Some hands-on experience with Amazon Vendor Central, Seller Central, or other major retailer eCommerce platforms required.
  • Strong analytical skills and demonstrated ability to turn data into actionable insights.
  • Strong working knowledge of Excel, including PivotTables, lookups and manipulating large data sets.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data and content accuracy.
  • Ability to manage numerous ASINs, projects, deadlines and open issues simultaneously.
  • Strong written, verbal and presentation skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Logistics and agency partners.
  • Resourceful, curious and comfortable troubleshooting problems that do not have an obvious solution.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of issues through resolution.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and some ambiguity.
  • Experience with Amazon catalog management, new-item setup or digital shelf management, preferred.
  • Familiarity with ASINs, UPC/GTINs, parent/child variations, flat files, A+ Content, Brand Registry and Amazon support cases.
  • Experience analyzing Amazon sales, inventory, traffic and conversion data.
  • Familiarity with syndicated/digital shelf platforms or content-management tools.

Compensation:

Hiring Pay Range:

$61,128.00 - $81,504.00

Final base pay will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to; role responsibilities, experience, skills, education, geographic location, and/or internal pay equity.

Benefits:

We offer a variety of benefits that include comprehensive, affordable health and wellness coverage for you and your family.

  • Paid time off (holidays, vacation and sick days)

  • Medical, prescription drugs, dental and vision coverage

  • Life, disability and AD&D insurance

  • 401(k) plan

  • Flexible spending accounts

  • Tuition reimbursement program

  • Employee assistance programs

  • Telemedicine

  • Work-life balance

  • Employee discounts

  • Wellness program

  • Paid parental leave

Benefits may vary by location and position.

Work Location: Remote in Thailand

Project start: November 2026

About the Role

We are looking for experienced professionals and subject-matter experts to contribute to an AI training and evaluation project focused on the creation of realistic professional knowledge-based tasks.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience as Statisticians, Software Developers, Computer Systems Analysts, Civil Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Electrical Engineers, Industrial Engineers or similar and understands how real workplace assignments are completed.

The ideal candidate is also comfortable using modern LLM tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop realistic professional task scenarios based on your work experience in different roles within the above-mentioned sectors.

  • Create and review supporting business materials such as spreadsheets, reports, presentations, documents, datasets, or other occupation-specific files.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional qualification, where appropriate.

  • Minimum 3 years of relevant professional work experience in roles such as Statisticians, Software Developers, Computer Systems Analysts, Civil Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Electrical Engineers, Industrial Engineers and similar.

  • Be located in Thailand.

  • Strong practical knowledge of workflows, tools, terminology, standards, and deliverables used in your profession.

  • Have experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar AI tools.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience working with multiple documents, data sources, reports, spreadsheets, presentations, or similar professional materials.

  • Strong written English (all the project related task creation will be done in English).

  • High attention to detail and ability to produce accurate, internally consistent work.

  • Ability to distinguish realistic professional work from overly simplified or artificial scenarios.

  • Experience creating, reviewing, validating, auditing, or quality-checking professional work is a plus.

  • Experience developing training materials, case studies, or professional assessments is a plus.
