raw.description:
If you're passionate about being part of a diverse organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to deliver innovative business solutions with excellence, then Nationwide's Legal team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

The Paralegal Specialist will support Nationwide's Investment Management Group. The preferred candidate will have mutual fund and strong experience in Investment Company Act of 1940, Securities Act of 1933 and Securities Exchange Act of 1934. Functions are primarily related to the SEC registration and disclosure process, including:

  • Annual prospectus and registration statement updates;
  • Registration of new mutual funds;
  • Product modifications to existing mutual funds, such as
    • Changes in investment strategies
    • Changes to or additions of subadvisers
    • Adding or deleting share classes
    • Liquidating or merging mutual funds
  • Proxy solicitations;
  • Subadviser information statements;
  • Review of annual reports and semi-annual reports;
  • Preparation of mutual fund service provider agreements and plans (e.g., investment advisory agreements, Rule 12b-1 plans, Rule 18f-3 plans).

Experience with Rules 485 and 497 of the Securities Act of 1933, SEC Form N-1A and Edgar/XBRL requirements and ArcPro is preferred but not essential.

This position can be a remote work opportunity.


Job Description Summary

Would you thrive in an environment where you can deliver top-quality legal services to support the goals and objectives of a Fortune 100 insurance and financial services company? If you possess the communication skills, analytical ability and paralegal skills needed to provide outstanding service, advice and counsel, we want to hear from you!

As a Paralegal Specialist, you'll provide the highest level of legal assistance, project management and general support to the legal staff in the development, research, management and resolution of legal issues. We'll count on you to draft complex legal documents, agreements and pleadings related to a wide variety of matters, including litigation, for certain legal practice areas. You may have opportunities to work independently on some matters, with latitude for making decisions and taking action.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provides support to attorneys in the form of legal research, drafting communications and preparing legal documents with minimal direction.

  • Conducts sophisticated and detailed legal research and compiles data from such references as online sources, digests and practice manuals, among others. Researches and provides analysis of statutes, regulations and court decisions. Prepares summaries and recommends resolutions to legal questions. Prepares correspondence to internal and external contacts.

  • Drafts contracts, patent applications, resolutions and other legal documents. Drafts detailed deposition outlines/questions, motions, pleadings, subpoenas, orders and briefs. Works with attorney on unusual or complex matters.

  • Conducts and supervises broad-level assignments. Evaluates matters which may have a significant impact. May assist the attorney in executing legal matters.

  • For litigation specialty areas, leads the analysis and evaluation of records and data for discovery. Drafts recommendations and correspondence to clients, claims attorneys, and customers with regard to discovery and legal matters.

  • May develop and maintains information databases. Builds new processes for data maintenance, storage and retrieval.

  • May conduct and evaluate open and closed paralegal file audits, advising attorneys and management of the audit results and recommending improvements.

  • Demonstrates expertise in paralegal concepts and procedures. Maintains proficiency in both business and legal professional competencies.

  • Assists in developing and implementing policies, procedures and precedents for the paralegal area.

  • Coordinates workflow and mentors and trains less experienced paralegals.

  • Responds to requests for production of documents, responses to interrogatories and/or regulatory requests and inquiries, and coordinates pre-trial proceedings and discovery, depending on area of specialty.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Counsel/Paralegal Supervisor. May have the opportunity to lead a team of up to three associates.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate or post-graduate studies in business administration, insurance or other related area preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Certification in paralegal studies preferred.

Experience: Typically, eight or more years of experience as a paralegal with demonstrated good performance.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Advanced knowledge of paralegal concepts, practices and procedures. Significant knowledge of the operations, practices and procedures of general counsel or civil litigation, depending on area of specialty. Proven knowledge of filing requirements of courts and agencies. Must have demonstrated knowledge in legal research and complex deposition motion practices, as well as in appellate procedures.

Sophisticated analytical, research and organizational skills. Consistent track record in setting work priorities that conform with established standards. Self-starter who is able to work with little direction. Able to handle complex projects with minimal direction. Proven ability to provide leadership and support. Ability to give presentations in both formal and informal settings. Strong verbal and written skills for contact with associates, attorneys, clients and customers. Ability to operate a computer and related legal and business software and databases.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the Officer, Managing Counsel and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Eligible (Non-Exempt)

Working Conditions: Normal office environment, Occasional travel. Non-standard or extended work may be required based on project needs.

ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some associates assigned to the job to performs a somewhat different combination of duties.

Credit/Background Check: Due to the fiduciary accountabilities of this job, a valid credit and/or background which will be required as part of the selection process.

We currently anticipate accepting applications until 11/26/2026. However, we encourage early submissions, as the posting may close sooner if a strong candidate slate is identified before the deadline.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. To learn more about the benefits we offer,click here.

Position Purpose: Assist in maintaining Centene Corporation’s Compliance Program. Provide regulatory interpretation, perform compliance reporting, lead special projects, and develop and implement compliance auditing and monitoring strategies.


Key Details: Applicants for this job have the flexibility to work remote from home anywhere in the Continental United States.


  • Respond to external requests for information required by the organization for its regulatory filings
  • Manage compliance reporting responsibilities and respond to inquiries from state and federal regulatory agencies
  • Manage ethics and compliance projects or implementations
  • Review and synthesize regulatory requirements and create policy and/or position statements
  • Assist in managing annual code of conduct attestation and remediation
  • Communicate state and federal requirements to internal and external clients
  • Provide development guidance and assist in the identification, implementation, and maintenance of compliance policies, procedures and work instructions
  • Assist in the identification, analysis, and resolution of compliance issues.
  • Maintain and review regulatory documentation necessary to maintain corporate standards
  • Assist in developing, producing and conducting compliance training programs
  • Perform periodic compliance audits, risk assessments and conducts related to ongoing compliance monitoring activities
  • Assist health plans in managing relationships with regulatory agencies and seek to resolve policy issues which may negatively impact service to members
  • Assist management with interim health plan compliance officer responsibilities
  • Plan, direct and coordinate the implementation of Compliance Committee policy to ensure decisions are properly executed
  • Serve as a company-wide resource and liaison on policies, contract issues and provisions, communications, workflow, and quality improvements initiatives

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in related legal field or equivalent experience.
  • Master’s or Juris Doctorate degree preferred and maybe considered in lieu of experience.
  • 3+ years of related experience in compliance privacy and/or regulatory affairs.
  • Experience in project management with working knowledge of laws and/or regulations in area of compliance, in particular HIPAA, and state regulations.
Pay Range: $70,100.00 - $126,200.00 per year

At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act

Job Title: Manager, Government Pricing Business Process

Job Location: New York, New York, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Overview

Manages multiple consulting projects of varying complexity and ensures on-time and on-budget delivery for clients in the life sciences field. Contributes to new business development and maintaining and strengthening client base. May support the development of new offerings.

Essential Functions

  • Manages project teams including both internal and external resources in the design, development and delivery of client solutions.
    • Leads teams to review and analyze client requirements or challenges and develops and costs associated proposals that ensure profitability and high client satisfaction with limited if any senior management input.
    • Manages the process of proposal preparation and/or modifications including overall bid integrity.
    • Develops project plan with timelines and deliverables and leads project to successful completion, on-time and on-budget, from start to finish with limited senior management guidance.
    • Recommends improvements and alternative solutions to resolve problems.
    • Serves as key point of contact with client.
    • Provides high level input to, and ensures the development of, client reports and presentations and delivers all or significant portions of findings to client.
    • Develops and/or elevates new business opportunities through the identification of follow-on work and new leads.
    • Provides follow-up with client after project deliverable have been completed to ensure client satisfaction.
    • Proactively continues to strengthen subject matter expertise through on the job experience, participation in conferences and symposiums and other forums for professional knowledge sharing.
    • Proactively mentors, coaches and shares subject matter expertise with others to elevate our capabilities to deliver world-class solutions for clients.

    Qualifications
    • Bachelor's Degree Req
    • Master's Degree Pref
    • 8-12 years of related experience including consulting and life sciences industry experience Req
    • Demonstrates excellent project management skills and client influencing and relationship building skills.
    • In-depth understanding of IQVIA data assets and the IQVIA core offerings.
    • Works willingly and effectively with others in and across the organization to accomplish team goals.
    • Experienced with developing consultative relationships with senior level managers and executives at clients in the life sciences industry.
    • Ability to manage multiple projects, juggle priorities and deliver on tight deadlines.
    • Knowledge of consulting methodologies, tools and techniques related to functional area.
    • Knowledge of key issues and current developments in the life sciences industry.
    • Excellent presentation, communication and client influencing skills.
    • Has established network and referral contacts.
    • Possesses the necessary subject matter expertise and project management skills able to effectively manage projects across more than one CoE.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law.

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

Solutions Engineer, Pre-Sales

Customer Solutions Group | North America

GrowthLoop is on a mission to help marketing teams activate their data with speed and precision. As a Solutions Engineer, you'll play a critical role in driving GrowthLoop’s expansion by partnering closely with the sales team to bring our Compound Marketing Engine to life for prospective clients. You’ll bridge the gap between product and customer, helping marketers and technical stakeholders - including data engineers, analytics teams, and IT - realize the power of activating data from the data cloud to drive real business outcomes. Your ability to navigate both business and technical conversations will be key to unlocking value for complex, data-savvy organizations.

You’re comfortable speaking with confidence in a sales environment, leading demos, and answering product and technology-related questions. You have a strong understanding of Customer Data, Marketing Technology, Data Warehouses like BigQuery and Snowflake, Marketing KPIs, and Marketing Channels.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Account Executives from discovery through close to qualify technical fit, shape account strategy, and guide customer evaluations.
  • Lead discovery with marketing and data teams to understand how they store customer data, build audiences, run campaigns, and measure results.
  • Create tailored demos, prototypes, and proofs of value with clear success criteria that show how GrowthLoop fits into each prospect’s data and marketing stack.
  • Serve as the primary technical contact during evaluations, explaining architecture, integrations, and tradeoffs to both data teams and marketing leaders.
  • Work with Account Executives on pricing and scope when technical requirements affect the proposed solution.
  • Document requirements and open questions, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate with Product and Engineering to keep evaluations moving.
  • Answer competitive questions using your knowledge of CDPs, data warehouses, identity resolution, AI in marketing, and cross-channel activation.
  • Bring recurring customer pain points and product feedback to the teams that can act on them.
  • Travel for customer meetings when being there will meaningfully help an opportunity.

What We Look For

  • 3+ years in sales engineering or technical presales, supporting complex B2B SaaS sales cycles from discovery through technical evaluation.
  • Experience supporting evaluations for enterprise data or marketing platforms, including how audiences are built from warehouse data and activated through downstream integrations.
  • Working knowledge of Snowflake or BigQuery, how customer data flows through a modern data stack, and where LLMs can add value in marketing workflows.
  • An understanding of how marketing teams choose audiences, messages, offers, and channels, and how they measure whether a campaign worked.
  • Familiarity with experimentation and incremental lift, including why a high response rate does not necessarily mean a campaign changed customer behavior.
  • Experience explaining technical concepts to both data teams and marketing leaders, adapting your approach to what each audience needs to decide.
  • Strong judgment in complex sales cycles. You can prioritize technical questions, communicate what still needs validation, and work across teams to keep an evaluation moving.
  • Direct experience in marketing, marketing operations, or marketing strategy is a plus

About GrowthLoop

GrowthLoop built the first composable CDP, helping marketers leverage live, first-party data from their cloud warehouse to launch highly targeted campaigns. That composable foundation gave way to the Compound Marketing Engine, an evolution of the composable CDP that drives compound growth by using agentic AI to accelerate the marketing cycle.

Now, we’re building what comes next: an agentic system that uses causality data to find the actions that actually improve customer outcomes and gets smarter with every campaign cycle.

Founder-led, we’re partnering with the world’s most innovative brands to close the loop between people, data, and AI. Enterprise marketing teams at Google, Costco, Ford, and Whirlpool (to name a few) choose GrowthLoop to launch smarter, more personalized marketing programs that compound growth with every campaign.

What We Offer

The on-target earnings range for this role is USD $180,000–$200,000 or CAD $260,000–$280,000.Total compensation includes equity. Final base salary decisions will be based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors unique to each candidate, such as the individual’s skill set, location, depth of experience, and qualifications.

Rewards

  • See your work impact some of the most important businesses in the world, including Google, Priceline, and Indeed.
  • Spot bonuses for major milestones and product feature graduations
  • Opportunities for career progression and dynamic collaboration across teams
  • Equity incentives for employees making an impact

Flexible Work Style

  • Remote-First Culture
  • Flexible schedules and goal-based work style
  • Unbounded PTO
  • Monthly Recharge Days

Competitive Benefits

  • Free Platinum Health Insurance with Aetna
  • 401(k) Program with Generous Company Match

Learn and Grow

  • Quarterly Hackathons to focus on team passion projects
  • Education Stipend towards your professional development
  • Work closely with our world-class executive team
  • Learners’ mindset culture

GrowthLoop is an Equal Opportunity Employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Program: Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) Increment 1
Position Type: Full-Time, Dedicated Program Support
Location: Remote*, with occasional travel as required.

*Please be advised that during the interview, yo will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes, if an offer letter is extended to you.

Clearance: Active Secret Clearance and must maintain the clearance required by the program.


Position Summary

Leidos is seeking a motivated Junior Program Financial Analyst to support financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and program controls for the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) Increment 1 program.

AGUN is a large-scale Army network modernization program supporting enterprise network operations, engineering, cybersecurity, and deployment activities across multiple geographic theaters.

The selected candidate will work closely with the AGUN Program Management Office, Program Finance, Contracts, Subcontracts, and functional leads to maintain accurate financial information, support routine financial processes, and assist with cost and resource planning.

This position offers an opportunity to gain experience supporting a complex Department of Defense program while developing skills in government contract financial management.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Support preparation and maintenance of program budgets, financial forecasts, and monthly financial reports.
  • Track actual costs, labor expenditures, subcontractor costs, material expenses, and financial commitments.
  • Maintain financial trackers supporting contract funding, ceiling utilization, and projected funding requirements.
  • Assist with Estimates to Complete (ETC), Estimates at Completion (EAC), and variance analysis under the direction of senior financial personnel.
  • Support Technical Direction Letter (TDL) and Technical Direction Plan (TDP) financial tracking and cost reconciliation.
  • Collect and consolidate labor forecasts and staffing requirements from program functional leads.
  • Assist in reconciling subcontractor expenditures, purchase orders, invoices, and financial commitments.
  • Develop and maintain Excel-based financial models, trackers, and management reporting tools.
  • Support preparation of financial information for program reviews, Government meetings, and leadership briefings.
  • Identify discrepancies in financial data and coordinate corrective actions with Program Finance and functional teams.
  • Assist with monthly revenue forecasting, cost reporting, and financial closeout activities.
  • Maintain accurate financial documentation and support compliance with Leidos financial policies and government contracting requirements.
  • Provide administrative and analytical support for program financial planning and reporting activities.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Typically 2–4 years of experience in financial analysis, accounting, budgeting, or program support.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, data reconciliation, and financial reporting.
  • Ability to analyze financial information, identify discrepancies, and prepare accurate reports.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to learn government contract financial management processes and systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Department of Defense or federal government contracts.
  • Familiarity with cost-reimbursement contracts, including CPFF or CPAF structures.
  • Exposure to program budgets, EAC/ETC forecasting, or financial variance analysis.
  • Experience with enterprise financial management or ERP systems.
  • Familiarity with subcontract financial tracking, purchase orders, and invoice reconciliation.
  • Experience using Power BI or similar reporting and data visualization tools.
  • Familiarity with Leidos financial systems and program reporting processes.

Expected Outcomes

  • Accurate and timely maintenance of program financial trackers and reporting data.
  • Improved visibility into labor, subcontractor, and material expenditures.
  • Consistent support for monthly forecasting and financial reviews.
  • Reduced administrative and analytical workload for senior financial personnel.
  • Better coordination between Program Finance and the AGUN PMO.
  • Increased financial reporting efficiency and data accuracy.

Professional Development Opportunity

The position will provide exposure to financial management across a large, complex Army modernization program. The successful candidate will develop experience in program forecasting, cost analysis, government contracting, and integrated program controls, with opportunities for increasing responsibility as skills and experience grow.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

For more information, please visit Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Territory Manager

Position Summary

The Territory Manager will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned territory. This individual will be responsible for educating healthcare providers (HCPs) on Mineralys’ product, building trusted customer relationships, driving product adoption, and achieving territory sales performance goals.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong selling skills, customer engagement capabilities, and a passion for improving outcomes for patients with uncontrolled hypertension. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial biotech environment and is energized by the opportunity to launch a breakthrough new class of medicine.

Key Responsibilities

Territory Management / Business Execution

  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the disease state, clinical data, and relevant treatment guidelines.
  • Build and execute a comprehensive territory business plan aligned with brand strategy, launch priorities, and sales objectives.
  • Drive product adoption and compliant utilization among targeted healthcare providers.
  • Analyze territory trends, customer needs, and competitive activity to identify opportunities and course correct as needed.
  • Consistently deliver against sales goals, call activity expectations, and launch milestones.
  • Maintain accurate territory reporting, and CRM documentation

Customer Engagement / Selling Excellence

  • Execute strategic call plans by translating data and insights into impactful, customer-focused actions.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and openness to new ideas, embracing innovative approaches to customer engagement.
  • Apply strong business acumen to assess market dynamics and leverage insights for effective territory planning.
  • Build and sustain trusted relationships with healthcare providers, office staff, and key decision-makers
  • Clearly and compliantly communicate clinical data, product value, access information, and appropriate patient identification.
  • Deliver engaging, high-quality product presentations and address customers questions with confidence and credibility.
  • Partner with customers to address barriers to patient access and support product pull-through

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner effectively with cross-functional stakeholders to understand customers needs and elevate the overall customer and patient experience in a compliant manner.
  • Collaborate closely with adjacent field partners including Field Reimbursement Managers, Territory Managers, and Regional Business Directors to support customer needs and territory objectives
  • Share insights, learnings, and best practices with field leadership and internal team (e.g., Marketing, Training, Field Operations and Analytics)
  • Provide timely market intelligence, customer insights, and competitive updates
  • Support regional meetings, launch initiatives, and company-sponsored programs

Compliance / Culture

  • Operate with the highest standards of integrity and in full compliance with all company policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements
  • Demonstrate professionalism, accountability and ethical conduct in all customer interactions
  • Consistently embody Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 3+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech sales experience preferred with other relevant sales experience considered
  • Specialty sales experience (cardiometabolic) preferred
  • Prior launch experience preferred
  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales goals strong customer relationships
  • Strong clinical acumen and ability to communicate complex scientific information
  • Excellent territory planning, organizational, and communication skills
  • Self-motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, launch environment
  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel within territory

Success Profile

  • Customer-focused centric and relationship-driven
  • Highly accountable with strong executionfocus
  • Adaptable and resilient in a launch environment
  • Collaborative, team-oriented, and eager to contribute to shared success.
  • Passionate about making a meaningful impact for patients

Travel

  • This position requires up to 60% travel.

These positions are eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

You will utilize your skills, knowledge, and clinical judgement to provide a high standard of care for participants in clinical trials and respond to emergency situations based upon clinical research standards.


Responsibilities:

  • Ensure the integrity of the data submitted on Case Report Forms (CRFs) or other data collection tools by careful source document Monitor data for missing or implausible data
  • Responsible for all aspects of registry management as prescribed in the project plans - Undertake feasibility work when requested
  • Complete Serious Adverse Event (SAE) reporting, process production of repo11s, narratives and follow up of SAEs
  • Independently perform CRF review; query generation and resolution against established data review guidelines on Fortrea or client data management systems as assigned by management
  • Assist with training of new employees, eg. co-monitoring

Requirements

  • University or college degree, or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriately accredited institution (e.g. nursing licensure)
  • 3+ years of Clinical Monitoring experience
  • 30-50+% overnight travel
  • Ophthalmology experience

The important thing for us is you are comfortable working in an environment that is:

  • Fast paced: where no deviations from the study protocol are allowed, and not meeting a timeline for even few minutes will create a quality issue.
  • Changing priorities constantly asking you to prioritize and adapt on the spot.
  • Teamwork and people skills are essential for the study to run smoothly.
  • Technology based. We collect our data directly into an electronic environment.

Work Environment:

  • Work is performed in an office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to sit for extended periods and operate a vehicle safely.

raw.description:
About Cyngn, Inc.

Based in Mountain View, CA, Cyngn is a publicly-traded autonomous technology company. We deploy self-driving industrial vehicles to factories, warehouses, and other facilities throughout North America. To build this emergent technology, we are looking for innovative, motivated, and experienced leaders to join us and move this field forward. If you like to build, tinker, and create with a team of trusted and passionate colleagues, then Cyngn is the place for you.

About the role

The Senior Account Executive grows revenue for Cyngn’s Enterprise Autonomy Suite, the company’s flagship industrial autonomous vehicle product line. This is a capital equipment sale into industrial and manufacturing environments, with sales cycles that typically run 3 to 9 months and require engagement across every level of the customer organization, from plant floor operators and engineering leads to VPs of Operations and C-suite economic buyers. The Senior Account Executive owns complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities end to end, applies a formal qualification methodology (MEDDPICC or equivalent), and helps shape a go-to-market motion that is still being built.

What you'll do

Full-Cycle Deal Ownership

  • Own the full sales cycle from qualification through close, applying a structured methodology (MEDDPICC or equivalent) to establish Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identified Pain, Champion, and Competition on every opportunity.
  • Multi-thread each account by identifying and engaging the full buying committee, including economic buyers, technical evaluators, operations and plant leadership, procurement, and legal, rather than relying on a single point of contact.
  • Build and maintain mutual action plans with prospects to keep 3–9 month sales cycles on track through technical evaluation, pilot or proof-of-value stages, procurement, and contract execution.
  • Translate technical product capabilities into business outcomes and ROI, tailoring the message for operational stakeholders (safety, throughput, labor efficiency) and financial or executive stakeholders (total cost of ownership, payback period, capital versus operating expense).

Pipeline & Account Growth

  • Qualify and advance leads sourced by the outbound sales development team and inbound marketing channels, and independently generate pipeline through targeted account prospecting.
  • Develop and execute account penetration strategies for existing customers to drive expansion into additional sites and use cases.

Contracts, Forecasting & Collaboration

  • Lead or coordinate commercial and legal document review, including MSAs, Concept of Operations documents, and order forms, in partnership with Legal and Finance to keep deals moving through the paper process.
  • Maintain accurate, current opportunity and account records in the CRM, including MEDDPICC fields, next steps, and mutual action plans, to support reliable forecasting.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Engineering, Engineering, and Product to align on account strategy, technical validation, and post-sale handoff.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of B2B sales experience carrying an individual quota, with a demonstrated track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Working knowledge of MEDDPICC or a comparable structured methodology (e.g., MEDDIC, Command of the Message, Value Selling), with demonstrated discipline applying it to live deals.
  • Demonstrated ability to sell into and manage multi-level buying committees over 3–9+ month cycles, from operational end users through C-level economic buyers.
  • Experience selling to mid-market and/or enterprise accounts.
  • Strong discovery and qualification skills, with the ability to identify pain, quantify metrics, and build a credible, defensible business case.
  • Comfortable reading and negotiating commercial contract terms and coordinating with Legal and Finance through procurement and the paper process.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently prospect, build pipeline, and manage a territory or account list with minimal oversight.
  • Rigorous CRM discipline, with consistent use of CRM tools to maintain forecast accuracy and deal hygiene.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present credibly to technical and executive audiences and translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Be available to travel to customer sites, trade shows, and for other sales activities up to 50% of the time

Bonus Qualifications

  • Direct experience selling capital equipment, industrial automation, robotics, IoT, or other hardware-centric solutions.
  • Familiarity with the AGV/AMR (automated guided vehicle / autonomous mobile robot) market.
  • Experience selling into logistics, warehousing, or manufacturing operations.

Benefits & Perks

  • Health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision) through Aetna, Kaiser Permanente, and Guardian, with multiple plan tiers to choose from
  • Ancillary benefits including accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity plans (Voya)
  • Company-paid basic life insurance, plus voluntary (supplemental) life for you and your dependents
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • HSA and FSA (Health & Dependent Daycare)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 1:1 Health Concierge
  • Company 401(k)
  • Commuter Benefits

raw.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£41,300-52,250 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

Our VAIB team⭐

Making money work for everyone is what we do at Monzo, but it only counts if it works for the people who need support the most. Our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team is dedicated to breaking down barriers across the bank. We make sure that whether a customer is vulnerable, disabled, excluded, or experiencing a bereavement, they get a product and a service that is empathetic, accessible, and built entirely with them in mind.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

As VAIB Strategy Analyst, you will play a critical role in fulfilling Monzo's mission to make money work for everyone by driving meaningful improvements for customers requiring additional support. Working collaboratively, you will leverage data, customer insights, and operational expertise to seamlessly embed vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion, and bereavement considerations into product and service design. You will take proactive ownership of complex strategic projects and use independent judgement to navigate ambiguous escalations, shape treatment strategies, and identify emerging risks. Ultimately, you will ensure that changes deliver equitable customer outcomes while maintaining strong standards of risk management, governance, and regulatory compliance.

  • Lead Strategic Delivery: Take ownership of complex VAIB workstreams, translating strategic priorities into clear delivery plans and driving improvements that balance customer needs, regulatory expectations, and operational goals.
  • Drive Data-Led Improvements: Analyze quantitative data, customer feedback, and operational insights to identify systemic barriers, proactively monitor outcomes, and develop evidence-based recommendations for strategic change.
  • Champion Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner seamlessly across Product, Engineering, and Operations to build VAIB awareness, influence decision-making, and embed inclusive considerations into the design of customer journeys and internal processes.
  • Navigate Complex Escalations: Act as the escalation point for complex, ambiguous customer or operational issues, applying strong independent judgement to recommend proportionate solutions when clear policy guidance is unavailable.
  • Own Governance and Risk: Manage control requirements for all strategic changes, ensuring work is rigorously assessed, documented, and governed to support informed decision-making and mitigate regulatory risk.
  • Coach and Build Capability: Strengthen the wider VAIB team by proactively sharing specialist knowledge, mentoring less experienced colleagues, and elevating overall analytical and strategic ways of working.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have deep subject matter expertise in VAIB and relevant legal frameworks (e.g., Consumer Duty, Equality Act, WCAG), applying this knowledge to identify systemic barriers and proactively recommend improvements to products and customer journeys. VAIB experience is preferable but we'd also love to hear from you if you have any other regulatory background.
  • You have a proven ability to independently manage and deliver complex strategic initiatives, utilising quantitative data, customer insights, and operational feedback to investigate ambiguous challenges, resolve blockers, and implement practical solutions.
  • You have a strong grasp of risk, governance, and assurance, paired with excellent decision-making skills to confidently navigate ambiguity, appropriately mitigate risks, and ensure complex decisions are effectively balanced and documented.
  • You are highly skilled in stakeholder management and communication, with the ability to clearly convey sensitive information, constructively challenge existing approaches, and drive alignment across Operations, Product, Risk, Data, and Engineering.
  • You are committed to delivering exceptional outcomes for vulnerable customers, coupled with a dedication to sharing expertise and coaching colleagues to build the overall capability and confidence of the wider team.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £41,300-52,250 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

  • Recruiter call (25 minutes)
  • Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)
  • Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

raw.description:
About the Company

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.
A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight.
Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet the Team

The Senior Autonomy Core Frameworks Software Engineer plays a critical role in architecting and advancing the foundational frameworks that underpin Torc's autonomous driving stack. This role helps in owning technical direction for the software in core autonomy components, helping to raise the bar on code quality, and driving improvements across the autonomy software.

As a senior technical leader, you will collaborate closely with the Behavior and Perception teams within Autonomy to design robust, composable architectural patterns that serve as the foundation for safe, performant, reliable autonomous operation. This position demands deep technical expertise in software architecture and autonomous vehicle fundamentals.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the architecture, design, implementation, and evolution of core frameworks that serve as the foundation for Torc's autonomous driving stack, including state management, inter-component communication, abstraction layers, and common utilities used across all software systems.
  • Drive the technical direction for real-time C++ architectural components and patterns responsible for reliable system-wide data flow, component coordination, error handling, and operational observability.
  • Establish scalable architectural patterns and abstractions that enable autonomous driving capabilities while driving technical tradeoff discussions and long-term design decisions that shape the entire platform.
  • Collaborate across Behavior and Perception teams to keep integration boundaries clean and shared abstractions coherent.
  • Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and code reviews while establishing engineering standards that improve reliability, maintainability, testability, and scalability across the platform.
  • Mentor software engineers through technical coaching, architectural guidance, and day-to-day collaboration while raising engineering standards and fostering technical excellence across the organization.
  • Champion architectural quality through systematic validation, comprehensive testing strategies, observability frameworks, and production readiness practices that ensure platform robustness at scale.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis of complex platform-level issues and drive architectural improvements that enhance system reliability, performance, and operational resilience.
  • Define and evolve simulation and validation frameworks that enable rigorous testing of core architectural components across diverse operational scenarios and edge cases.
  • Evaluate emerging architectural patterns, systems research, and advanced techniques that can strengthen the platform's foundation and enable future autonomous driving capabilities.
  • Communicate complex architectural concepts and technical vision effectively across engineering teams, product, and leadership while building consensus around platform direction and technical strategy.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline with 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, or
  • Master's degree with 6+ years of professional experience, or
  • Demonstrated success designing and evolving complex, production software platforms with ownership of architectural decisions
  • Deep experienced with C++17 and recent standards
  • Comfortable with using Python to help script and glue systems together
  • Experience working across autonomous systems/robotics, distributed systems, or complex embedded environments using middleware with pub-sub communications patterns
  • Strong experience with testing, continuous integration, and build systems
  • Deep experience with systems-level software design, including experience managing technical debt, refactoring large codebases, and evolving platforms while maintaining stability and performance.
  • Experience mentoring engineers through technical leadership, architecture reviews, code reviews, and establishing engineering standards that scale across organizations.
  • Strong mastery of software engineering fundamentals including modular/composable architecture, design patterns, concurrency, testing strategies, and long-term maintainability.

Bonus Points

  • Experience architecting, maintaining, and using robotics middleware's (E.g., ROS 2)
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems design, including consensus algorithms, state synchronization, event-driven architectures, deterministic replay, etc.
  • Familiarity with ISO 26262, SOTIF, ASPICE, or other safety-critical software development standards.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins
  • Experience with Bazel and Bazel-based build systems
  • Experience designing or building observability, logging, and monitoring systems for complex distributed systems.
  • Experience working with simulations for regression testing
  • Experience managing versioning and conversion of data schemas at scale

Perks of Being a Full-time Torc’r
Torc cares about our team members and we strive to provide benefits and resources to support their health, work/life balance, and future. Our culture is collaborative, energetic, and team focused. Torc offers:

  • A competitive compensation package that includes a bonus component and stock options
  • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees
  • 401K plan with a 6% employer match
  • Flexibility in schedule and generous paid vacation (available immediately after start date)
  • AD+D and Life Insurance

At Torc, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We celebrate the uniqueness of our Torc’rs and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, or disabilities.
Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications listed for this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets. Pay is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Torc's total compensation package will also include our corporate bonus and stock option plan. Dependent on the position offered, sign-on payments, relocation, and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

About Bask Health

Bask Health provides a full-service SaaS platform that enables doctors, entrepreneurs, and healthcare businesses to build, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, speed, and exceptional execution. We work in small teams, tackle complex problems, and expect everyone to take an active role in building and improving our products.

About the Role

We're looking for an Associate Product Manager, New Grad to help build and improve the software that powers Bask Health's telehealth platform.

This is an early-career opportunity for someone who has recently completed their education and wants to develop a career in technical product management. You'll work alongside experienced product managers, engineers, and designers to understand customer problems, evaluate solutions, and help bring new features to life.

At Bask, product managers are closely involved in how software is built. You'll need to understand technical concepts, communicate effectively with engineers, and take an active role in moving projects forward.

You'll gain experience across product discovery, technical planning, development, testing, and launches while gradually taking ownership of smaller features and initiatives.

We're looking for someone who enjoys building things, learns quickly, and has the initiative to turn ideas into practical solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Work with product managers, engineers, and designers to develop and improve features across Bask's telehealth platform.
  • Help identify customer problems and translate them into clear product requirements.
  • Gather feedback from merchants, patients, clinicians, and internal teams to understand how our products are used.
  • Assist with defining product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation.
  • Support product discovery, competitive research, and early-stage feature exploration.
  • Collaborate with engineers to understand technical feasibility, implementation requirements, and development tradeoffs.
  • Use coding knowledge to investigate technical issues, understand product behavior, and communicate solutions.
  • Help develop prototypes, proof-of-concept solutions, and early feature demonstrations.
  • Support smaller product initiatives from initial planning through testing, launch, and iteration.
  • Investigate bugs, reproduce issues, and document findings for engineering teams.
  • Participate in product planning meetings, technical discussions, feature reviews, and development workflows.
  • Work with designers to improve usability and simplify complex user experiences.
  • Help analyze product usage, customer feedback, and performance metrics to evaluate product improvements.
  • Support quality assurance, feature validation, and product releases.
  • Maintain product documentation, project updates, and development priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce friction, and make Bask's applications more effective.
  • Present research findings, technical observations, and product recommendations to the team.
  • Gradually take ownership of smaller features and product improvements as you develop your skills.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Recent graduate or early-career candidate with a strong interest in technical product management.
  • Foundational understanding of software development, web applications, and how technology products are built.
  • Hands-on coding experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or another programming language through coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional work.
  • Experience building or meaningfully contributing to at least one software application, website, prototype, or technical project.
  • Ability to read and understand basic code, investigate technical issues, and communicate effectively with engineers.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to understand user needs and translate problems into practical product ideas.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to research unfamiliar topics, evaluate information, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with engineers, designers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and product development processes quickly.
  • Initiative, ownership, and ability to work independently on assigned responsibilities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities and requirements may evolve.

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Internship, university project, or independent experience involving product management or software development.
  • Experience building and launching a website, application, or other technical product.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, or modern web development frameworks.
  • Experience working with APIs, databases, Git, or GitHub.
  • Familiarity with product development methodologies, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience conducting user research, usability testing, or competitive analysis.
  • Familiarity with ClickUp, Jira, Linear, Figma, or similar product development tools.
  • Experience analyzing data using spreadsheets, SQL, or product analytics tools.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to build prototypes or solve technical problems.
  • Interest in SaaS platforms, e-commerce, or consumer-facing applications.
  • Interest in telehealth, digital health, or healthcare technology.
  • A portfolio, GitHub profile, or personal projects demonstrating technical ability and product thinking.

raw.title: Survey Manager, Survey Research Science and Operations
raw.excerpt: Are you a survey research professional hoping to further build your project management experience?
raw.description:
Are you a survey research professional hoping to further build your project management experience? Then come join ICF’s Survey Research Science and Operations practice. We are home to a talented community of survey researchers building robust solutions for government, university, and commercial clients.

ICF survey products aim to demonstrate quality, credibility, reliability, innovation, responsiveness, and transparency. For more information:


The Survey Research Science and Operations practice is seeking a Survey Manager. If successful, you will support a variety of projects across a wide array of topics and clients at the federal, state, and commercial level, including public health, aviation, transportation, energy (various utilities), and more. This role is well suited to a project manager who is highly organized, takes ownership of work, and is comfortable keeping multiple teams, tasks, deadlines, and dependencies moving at the same time.


You will be expected to provide support in the following three areas:


1.Project Management- You will manage the day-to-day activities of concurrent survey-related projects.

2.Business Development- You will support the team’s proposal and grant development activities; this includes written sections of proposals as well as internal and external networking and relationship management.

3.Technical Expertise- You will provide technical assistance to internal and external clients in association with the projects you manage as well as complete technical reports and other deliverables as required.


This is a great position for a mid-level professional who will join our team in a REMOTE capacity.


What you’ll do:

  • Manage concurrent survey-related projects, serving as the key point of contact to clients, providing excellent service, managing expectations, and producing products that demonstrate results.
  • Prepare project plans, manage schedules, and performance using effective project management processes and frameworks.
  • Create and track project budgets.
  • Keep multiple workstreams moving simultaneously by identifying next steps, assigning and following up on actions, managing dependencies, and escalating issues when needed.
  • Identify and coordinate with internal collaborators and outside subcontractors and vendors.
  • Proactively manage and communicate with a team of cross-matrixed professionals, ensuring smooth team operations and effective collaboration.
  • Contribute methodological or technical guidance in support of quantitative projects or tasks involving web, mail, telephone, in-person, and other data collection activities.
  • Contribute methodological or technical guidance in support of qualitative projects or tasks involving cognitive interviewing, one-on-one interviews, and/or focus groups.
  • Develop project quality assurance protocols, and ensure quality for all data, reports, and presentations.
  • Communicate effectively in writing—proposals, analytic reports, issue papers, briefings, and formal and informal email correspondence.
  • Develop and cultivate strong client relationships.Anticipate risks, bottlenecks and dependencies and proactively implement solutions to keep projects on track.
  • Update leadership on progress as directed and on regular reporting cycles.
  • Actively participate in business development activities— managing the proposal process, and writing proposal sections.undefined

What you must have:

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 3+ years of applied experience in the survey research field.
  • 2+ years of experience in survey project management, including coordinating teams and tasks, tracking completion of activities, managing schedules, monitoring project budget, and ensuring the quality of work products.2+ years of experience contributing to proposals in response to government solicitations (RFPs, RFQs, RFIs) or competitive grant applications
  • 2+ years of experience with MS Office products—Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or professional skills.

Professional Skills

  • Experience managing and advancing multiple workstreams simultaneously, with strong organizational and follow-through skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of work, independently drive tasks forward, and recognize when issues require escalation.
  • Demonstrated customer service orientation and outstanding level of professionalism in providing client support.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear, compelling narrative that turns technical approaches into client-focused win themes and value propositions

Additional professional skills and experience preferred:

  • 1+ year experience conducting and analyzing qualitative research.
  • Master’s degree preferred.
  • Ability to be flexible, multi-task, prioritize, and manage multiple activities simultaneously in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Experience in quantitative data analysis and statistical software experience (e.g., R, Python, SPSS, SAS).
  • Proficiency in Spanish or another foreign language is a plus.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.


We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Work Authorization and Sponsorship

All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

Reasonable Accommodations

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email  and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. 


Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act.


Bot and Third-Party Applications

Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact for assistance.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. 


However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at . We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.  


Pay Range

There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location, education and certifications as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position.


The pay range for this position based on full-time employment is:

raw.description:
IMPORTANT: after you apply, please check your email. We sendyou a link to complete your application — it is not considered until that laststep is done. If you do not see it, check your spam folder.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in 55 countries, including United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, India, France, Netherlands, Singapore.

Pay: $80–$150/hr

Role Title: Quantitative Rates Researcher

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

We are engaging Quantitative Rates Researchers to contribute to a leading investment bank’s algorithmic trading platform project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and assess AI-generated quantitative research and trading strategy outputs focused on fixed income and rates markets
  2. Identify and document methodological issues such as lookahead bias, overfitting, data snooping, and unrealistic transaction cost assumptions
  3. Evaluate the accuracy of backtesting frameworks, especially with respect to rates-specific mechanics like carry/roll-down and contract roll conventions
  4. Scrutinize the statistical rigor of signal construction, factor modeling, and alpha research in the provided outputs
  5. Deliver detailed written feedback on model assumptions, implementation fidelity, and research soundness
  6. Collaborate asynchronously with project coordinators by clarifying findings and suggestions through clear written and verbal communication
  7. Contribute to the refinement of research evaluation processes for greater accuracy and relevance

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Background as a quantitative researcher, analyst, or consultant with expertise in fixed income or rates markets
  2. Demonstrated experience building and backtesting systematic rates strategies at a hedge fund, asset manager, or bank
  3. Advanced proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy, scipy) or R for quantitative research and data analysis
  4. Strong understanding of yield curve modeling, carry/roll-down analytics, relative value trading, SOFR/Eurodollar instruments, and Treasury futures
  5. Comfort evaluating research under real-world trading conditions, including transaction costs and liquidity constraints
  6. Exceptional attention to detail and ability to articulate complex quantitative findings in clear, concise written feedback
  7. Prior experience assessing or reviewing models for compliance with best practices in quantitative finance is a plus

How to apply

Apply here with your profile. We will then email you a link to complete yourapplication on the hiring platform — your application is only considered oncethat final step is done.

raw.title: Product Designer
raw.excerpt: Software is not just vital but a strategic cornerstone of our operations.
raw.description:
Software is not just vital but a strategic cornerstone of our operations. We’re looking for a Product Designer to set the cross-application UX direction for our commercial software - from pharma cold-chain visibility that helps temperature-sensitive medicines move safely around the world, to ULD tracking for airlines. You’ll define a consistent, high-quality experience across our modules and applications and support our specialised designers in bringing that experience to life, while remaining hands-on in discovery, from the first user conversation through to the final UX.

📍 Location: We are open to candidates based anywhere within the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands, with remote working available within these countries. Hybrid option available in the Netherlands.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell?

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.

🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.

What You'll Do:

A dedicated framework team owns our Design System and Design Guidelines, while embedded designers craft the screens and flows within each product module. Your role is to set the overall direction for the experience they design towards — including experience principles, end-to-end journeys and measurable outcomes that help multiple modules feel like one product.

You will:

  • Lead discovery end-to-end, including user research and interviews, journey mapping, jobs-to-be-done, pain points and opportunities, and translate research into a shared foundation for UX and product decisions

  • Create wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes hands-on using Figma and/or code to explore and test concepts during discovery, and run evaluative tests with users and engineers

  • Define the cross-application UX vision, design principles and success metrics together with Product and Marketing

  • Support and align our specialised designers - framework and embedded - around a consistent experience across modules and applications

  • Communicate UX principles and investment priorities to senior leadership, demonstrating the value and potential impact of UX-related roadmap items

  • Maintain the UX roadmap and prioritise pattern and design investments with the framework team

  • Produce high-level experience flows and service blueprints that connect journeys across applications and domains

  • Review Design System and module deliverables for alignment with experience strategy and brand

  • Support embedded designers from discovery through to delivery by co-framing problems, reviewing flows against the cross-application blueprint and ensuring continuity across user journeys

  • Set KPIs and use analytics, user research, A/B tests and competitive analysis to inform and refine design decisions

  • Promote a UX culture centred on user needs, inclusive design and accessibility standards such as WCAG across the organisation

  • Collaborate with Marketing on tone, terminology and brand consistency across products

Requirements

What You'll Bring:

  • Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Experience as a senior or lead product designer working on complex B2B software, ideally within supply chain, logistics, aviation/air cargo or pharma

  • Strong experience leading discovery, from understanding user needs through research and prototyping to defining and refining UX solutions

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, with experience creating and iterating wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes

  • Experience bringing together multiple designers, including without formal reporting lines, to create a consistent experience across products or modules

  • Ability to communicate UX strategy, priorities and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders

  • Working knowledge of design systems and accessibility standards such as WCAG; experience partnering with design system teams is an advantage

  • Experience designing for multiple user groups, such as pharma quality/logistics teams and airline cargo operations, is beneficial

If you don’t meet every requirement but bring relevant experience and skills, we’d still like to hear from you.

What's In It For You?

⚡ Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours and work-life balance allow you to tailor work to fit your life.

🌟 Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions.

🌍 Flexible ways of working: Our global teams work across our offices in Zurich, Zug, Hyderabad and Basel, with a mix of on-site, hybrid and remote working. Role-specific locations and working arrangements are detailed above.

🎉 Company-wide Events: Join us for company events to celebrate successes, build teams, and share our vision. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program.

👶 Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave.

🏖️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind.

Ready to Make an Impact?

We’re not just offering a job; we’re offering a chance to be part of something bigger. At SkyCell, you’ll help build a future where pharmaceutical delivery is efficient, sustainable, and transformative.

Stay Connected with SkyCell

Visit and explore #WeAreSkyCell on LinkedIn

How to Apply

Simply click ‘apply for this job’ below! We can’t wait to meet you and discuss how you can contribute to our mission! Please note, we are unable to consider applications sent to us via email.

If you have any questions, you can contact our Talent Team ().

SkyCell AG is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

For this position, if you are not located in, or able to relocate (without sponsorship) to one of the advertised locations, your application cannot be considered.
