raw.title: EverPro - Customer Marketing Manager - Invoicing Solutions (Remote, Canada)
raw.excerpt: EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention.
raw.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

EverPro, a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.

We’re looking for a Marketing Manager, Lifecycle & Growth to join the EverPro Marketing team, supporting Invoice Simple.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for driving lifecycle-led business impact by designing, executing, and optimizing customer engagement initiatives that support activation, retention, feature adoption, and revenue growth. You’ll operate at the intersection of Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Product Marketing, Growth, and Data—translating business priorities and customer insights into experiences that meaningfully influence customer behavior.

This role is ideal for a marketer who thinks in customer journeys, applies data to decision-making, and wants ownership over initiatives that directly impact business outcomes in a Product-Led Growth (PLG) environment.


Responsibilities

Customer Lifecycle Strategy & Experience Direction

  • Own lifecycle experience direction for assigned journeys, segments, or initiatives
  • Define which customers experiences are for, what customer need or opportunity they address, and what behavior or outcome they are intended to influence
  • Design end-to-end lifecycle experiences across email, push notifications, and in-app messaging
  • Ensure lifecycle touchpoints work in concert with product experiences to support customer success and growth

Business Impact & Growth Contribution

  • Translate business priorities into lifecycle initiatives that drive activation, retention, adoption, and monetization
  • Develop clear hypotheses for how lifecycle initiatives will contribute to business goals
  • Size expected impact directionally using assumptions, ranges, and customer economics
  • Prioritize initiatives based on potential impact, customer value, and feasibility

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Growth, Payments, and Data teams
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing Managers to ensure lifecycle messaging reflects approved positioning and customer readiness
  • Use customer insights and performance data to influence decisions and align stakeholders
  • Escalate tradeoffs or conflicts when lifecycle initiatives have broader portfolio impact

Initiative Management & Execution

  • Own execution of complex lifecycle and growth-related initiatives within assigned scope
  • Coordinate timelines, dependencies, and handoffs across Marketing and partner teams
  • Balance multiple initiatives while adapting to shifting business priorities
  • Partner with marketing automation, creative, and analytics teams to bring experiences to life

Performance Analysis, Experimentation & Optimization

  • Monitor lifecycle performance using shared measurement frameworks
  • Design and run experiments to test new approaches and optimize outcomes
  • Analyze results to identify drivers of success or underperformance
  • Translate learnings into clear recommendations for iteration and scale

Collaboration & Thought Leadership

  • Act as an informal advisor to peers on lifecycle best practices and customer engagement
  • Share insights and learnings that improve cross-team effectiveness
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of lifecycle and growth practices across Marketing

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 5–7+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, growth marketing, or customer marketing roles
  • Experience owning customer journeys tied to business outcomes, not just channel execution
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with experience using data to inform decisions
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence without direct authority
  • Experience working in B2B or B2C SaaS or Product-Led Growth (PLG) environments

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
  • Experience working with marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, or similar
  • Exposure to feature adoption, monetization, or payments-related initiatives
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Product Marketing teams
  • Comfort with directional impact modeling or customer economics

Where: Remote, Canada

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in Canada - if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.


Benefits and Perks

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Robust wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
  • 3 weeks of vacation to start, a paid volunteer day of your choosing, plus 2 floating holidays to celebrate anything of significance to you
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with 4% company match

Compensation: The target compensation range for this position is $80,000 to $100,000 CAD per year in most Canada locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!


EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

raw.title: Sr. Payroll Operations Specialist
raw.excerpt: Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work.
raw.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Sr. Payroll Operations Specialist

Remote

Role Summary

Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is seeking an experienced, organized, and collaborative Sr. Payroll Operations Specialist to support US and Canadian payroll operations within a global organization.

This role is responsible for coordinating, prioritizing, and executing payroll activities to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery. The ideal candidate understands end-to-end payroll processes, anticipates operational dependencies, and collaborates effectively with regional and global stakeholders.

The position requires hands-on payroll experience, strong operational judgment, and the ability to leverage technology, AI, and performance metrics to drive efficiency and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Payroll Operations

  • Coordinate and execute payroll activities across multiple pay groups and processing cycles, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely completion.
  • Manage payroll schedules, checklists, audits, reconciliations, and competing priorities.Sr.
  • Support complex payroll activities, including leaves of absence, international assignees, terminations, and special payments.
  • Proactively identify and resolve payroll discrepancies, operational risks, and processing delays.

Process Coordination and Collaboration

  • Provide day-to-day operational guidance and indirect leadership to Payroll Analysts by coordinating work assignments, aligning priorities, monitoring progress, and supporting timely, accurate payroll execution without direct people-management responsibility.
  • Understand upstream and downstream payroll dependencies across HR, Benefits, Leaves, Finance, and other functions.

Employee Relations Manager – W2 Consultants

Position: Employee Relations Manager – W2 Consultants
Employment Type: Full-Time
Industry: IT Staffing & Professional Services
Location: Remote / Hybrid

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly professional Employee Relations Manager – W2 Consultants to serve as the primary point of contact for our W2 consultant workforce.

This position will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with consultants throughout their employment lifecycle and ensuring that their questions, concerns, and requests are addressed promptly and professionally.

The ideal candidate will combine strong employee-relations expertise, communication skills, IT staffing knowledge, and operational judgment. This individual should be approachable and responsive while maintaining professionalism, confidentiality, and appropriate boundaries when handling sensitive employee matters.

Key Responsibilities

Employee & Consultant Relations

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for W2 consultants regarding employment-related questions, concerns, and requests.
  • Establish and maintain professional, trusted relationships with consultants throughout their employment lifecycle.
  • Provide timely communication and appropriate follow-up on consultant inquiries and concerns.
  • Listen to employee concerns, understand the underlying issue, and coordinate with the appropriate internal stakeholders to achieve resolution.
  • Handle sensitive and escalated matters with discretion, professionalism, and confidentiality.

  • Maintain accurate records of employee concerns, communications, actions taken, and resolutions.

Payroll & Employment Support

  • Coordinate with Payroll and HR regarding questions related to salary, payroll processing, timesheets, deductions, reimbursements, benefits, and employment documentation.
  • Assist consultants in understanding company processes and requirements.
  • Monitor outstanding payroll or employment-related issues and ensure appropriate follow-up through resolution.
  • Escalate complex or sensitive matters to the appropriate management or functional team.

Immigration Coordination

  • Serve as the communication liaison between consultants and the organization's Immigration/Legal team.
  • Coordinate requests and documentation related to H-1B transfers, extensions, amendments, OPT/EAD, and other employment authorization matters.
  • Ensure consultants receive timely updates regarding the status of immigration-related requests.
  • Facilitate communication and follow-up without providing independent legal or immigration advice.

Marketing, Projects & Consultant Support

  • Coordinate with Recruiting, Marketing/Bench Sales, and Account Management regarding consultant marketing status, job opportunities, submissions, interviews, project assignments, and placement activities.
  • Ensure consultants receive appropriate updates regarding their project or marketing status.
  • Assist consultants during onboarding, project transitions, client interviews, assignments, and offboarding.
  • Identify and escalate issues that may impact consultant engagement, retention, or project continuity.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Partner effectively with HR, Payroll, Immigration, Recruiting, Marketing/Bench Sales, Sales, Account Management, and senior management.
  • Take ownership of consultant issues and ensure they are routed to the appropriate department.
  • Maintain visibility into open issues and proactively follow up until resolution.
  • Identify recurring employee concerns and recommend improvements to policies, processes, and communication.
  • Develop and maintain effective communication processes between consultants and internal departments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field preferred.
  • 3–7+ years of experience in Employee Relations, HR Operations, Consultant Relations, IT Staffing, Workforce Management, or a related field.
  • Previous experience supporting W2 IT consultants within a U.S. staffing or consulting organization is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of the U.S. IT staffing and consulting environment.
  • Familiarity with H-1B, H-1B transfers, OPT/EAD, and employment authorization processes.
  • Experience coordinating with Payroll, Immigration, Recruiting, HR, and staffing operations.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-management capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive employee concerns with professionalism and discretion.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and follow-through skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple departments.

Key Competencies

  • Employee & Consultant Relationship Management
  • Conflict Resolution & Issue Management
  • Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Professional Communication
  • Problem Solving & Ownership
  • Confidentiality & Professional Judgment
  • U.S. Staffing Operations
  • Payroll & Employment Processes
  • Immigration Coordination
  • Consultant Engagement & Retention

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to provide W2 consultants with a consistent, responsive, and professional employee experience.

The Employee Relations Manager is expected to:

  • Establish strong relationships and trust with the consultant workforce.
  • Respond to consultant inquiries in a timely manner.
  • Ensure issues are appropriately assigned, tracked, and resolved.
  • Maintain clear and consistent communication throughout the resolution process.
  • Minimize recurring consultant concerns through proactive communication and process improvement.
  • Strengthen collaboration between consultants and internal departments.
  • Support overall consultant engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

The Role in One Sentence

The Employee Relations Manager will serve as the central point of contact and advocate for our W2 consultants, coordinating across HR, Payroll, Immigration, Recruiting, Marketing, and Management to ensure their employment-related needs are addressed professionally and efficiently.

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at

Position Overview

We are looking for a hands-on software engineer with strong system design skills, deep server-side engineering experience, and the curiosity to work across a complex enterprise platform. You will turn product and engineering goals into practical designs, implement critical functionality, and carry improvements through testing, deployment, and production operation.

You should enjoy understanding how components work together, exploring unfamiliar codebases, and tracing problems beyond the boundaries of a single service. The role combines broad technical judgment with the ability and motivation to go deep into implementation details.

Agentic AI development is central to how we work. We value engineers who use AI agents to expand what they can investigate and deliver, while personally understanding, reviewing, and verifying the systems they build.

Ownership and Delivery

  • Take responsibility from problem definition through implementation, production adoption, and ongoing operation.
  • Show initiative: identify gaps, gather context, propose practical solutions, and move work forward with appropriate coordination.
  • Work through ambiguity and setbacks, surface blockers early, and follow through on commitments.
  • Balance speed with quality, explain tradeoffs, and verify that the result solves the intended problem.
  • Remain accountable after release: investigate failures, incorporate feedback, and improve reliability and maintainability.
  • Share knowledge and credit, seek input from component owners, and strengthen the team's ability to deliver.

Responsibilities

  • Design across component boundaries. Translate ambiguous needs into clear designs, evaluate tradeoffs, define interfaces, and consider the effects on the wider system.
  • Build robust server-side software. Implement and improve services with appropriate correctness, performance, scalability, security, and operational visibility.
  • Investigate end to end. Follow requests, data, and failures across components; identify root causes and work with component owners to deliver lasting improvements.
  • Rapid AI-assisted prototyping. Use AI tools to quickly build working prototypes, compare approaches, and validate technical feasibility before developing promising ideas into production-quality software.
  • Move between design and code. Prototype approaches, write critical implementation code, review changes, and validate assumptions through tests and measurements.
  • Use AI agents effectively. Break work into clear tasks, supply relevant context and constraints, review generated changes, and verify behavior including failure scenarios.
  • Learn unfamiliar systems. Use code, documentation, experiments, AI tools, and collaboration to become effective across languages and codebases.
  • Evolve software thoughtfully. Improve maintainability and delivery speed while managing compatibility, rollout, and operational risk.
  • Contribute across the stack. Work with APIs, client integrations, and user interfaces when needed to deliver a complete outcome.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership. Communicate decisions, coordinate across teams, mentor peers, and help others deliver.

Required Experience

  • Substantial hands-on software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production systems and meaningful technical decisions.
  • Strong system design skills: the ability to reason about interfaces, dependencies, data flows, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability across multiple components.
  • Deep backend engineering skills in at least one relevant language (Go, Rust, Node.js/TypeScript, Java, etc), including effective debugging and performance investigation.
  • Practical understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous communication, data consistency, persistence, and failure recovery. Experience with databases, caching, cloud platforms, containers, and messaging technologies such as Kafka, NATS, or comparable systems is valuable.
  • Experience with automated testing, deployment, observability, and production troubleshooting.
  • Practical use of AI coding agents for substantial engineering work, with the ability to explain decisions, identify mistakes, and independently verify results.
  • Curiosity and demonstrated initiative to learn unfamiliar technologies and investigate beyond a single component or specialty.
  • Clear communication and effective collaboration across engineering teams.

Preferred Experience

  • Production development in Rust or Go.
  • Full-stack delivery or meaningful work with client applications, SDKs, or modern frontend frameworks.
  • Improving systems under demanding availability, latency, throughput, or cost constraints.
  • Modernizing existing software and delivering changes across multiple components or teams.
  • Event-driven systems using Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ, or comparable technologies.
  • Contact center, telecommunications, or other real-time enterprise applications.
  • AI-enabled application development involving tool integration, orchestration, or evaluations.

Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or Engineering

Pay Transparency

The pay range for this opportunity is from $179,127 to $234,100 + benefits. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary plus bonus for this position. Actual total compensation will vary and is based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and competencies.

Sponsorship & Equal Opportunity

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic.

raw.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

EverPro, a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.

We’re looking for a Marketing Manager, Lifecycle & Growth to join the EverPro Marketing team, supporting Invoice Simple.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for driving lifecycle-led business impact by designing, executing, and optimizing customer engagement initiatives that support activation, retention, feature adoption, and revenue growth. You’ll operate at the intersection of Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Product Marketing, Growth, and Data—translating business priorities and customer insights into experiences that meaningfully influence customer behavior.

This role is ideal for a marketer who thinks in customer journeys, applies data to decision-making, and wants ownership over initiatives that directly impact business outcomes in a Product-Led Growth (PLG) environment.


Responsibilities

Customer Lifecycle Strategy & Experience Direction

  • Own lifecycle experience direction for assigned journeys, segments, or initiatives
  • Define which customers experiences are for, what customer need or opportunity they address, and what behavior or outcome they are intended to influence
  • Design end-to-end lifecycle experiences across email, push notifications, and in-app messaging
  • Ensure lifecycle touchpoints work in concert with product experiences to support customer success and growth

Business Impact & Growth Contribution

  • Translate business priorities into lifecycle initiatives that drive activation, retention, adoption, and monetization
  • Develop clear hypotheses for how lifecycle initiatives will contribute to business goals
  • Size expected impact directionally using assumptions, ranges, and customer economics
  • Prioritize initiatives based on potential impact, customer value, and feasibility

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Growth, Payments, and Data teams
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing Managers to ensure lifecycle messaging reflects approved positioning and customer readiness
  • Use customer insights and performance data to influence decisions and align stakeholders
  • Escalate tradeoffs or conflicts when lifecycle initiatives have broader portfolio impact

Initiative Management & Execution

  • Own execution of complex lifecycle and growth-related initiatives within assigned scope
  • Coordinate timelines, dependencies, and handoffs across Marketing and partner teams
  • Balance multiple initiatives while adapting to shifting business priorities
  • Partner with marketing automation, creative, and analytics teams to bring experiences to life

Performance Analysis, Experimentation & Optimization

  • Monitor lifecycle performance using shared measurement frameworks
  • Design and run experiments to test new approaches and optimize outcomes
  • Analyze results to identify drivers of success or underperformance
  • Translate learnings into clear recommendations for iteration and scale

Collaboration & Thought Leadership

  • Act as an informal advisor to peers on lifecycle best practices and customer engagement
  • Share insights and learnings that improve cross-team effectiveness
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of lifecycle and growth practices across Marketing

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 5–7+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, growth marketing, or customer marketing roles
  • Experience owning customer journeys tied to business outcomes, not just channel execution
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with experience using data to inform decisions
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence without direct authority
  • Experience working in B2B or B2C SaaS or Product-Led Growth (PLG) environments

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
  • Experience working with marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, or similar
  • Exposure to feature adoption, monetization, or payments-related initiatives
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Product Marketing teams
  • Comfort with directional impact modeling or customer economics

Where: Remote, Canada

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in Canada - if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.


Benefits and Perks

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Robust wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
  • 3 weeks of vacation to start, a paid volunteer day of your choosing, plus 2 floating holidays to celebrate anything of significance to you
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with 4% company match

Compensation: The target compensation range for this position is $80,000 to $100,000 CAD per year in most Canada locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!


EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Sr. Payroll Operations Specialist

Remote

Role Summary

Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is seeking an experienced, organized, and collaborative Sr. Payroll Operations Specialist to support US and Canadian payroll operations within a global organization.

This role is responsible for coordinating, prioritizing, and executing payroll activities to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery. The ideal candidate understands end-to-end payroll processes, anticipates operational dependencies, and collaborates effectively with regional and global stakeholders.

The position requires hands-on payroll experience, strong operational judgment, and the ability to leverage technology, AI, and performance metrics to drive efficiency and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Payroll Operations

  • Coordinate and execute payroll activities across multiple pay groups and processing cycles, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely completion.
  • Manage payroll schedules, checklists, audits, reconciliations, and competing priorities.Sr.
  • Support complex payroll activities, including leaves of absence, international assignees, terminations, and special payments.
  • Proactively identify and resolve payroll discrepancies, operational risks, and processing delays.

Process Coordination and Collaboration

  • Provide day-to-day operational guidance and indirect leadership to Payroll Analysts by coordinating work assignments, aligning priorities, monitoring progress, and supporting timely, accurate payroll execution without direct people-management responsibility.
  • Understand upstream and downstream payroll dependencies across HR, Benefits, Leaves, Finance, and other functions.
  • Collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to resolve issues and improve payroll processes.
  • Partner with technical teams on system-related issues, business requirements, and user acceptance testing.

Employee Support and Continuous Improvement

  • Manage employee payroll inquiries through case management systems, ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
  • Monitor payroll KPIs, including accuracy, timeliness, exceptions, and case resolution.
  • Leverage AI, automation, and analytical tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, and operational workflows.
  • Identify recurring issues, support root cause analysis, and implement process improvements.

Compliance and Controls

  • Apply US and Canadian payroll regulations and established company policies.
  • Execute payroll controls, audits, and reconciliations while supporting SOX compliance and audit requirements.
  • Maintain accurate payroll documentation, procedures, and records.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 7+ years of progressive payroll experience supporting US and Canadian payroll operations.
  • Hands-on experience with Dayforce Payroll and Workday HCM; Dayforce Workforce Management experience preferred.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll processes, compliance requirements, and operational dependencies.
  • Experience supporting international assignees or cross-border payroll activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize complex workflows, manage competing priorities, and meet critical deadlines.
  • Experience working collaboratively within a regional payroll team in a global organization.
  • Strong analytical, Excel, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Experience with payroll audits, case management, process improvement, and performance metrics.
  • Familiarity with AI and automation tools to improve payroll efficiency and accuracy.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience; CPP, PCP, or PLP certification preferred.

Measures of Success

  • Accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery.
  • Effective prioritization and proactive resolution of operational issues.
  • Strong collaboration across regional and global teams.
  • Continuous improvement in payroll accuracy, efficiency, and employee service.
  • Consistent adherence to payroll controls and compliance requirements.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

Position: Employee Relations Manager – W2 Consultants
Employment Type: Full-Time
Industry: IT Staffing & Professional Services

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly professional Employee Relations Manager – W2 Consultants to serve as the primary point of contact for our W2 consultant workforce.

This position will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with consultants throughout their employment lifecycle and ensuring that their questions, concerns, and requests are addressed promptly and professionally.

The ideal candidate will combine strong employee-relations expertise, communication skills, IT staffing knowledge, and operational judgment. This individual should be approachable and responsive while maintaining professionalism, confidentiality, and appropriate boundaries when handling sensitive employee matters.

Key Responsibilities

Employee & Consultant Relations

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for W2 consultants regarding employment-related questions, concerns, and requests.
  • Establish and maintain professional, trusted relationships with consultants throughout their employment lifecycle.
  • Provide timely communication and appropriate follow-up on consultant inquiries and concerns.
  • Listen to employee concerns, understand the underlying issue, and coordinate with the appropriate internal stakeholders to achieve resolution.
  • Handle sensitive and escalated matters with discretion, professionalism, and confidentiality.

  • Maintain accurate records of employee concerns, communications, actions taken, and resolutions.

Payroll & Employment Support

  • Coordinate with Payroll and HR regarding questions related to salary, payroll processing, timesheets, deductions, reimbursements, benefits, and employment documentation.
  • Assist consultants in understanding company processes and requirements.
  • Monitor outstanding payroll or employment-related issues and ensure appropriate follow-up through resolution.
  • Escalate complex or sensitive matters to the appropriate management or functional team.

Immigration Coordination

  • Serve as the communication liaison between consultants and the organization's Immigration/Legal team.
  • Coordinate requests and documentation related to H-1B transfers, extensions, amendments, OPT/EAD, and other employment authorization matters.
  • Ensure consultants receive timely updates regarding the status of immigration-related requests.
  • Facilitate communication and follow-up without providing independent legal or immigration advice.

Marketing, Projects & Consultant Support

  • Coordinate with Recruiting, Marketing/Bench Sales, and Account Management regarding consultant marketing status, job opportunities, submissions, interviews, project assignments, and placement activities.
  • Ensure consultants receive appropriate updates regarding their project or marketing status.
  • Assist consultants during onboarding, project transitions, client interviews, assignments, and offboarding.
  • Identify and escalate issues that may impact consultant engagement, retention, or project continuity.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Partner effectively with HR, Payroll, Immigration, Recruiting, Marketing/Bench Sales, Sales, Account Management, and senior management.
  • Take ownership of consultant issues and ensure they are routed to the appropriate department.
  • Maintain visibility into open issues and proactively follow up until resolution.
  • Identify recurring employee concerns and recommend improvements to policies, processes, and communication.
  • Develop and maintain effective communication processes between consultants and internal departments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field preferred.
  • 3–7+ years of experience in Employee Relations, HR Operations, Consultant Relations, IT Staffing, Workforce Management, or a related field.
  • Previous experience supporting W2 IT consultants within a U.S. staffing or consulting organization is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of the U.S. IT staffing and consulting environment.
  • Familiarity with H-1B, H-1B transfers, OPT/EAD, and employment authorization processes.
  • Experience coordinating with Payroll, Immigration, Recruiting, HR, and staffing operations.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-management capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive employee concerns with professionalism and discretion.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and follow-through skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple departments.

Key Competencies

  • Employee & Consultant Relationship Management
  • Conflict Resolution & Issue Management
  • Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Professional Communication
  • Problem Solving & Ownership
  • Confidentiality & Professional Judgment
  • U.S. Staffing Operations
  • Payroll & Employment Processes
  • Immigration Coordination
  • Consultant Engagement & Retention

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to provide W2 consultants with a consistent, responsive, and professional employee experience.

The Employee Relations Manager is expected to:

  • Establish strong relationships and trust with the consultant workforce.
  • Respond to consultant inquiries in a timely manner.
  • Ensure issues are appropriately assigned, tracked, and resolved.
  • Maintain clear and consistent communication throughout the resolution process.
  • Minimize recurring consultant concerns through proactive communication and process improvement.
  • Strengthen collaboration between consultants and internal departments.
  • Support overall consultant engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

The Role in One Sentence

The Employee Relations Manager will serve as the central point of contact and advocate for our W2 consultants, coordinating across HR, Payroll, Immigration, Recruiting, Marketing, and Management to ensure their employment-related needs are addressed professionally and efficiently.

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

raw.description:
About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at

Position Overview

We are looking for a hands-on software engineer with strong system design skills, deep server-side engineering experience, and the curiosity to work across a complex enterprise platform. You will turn product and engineering goals into practical designs, implement critical functionality, and carry improvements through testing, deployment, and production operation.

You should enjoy understanding how components work together, exploring unfamiliar codebases, and tracing problems beyond the boundaries of a single service. The role combines broad technical judgment with the ability and motivation to go deep into implementation details.

Agentic AI development is central to how we work. We value engineers who use AI agents to expand what they can investigate and deliver, while personally understanding, reviewing, and verifying the systems they build.

Ownership and Delivery

  • Take responsibility from problem definition through implementation, production adoption, and ongoing operation.
  • Show initiative: identify gaps, gather context, propose practical solutions, and move work forward with appropriate coordination.
  • Work through ambiguity and setbacks, surface blockers early, and follow through on commitments.
  • Balance speed with quality, explain tradeoffs, and verify that the result solves the intended problem.
  • Remain accountable after release: investigate failures, incorporate feedback, and improve reliability and maintainability.
  • Share knowledge and credit, seek input from component owners, and strengthen the team's ability to deliver.

Responsibilities

  • Design across component boundaries. Translate ambiguous needs into clear designs, evaluate tradeoffs, define interfaces, and consider the effects on the wider system.
  • Build robust server-side software. Implement and improve services with appropriate correctness, performance, scalability, security, and operational visibility.
  • Investigate end to end. Follow requests, data, and failures across components; identify root causes and work with component owners to deliver lasting improvements.
  • Rapid AI-assisted prototyping. Use AI tools to quickly build working prototypes, compare approaches, and validate technical feasibility before developing promising ideas into production-quality software.
  • Move between design and code. Prototype approaches, write critical implementation code, review changes, and validate assumptions through tests and measurements.
  • Use AI agents effectively. Break work into clear tasks, supply relevant context and constraints, review generated changes, and verify behavior including failure scenarios.
  • Learn unfamiliar systems. Use code, documentation, experiments, AI tools, and collaboration to become effective across languages and codebases.
  • Evolve software thoughtfully. Improve maintainability and delivery speed while managing compatibility, rollout, and operational risk.
  • Contribute across the stack. Work with APIs, client integrations, and user interfaces when needed to deliver a complete outcome.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership. Communicate decisions, coordinate across teams, mentor peers, and help others deliver.

Required Experience

  • Substantial hands-on software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production systems and meaningful technical decisions.
  • Strong system design skills: the ability to reason about interfaces, dependencies, data flows, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability across multiple components.
  • Deep backend engineering skills in at least one relevant language (Go, Rust, Node.js/TypeScript, Java, etc), including effective debugging and performance investigation.
  • Practical understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous communication, data consistency, persistence, and failure recovery. Experience with databases, caching, cloud platforms, containers, and messaging technologies such as Kafka, NATS, or comparable systems is valuable.
  • Experience with automated testing, deployment, observability, and production troubleshooting.
  • Practical use of AI coding agents for substantial engineering work, with the ability to explain decisions, identify mistakes, and independently verify results.
  • Curiosity and demonstrated initiative to learn unfamiliar technologies and investigate beyond a single component or specialty.
  • Clear communication and effective collaboration across engineering teams.

Preferred Experience

  • Production development in Rust or Go.
  • Full-stack delivery or meaningful work with client applications, SDKs, or modern frontend frameworks.
  • Improving systems under demanding availability, latency, throughput, or cost constraints.
  • Modernizing existing software and delivering changes across multiple components or teams.
  • Event-driven systems using Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ, or comparable technologies.
  • Contact center, telecommunications, or other real-time enterprise applications.
  • AI-enabled application development involving tool integration, orchestration, or evaluations.

Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or Engineering

Pay Transparency

The pay range for this opportunity is from $179,127 to $234,100 + benefits. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary plus bonus for this position. Actual total compensation will vary and is based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and competencies.

Sponsorship & Equal Opportunity

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic.

In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location. raw.excerpt: Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software.
raw.description:
Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work. Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless. That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses.

About the role

At Airtable, we are passionate about how our product democratizes software creation and empowers teams to build applications that connect their organization and drive outcomes, no code needed. As a Customer Success Manager, you will be the post-sales owner for a portfolio of enterprise customers, guiding them from onboarding through renewal as they adopt Airtable and our AI capabilities. You will help customers turn AI adoption and workflow innovation into measurable business outcomes, and you will partner closely with Account Executives so they can focus on growth.

Customer Success at Airtable sits at the nexus of our Sales, Product and Marketing teams. We hire Customer Success Managers into one of two teams (Scaled and High Touch), depending on your experience and where our team needs you most. We will talk with you about which team is the best fit during the interview process.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the post-sales point of contact for your accounts, guiding customers to the right answer or the right Airtable team when you cannot resolve something yourself
  • Drive onboarding excellence, working with customers on a mutual plan so their primary workflows launch within 90 days, with governance and best practices in place from the start
  • Build joint success plans with customers focused on AI adoption, business outcomes and operational efficiency
  • Lead Executive Business Reviews and data-driven value reviews that document ROI, surface risk and identify growth
  • Develop champions across existing users so each account has multiple advocates who can sustain adoption
  • Deliver enablement that accelerates adoption: Airtable 101, feature-specific sessions, AI and MCP workshops, and hands-on build sessions
  • Guide governance conversations, including license deployment, long-term app strategy and stakeholder orchestration
  • Run workflow consultations for new use cases and determine the right build path
  • Monitor account health, adoption trends and risk signals, and flag risk early to your Account Executive and the Renewals team
  • Qualify expansion opportunities and hand them to your Account Executive with context
  • Maintain a current account record: use cases, success stories, ROI and a stakeholder map, refreshed quarterly
  • Serve as the voice of the customer internally, translating usage and feedback into insights that shape our product and AI roadmap, and partner with Marketing and Product on customer stories
  • Develop reusable frameworks, AI-enabled health insights and playbooks that scale customer impact across the enterprise segment

Who you are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in enterprise customer success, account management, solutions consulting or technical account management supporting B2B SaaS or workflow automation platforms
  • You have a track record of delivering measurable results for customers through onboarding, adoption, retention and expansion
  • You have owned relationships with multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts and are comfortable being the customer's primary contact
  • You have technical fluency and can guide both business and technical audiences. You are comfortable discussing workflow automation, integrations and data, and you have a working understanding of AI and how customers apply it to real workflows
  • You are a teacher at heart, able to distill technical or intricate systems into clear, actionable guidance, with strong facilitation, storytelling and presentation skills
  • You are skilled at building success plans, running business reviews and mapping platform capabilities to customer outcomes
  • You are organized and detail-oriented, and can prioritize across a large portfolio without losing sight of the "why" behind the "what"
  • You partner well with Sales and are at ease working alongside Account Executives, Renewals, Support and Services on a shared account
  • You are a team player and a self-starter who can operate in a motion that is still being refined

Nice to have

  • Experience with no-code or low-code platforms, workflow automation tools or AI-driven SaaS products
  • Background in management consulting, product management or solution architecture within enterprise technology
  • Experience designing AI-powered workflows or using LLMs to improve customer operations
  • Familiarity with data visualization and analytics tools for quantifying customer value
  • Understanding of enterprise governance, change management and security frameworks relevant to SaaS adoption

raw.description:
AIR is seeking a Research Associate with experience in education research and interest in the application of emerging educational technologies. This position will support a growing portfolio of research, including projects focused on understanding the role AI technologies play in educational opportunities, teaching practices, and student outcomes. The ideal candidate will bring excitement for continuing to develop skills in research and evaluation, and communicating about the work in creative ways. The position will contribute to multiple projects, with a particular emphasis on quantitative and qualitative data collection, processing, basic analysis, and interpretation and dissemination of findings. We seek a collaborative and intellectually curious professional who is excited to contribute to rigorous, actionable research that explores emerging opportunities and challenges in education.

This position has the flexibility to work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of AIR’s U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

Responsibilities:

The responsibilities for the position include:

  • Prepare and assist with primary source data collection including through interviews, focus groups, surveys, usage data from educational technology applications, school administrative records, and publicly available data.

Reporting to the Director of Customer Success, the CSM plays a key role in helping customers achieve their goals by driving product adoption, minimizing implementation risks, and identifying opportunities for growth. Why you’ll love this role:

You’ll love this role because it puts you at the heart of meaningful customer relationships, where you’ll serve as the trusted advisor and main point of contact for a portfolio of community-focused clients. From onboarding to ongoing engagement, you’ll guide customers through their journey, helping them achieve real outcomes with SWIVEL’s schools product. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, influence product adoption, and play a key role in reducing implementation risks. This position will have opportunity to grow further into communities. If you’re passionate about building strong partnerships, solving problems proactively, and making a tangible impact on both customer success and business growth, this role offers the perfect blend of purpose, challenge, and opportunity.

Essential duties include the following:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day customer needs, building strong, trust-based relationships with school and district stakeholders.

  • Navigate ambiguity with confidence by identifying gaps and implementing solutions that improve customer experience and internal efficiency.
  • Collaborate across teams to establish clear handoffs, develop partner engagement models, and design strategies that empower districts.
  • Champion digital transformation in education by helping schools adopt technology that streamlines payments and enhances operational efficiency.

raw.title: AUS - Customer Success Manager
raw.excerpt: About AutoRABITAutoRABIT helps organizations, particularly those in highly regulated industries, modernize and secure how they develop, release, and manage change across Salesforce environments.
raw.description:
About AutoRABIT

AutoRABIT helps organizations, particularly those in highly regulated industries, modernize and secure how they develop, release, and manage change across Salesforce environments. Our platform helps teams improve release velocity, strengthen security and governance, reduce manual processes, and build more reliable software delivery practices.

The Role

As a Customer Success Manager, you will own a portfolio of strategic, enterprise, and technically complex customers. This is a highly technical Customer Success role working with Salesforce, DevOps, Engineering, Platform, Security, and executive stakeholders to understand each customer's development lifecycle, deployment processes, technical environment, and business objectives.

CSMs are expected to operate as trusted technical and strategic advisors. You should be comfortable discussing Salesforce DevOps, CI/CD, source control, release management, testing, security, governance, and software delivery practices, while connecting those topics to measurable customer outcomes. You are not expected to replace a Solutions Engineer or Salesforce Architect, but you should have enough technical depth to independently lead discovery, identify risks and opportunities, challenge customers when appropriate, and engage specialized resources when needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of strategic and technically complex customers, with accountability for adoption, customer health, value realization, renewal readiness, and growth.
  • Build trusted relationships with Salesforce administrators, developers, architects, DevOps leaders, platform owners, engineering leaders, and executive sponsors.
  • Develop a strong understanding of each customer's Salesforce development lifecycle, including source control, environments, testing, release management, deployments, and governance.
  • Assess customer DevOps practices and identify technical barriers, process gaps, adoption challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Lead technical and strategic discovery to understand how customers operate, where friction exists, and what outcomes they are trying to achieve.
  • Apply knowledge of Salesforce DevOps and software delivery best practices to help customers improve adoption and realize measurable value.
  • Create success plans with clear business and technical objectives, milestones, adoption goals, and success measures.
  • Proactively identify customer risk, diagnose root causes, and lead recovery plans across technical and business stakeholders.
  • Coordinate resources across Solutions Engineering, Support, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, Sales, Renewals, and leadership to resolve complex customer challenges.
  • Guide customers through major technical milestones, including implementations, upgrades, new capabilities, process changes, and evolving Salesforce environments.
  • Identify opportunities to expand AutoRABIT's value based on customer use cases, technical maturity, and business objectives.
  • Bring customer insights, technical patterns, and product feedback back to Product and Engineering.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of modern DevOps principles, CI/CD practices, and the software development lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce development and deployment concepts, including metadata, environments, testing, dependencies, release management, and common deployment challenges.
  • Strong working knowledge of Git and source control concepts, including branches, commits, merges, pull requests, and repositories.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, release automation, APIs, testing, security, and governance.
  • Ability to understand technical architectures and customer workflows, identify areas of risk or friction, and recommend appropriate next steps.
  • Ability to independently conduct technical discovery and move beyond surface-level requirements to uncover root causes.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes for executive and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with engineering performance concepts and metrics, including DORA metrics.
  • Strong executive presence, communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience across Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Salesforce consulting, Professional Services, DevOps, or other customer-facing enterprise technology roles.
  • 2+ years supporting technically complex enterprise customers in developer tools, DevOps, Salesforce, cloud platforms, or similar enterprise software.
  • Demonstrated experience working with senior technical stakeholders across Engineering, DevOps, Salesforce, IT, or CTO organizations.
  • Strong technical background with Salesforce development, Salesforce DevOps, CI/CD, release management, or comparable software delivery processes.
  • Experience managing complex enterprise accounts, customer risk, technical initiatives, and cross-functional account teams.
  • Experience supporting Fortune 500 or similarly complex organizations preferred.
  • Experience within Financial Services, Healthcare, Government, or other regulated industries preferred.

What Success Looks Like

Successful CSMs understand not only whether customers are using AutoRABIT, but how they build and deliver software on Salesforce, where technical and operational friction exists, and how AutoRABIT can help improve those processes. They can independently engage with technical practitioners and leaders, ask informed questions, identify risks and opportunities, and connect improvements in DevOps practices to measurable business and engineering outcomes.

Additional Information

This role is fully remote and is open to candidates based in Australia with Australian work eligibility.

This role is fully remote with 10% travel required.

Salary Range: $115,000 - $130,000 AUD per year, depending on experience.

This job description is intended to provide a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the position. Responsibilities and requirements may evolve based on the needs of the business.

raw.title: Engineering Manager – Backend - Remote
raw.excerpt: Jitterbit is a recognized leader in Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) and API Management, named in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for seven consecutive years.
raw.description:
Jitterbit is a recognized leader in Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) and API Management, named in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for seven consecutive years. Our mission is to simplify and accelerate digital transformation through our low-code iPaaS, API Management (APIM), Low-Code Application Platform (LCAP), and B2B solutions.

Our platform helps businesses automate mission-critical systems quickly and effectively. To do this, we continuously build and evolve a robust, scalable, secure, and highly reliable SaaS platform serving customers around the world.

We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who combines strong people leadership, execution discipline, and technical depth. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building high-performing distributed teams while remaining close enough to the technology to guide architecture, troubleshoot complex problems, and help the team make sound engineering decisions.

About the Team

At Jitterbit, engineering is at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in building high- quality, maintainable software and delivering a world-class experience for our customers.

Our engineering organization operates in a collaborative, remote-first environment with team members across multiple countries and time zones. You will work closely with engineers, Product Management, Support, L3 Engineering, DevOps/SRE, QA, and other engineering teams to build and operate enterprise-grade integration and API management capabilities.

We value ownership, transparency, technical excellence, continuous improvement, and a willingness to solve problems collaboratively.

About the Role

As a Senior Engineering Manager – Backend, you will lead a distributed team of backend engineers responsible for designing, building, operating, and evolving critical components of Jitterbit's iPaaS and API Management platform.

You will be accountable for both people leadership and engineering delivery. You will establish clear priorities, help the team execute predictably, develop engineering talent, remove obstacles, and create an environment in which engineers can do their best work.

You will partner closely with Product Management and other stakeholders to translate business priorities into executable engineering plans while balancing product delivery with platform scalability, reliability, technical debt, and operational excellence.

This is not a purely administrative management position. You should be technically strong enough to participate in architecture and design discussions, challenge technical assumptions, review approaches, and dive deeply into complex production or engineering problems when necessary. When critical situations arise, you are comfortable rolling up your sleeves and working alongside the team to drive them to resolution.

Our technology environment includes:

  • Languages & Frameworks: Java, Spring Boot, C++, Lua

  • Infrastructure & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Nginx, Tomcat, Apache

  • Data & Messaging: MySQL, SQL Server, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch, InfluxDB

  • Cloud Services: AWS, including S3, CloudFront, DynamoDB, and related services

    What You'll Do

    Lead and Develop the Team

  • Lead, coach, and mentor a geographically distributed engineering team across multiple countries and time zones.

  • Build a high-performing engineering culture based on ownership, accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, provide actionable feedback, establish development goals, and support engineers in their career growth.

  • Manage performance effectively, recognizing strong contributors while addressing performance gaps in a timely and constructive manner.

  • Participate in workforce planning, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and retaining high- quality engineering talent.

  • Identify future technical and team leaders and create opportunities for them to grow.

  • Foster an inclusive environment where team members are comfortable sharing ideas,

    raising risks, and challenging assumptions.

    Drive Engineering Execution

  • Own the planning and execution of engineering initiatives from requirements and technical design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.

  • Partner with Product Management to understand business priorities, define scope, evaluate trade-offs, and establish realistic delivery commitments.

  • Lead Agile ceremonies and ensure effective sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily execution, reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement.

  • Maintain visibility into sprint progress, dependencies, blockers, risks, and delivery commitments.

  • Use engineering metrics and data to improve delivery predictability, quality, operational performance, and team effectiveness.

  • Balance feature development with technical debt, platform improvements, scalability, reliability, and engineering productivity.

  • Identify delivery risks early and communicate clearly with stakeholders when priorities, scope, or timelines need adjustment.

    Provide Technical Leadership

  • Maintain sufficient technical depth to have meaningful conversations with senior engineers and architects about system design, architecture, scalability, reliability, security, and performance.

  • Guide technical discussions and help the team evaluate architectural approaches and engineering trade-offs.

  • Ensure appropriate engineering practices around design reviews, code quality, automated testing, observability, deployment, and operational readiness.

  • Encourage solutions that are maintainable, scalable, secure, and appropriate for a large- scale multi-tenant SaaS environment.

  • Partner with senior engineers and architects on technical strategy and long-term platform evolution.

  • Dive into complex technical issues when necessary and work alongside engineers during critical production or customer-impacting problems.

  • Help drive root-cause analysis and ensure corrective and preventive actions are completed following significant incidents.

    Collaborate Across the Organization

  • Build strong working relationships with Product Management, Support, L3 Engineering, QA, DevOps/SRE, Architecture, Security, and other engineering teams.

  • Partner closely with Support and L3 teams to understand customer-impacting issues, prioritize escalations, and ensure timely resolution.

  • Coordinate dependencies and technical initiatives that span multiple engineering teams.

  • Clearly communicate engineering priorities, technical risks, delivery status, and trade-

    offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Represent the team in cross-functional planning, operational reviews, and leadership

    discussions.

  • Create effective feedback loops between Engineering, Product, Support, and customers

    to continuously improve product quality and reliability.

    Own Operational Excellence

  • Help ensure the platform meets the reliability, availability, scalability, and performance expectations of a 24x7x365 enterprise SaaS environment.

  • Establish strong ownership of production services within the engineering team.

  • Partner with operations and engineering teams on monitoring, observability, incident

    response, capacity planning, and production readiness.

  • Drive continuous improvements based on production incidents, customer escalations,

    operational metrics, and engineering retrospectives.

Job Description Summary

GE Aerospace is developing a forward-looking AI workforce strategy ensuring the organization is prepared for how work, roles, and skills will evolve in the age of artificial intelligence. With a passion for amplifying what our people do best, unlocking new and higher-value work, and growing the human capabilities that will define the next era of aerospace, GE has created the AI workforce strategy function sitting at the intersection of the CHRO and the Chief Data & AI Officer.

Reporting to the Executive Director, AI Workforce Strategy & Capability, the Leader, AI Workforce Capability will lead the enterprise in enabling employees to build the skills needed to succeed in an AI-enabled workplace. This role focuses on designing learning strategies, capability frameworks, and career development pathways that prepare the workforce to effectively use artificial intelligence and emerging technologies. Working across Human Resources, all lines of business, Learning & Development, and technology teams, this leader develops scalable programs that strengthen AI literacy, support workforce
reskilling, and align employee development with evolving business needs. The role also leads enterprise employee experience and adoption for AI, shaping how the organization prepares its workforce for new ways of working where human expertise and AI tools operate together. Additionally this leader owns the AI capability building for the Digital Technology organization, as a critical enabler of the enterprise AI strategy

Job Description

Owns the Employee AI Capability Supply Forecast

  • Synthesizes and builds the AI capability forecast based on the intelligence for skills, proficiencies and AI fluency of the
  • workforce
  • Projects the delta between AI capability supply the demand future of work will create
  • Establish the enterprise AI fluency standard — the proficiency levels, what each requires of a person by job type and
  • leadership level

Drives AI Workforce Capability Building

  • Leverages workforce intelligence, AI adoption signals and future of work projections to create targeted AI upskilling
  • strategies
  • Own the design, curation, and scaling of AI learning across the enterprise, including role-based learning journeys,
  • academies, immersive experiences, synchronous learning, JIT on-demand instruction, and community engagement
  • Designs and executes adjacent and prerequisite skill/capability building
  • Elevates the engagement, effectiveness and digital enablement of AI learning via dynamic hyper-personalization
  • Build elevated AI capability in specific departments serving the workforce across enterprise, including Digital Technology and Human Resources

Leads AI change management and adoption

  • Lead enterprise AI change management and adoption as one strategy across channels, tracking progress against intended trajectories, caring for change impacts, with defined measurement, analytics, and tracking of how adoption has taken hold.
  • Develop and steward the AI capability investment for the enterprise, and own the recommendations on investment prioritization, resource allocation, vendor engagement, scale-up decisions, and value measurement.
  • Lead and develop the team, direct contracted and partner capacity against the enterprise plan, and represent GE Aerospace in the enterprise and industry forums where AI capability practice is being set.

Preferred work location is Evendale, OH, however, remote employment will also be considered. Ability and willingness to travel at least 25%.

Qualifications / Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, organizational psychology, talent development, education, business, technology
  • or a related discipline.
  • Preferred: Advanced degree in organizational psychology, learning sciences, education or business administration.

  • adoption, including accountability for whether a capability was actually built.

  • Experience leading the transformation of a learning or capability practice,
  • Experience leading a team, including hiring and developing senior professionals and directing partner or contract capacity.
  • Experience defining a capability standard, competency architecture or skill model adopted enterprise-wide.
  • Experience developing and stewarding the investment for a capability area, including vendor engagement and scale-up decisions.
  • Experience leading enterprise change management and adoption with defined measurement.
  • Experience building capability for technical or engineering populations.
  • Experience with skills-based talent models, capability frameworks and job architecture.
  • Experience in a large, complex, global and regulated organization
  • Experience with personalized learning experience platforms
  • Experience applying talent intelligence and data based decision-making
  • Deep expertise with measurement strategies, ROI and demonstrating impact.

The base pay range for this position is 200,000 - 300,000 annually. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors,including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a

percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. You are equity eligible. This posting is expected to close on December 10, 2026
