PAINPOINT: Client needs a seasoned structural engineer to assist with a modular building project for a site in Lae, Papua New Guinea. He has a complete 3D Revit model and needs the structural calculations and checks done (spans, rafters, beams, overall stability)
TOOLS EXPERTISE REQUIREMENT : Revit, analysis software for example ETABS, SPACE GASS, STAAD or SAP2000 (Tools Revit and analysis software licenses to be provided by the client)
Key responsibilities
  • Perform structural calculations for the modular building, including loads, spans, rafters, beams, connections and overall stability.
  • Review the existing 3D Revit model and drawings, and confirm the structure is sound against Australian standards.
  • Assess site requirements (wind region, soil and ground conditions, site category) from the information the client provides, and calculate accordingly.
  • Prepare clear calculation packages, mark-ups and design notes that the client's RPEQ can review and certify efficiently.
  • Flag gaps, risks and missing information early, and propose solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Respond to RPEQ review comments and update calculations and drawings.
  • Keep the client updated with regular progress reports and clear written communication.
Note: The site is in Lae, Papua New Guinea

Must-have requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering, and a current Philippine PRC engineering license. Must be licensed and registered to sign off on all engineering calculations.
  • At least 10 years of structural engineering experience (20 years preferred).
  • Proven leader who takes initiative, thinks independently and drives work to completion without hand-holding.
  • Demonstrated experience working fully remotely, delivering without close supervision.
  • Hands-on experience with Australian or equivalent standards for loads, steel, concrete and timber. Australian standards used on this project include AS/NZS 1170 (actions and wind), AS 4100 (steel), AS 3600 (concrete) and AS 1720 (timber).
  • Strong working knowledge of Revit and structural analysis software (for example ETABS, SPACE GASS, STAAD or SAP2000).
  • Experience with modular, light-steel or timber-framed buildings.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with clear, concise reporting.
  • Professional affiliations (Philippines): active membership in one or more of the following is a plus.
  • Professional Regulation Commission (PRC): valid engineering license (required, listed
above for reference)
  • Association of Structural Engineers of the Philippines (ASEP)
  • Philippine Institute of Civil Engineers (PICE)
  • ASEAN Chartered Professional Engineer (ACPE) register, if held
  • Membership body for engineers in Australia is preferred

Preferred
  • International project experience outside the Philippines, such as Papua New Guinea, Australia or New Zealand.
  • Experience designing to the Australian National Construction Code (NCC) and in cyclonic or high-wind regions.
  • Experience in a design-and-build, prefabrication or offsite construction environment.
  • Registration or progress toward Engineers Australia (CPEng/NER) or RPEQ. This is an advantage, because sign-off stays with the client's RPEQ.

Marketing and Communications Manager

Location: Remote, US Based, EST
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

Over the past year, Underscore has built the foundation for a stronger marketing and new business engine, including a refreshed brand and positioning, a redesigned website, a defined ideal client profile, HubSpot infrastructure, an earned media program, and a growing portfolio of events and experiences designed to connect us with leaders across biopharma.

Now we’re looking for a Marketing and Communications Manager who can execute on that foundation to deliver a consistent, high-performing marketing and communications program.

The Marketing and Communications Manager will own the day-to-day execution of Underscore’s efforts across content, thought leadership, case studies, digital marketing, events, PR, sales enablement, and internal communications. This person will work closely with our leadership, subject matter experts, Sales Enablement, and external marketing and PR partners to make sure great ideas become great content and, ultimately, business opportunities.

This role will also help shape experiences. This includes our Rare Company Dinner series, which will be held at least four times in 2027. The manager will work on invitations, follow-ups, venue management, and ensuring we deliver premium, valuable experiences for senior leaders in biopharma.

Internally, this person will help lead the communications that keep our people informed, connected, and engaged. This includes managing our monthly Town Halls and maintaining our online communication hub.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable developing a content calendar, interviewing a media expert for a case study, building a HubSpot campaign, preparing a Town Hall, supporting an industry event, and looking at performance data to determine what we should do next.

What You’ll Do

Content & Thought Leadership

  • Own and execute Underscore’s editorial calendar across the website, LinkedIn, email, and other marketing channels.
  • Develop and manage the Rare Company newsletter, creating relevant and compelling content for biopharma leaders and prospective clients. The source of this information will be Underscore’s subject matter experts. The Marketing and Communications Manager will shape the story and language.
  • Turn the expertise that already exists across Underscore into compelling content, including conference takeaways, partner insights, industry perspectives, media and analytics thought leadership, and emerging trends.
  • Maintain Underscore’s voice and strengthen our position in the healthcare and biopharma marketplace.
  • Keep the Underscore website current with new team members, company news, events, awards, thought leadership, and other relevant updates.
  • Route leads that come through the site for our Rare Company Dinners, as well as general leads, to the right resources for follow-up. The approach and executional requirements will be outlined in our 2027 plan.

Internal Communications & Company Meetings

  • Own the planning and execution of Underscore’s monthly Town Halls, partnering with leadership to shape agendas, gather content, coordinate presentations and speakers, and ensure employees hear the information that matters most.
  • Partner with leaders across the company to translate company updates, milestones, and organizational news into communications that are clear, engaging, and relevant to employees.
  • Help create a consistent internal communications cadence so employees understand what is happening across Underscore, where the company is going, and how their work connects to it.
  • Bring the same storytelling, clarity, and attention to Underscore’s internal communications that we bring to our external brand.

Case Studies & Credentials

  • Build and maintain a strong library of Underscore case studies, with a goal of developing approximately two new case studies per quarter.
  • Partner with account leads, media teams, analytics, and other subject matter experts to identify compelling stories and results.
  • Own the case study process from beginning to end, including interviews, results gathering, writing, internal review, client approval, publishing, and inclusion in the sales library.
  • Navigate client confidentiality and healthcare industry requirements to develop compelling blinded case studies when necessary.
  • Ensure our capabilities decks, credentials, team bios, case studies, RFP content, and other sales materials remain current and easy to access.

HubSpot & Sales Enablement

  • Serve as a day-to-day marketing partner to Sales Enablement and the broader growth team.
  • Support marketing activity within HubSpot, including getting content to fuel custom messages designed to engage the client and get a conversation going.
  • Deliver tailored communications and content strategies for different prospect audiences and stages of the new business journey. This will be structured by audience so we can test and learn what works and what doesn’t.
  • Maintain a consistent cadence for timely lead follow-up following conferences, events, campaigns, and other business development activities. These standards will be agreed upon as part of our 2027 plan.
  • Participate in the preparation of monthly reporting that gives leadership visibility into pipeline sources, campaign performance, content engagement, and marketing effectiveness.

PR & Awards

  • Support Underscore’s external PR agency by providing company information, executive bios, subject matter expertise, quotes, images, approvals, and other materials needed to support earned media.
  • Own the annual awards calendar and coordinate submissions from initial opportunity through final deadline.
  • Help execute and continuously improve the playbook for major industry moments such as Fierce Pharma Week.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 4–6 years of B2B marketing agency experience, ideally with at least three years working in or with healthcare, biopharma, pharmaceutical companies, or healthcare agencies.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills. You can interview a subject matter expert and turn the conversation into content that a senior biopharma marketer would genuinely want to read.
  • Strong understanding of HubSpot, including best practices for relationship management.
  • Demonstrated experience owning and consistently executing against an editorial or content calendar.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to move multiple initiatives from idea to execution without losing momentum.
  • Comfortable working directly with senior leaders and subject matter experts to turn their expertise into accessible, differentiated content.
  • A strong sense of ownership and follow-through. You see something that needs to get done and know how to move it forward.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills required.

Preferred

  • Internal communications experience is a plus.
  • Agency experience, particularly within media, digital marketing, healthcare communications, or a related environment.
  • Experience developing pharmaceutical or healthcare case studies and navigating client legal, regulatory, or confidentiality requirements.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, success in this role will mean:

  • Underscore has a consistent editorial calendar that is being executed across channels.
  • The Rare Company newsletter has become a recognizable and valuable communication for our target audience.
  • New case studies are being developed and added to our credentials library each quarter.
  • Leads from events, campaigns, and other marketing activity have clear ownership and timely follow-up.
  • The website and sales enablement materials remain current rather than being updated reactively.
  • Strong ideas and insights from across Underscore are consistently turned into useful, market-facing content.
  • Leadership has clear monthly visibility into marketing activity, engagement, lead sources, and pipeline contribution.
  • Monthly Town Halls are thoughtfully planned and executed, with clear, relevant content that helps employees understand what is happening across the company.

Who Will Thrive Here

You’re a doer.

You like taking something from idea to finished product. You know how to pull a good story out of people who may not think of themselves as storytellers. You care about the quality of the writing, but you also care whether someone opened it, responded to it, understood it, or wanted to have a conversation because of it.

You understand that good communication matters on both sides of the company. You can help tell Underscore’s story to the market while also helping our people understand where we’re going, what matters, and how they are part of it.

You’re comfortable working in an environment where there are plenty of ideas and opportunities, and part of your value is bringing the structure, discipline, and follow-through that turns those ideas into a real marketing and communications program.

At Underscore, you’ll have access to deep expertise across media, analytics, strategy, and healthcare. Your job is to help make sure both our people and the market see it.

Interested?
Apply by submitting your resume and a brief note outlining your healthcare or media experience.

 Underscore Marketing is a woman-owned, independent agency specializing in life sciences. Since 2002, we've helped clients gain a competitive edge through bold, data-driven promotional strategies that deliver measurable results.  

Our team comprises media, strategy, and omnichannel analytics experts who thrive on collaboration, innovation, and results. When you join Underscore, you become part of a dynamic environment where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work helps elevate brands in a competitive healthcare landscape.  

If you're passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a team that values integrity, creativity, and results, if that sounds like you, we invite you to share.  

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement 
Underscore is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We believe that diversity drives innovation and success, and we welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

raw.description:
Our engineering team at Space Inch is growing! We are looking for talented engineers to join the company, and help drive our technical initiatives forward. Following a string of successful hires, we’re again expanding our engineering team.

We’re currently looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to contribute to one of our longest-running and most successful projects. You’ll be part of an established Space Inch engineering team while also collaborating closely with our client’s team - a major global FinTech corporation in the field of investment management with multiple long-term initiatives underway.

For this position, we're looking primarily for a Vue.js/Python expert to drive one of clients' workstreams but also someone who views programming languages as tools and is excited about leveraging modern AI workflows to build impactful solutions.

Our Mission, Vision, and Values

At Space Inch, we prioritize alignment with our clients and team, ensuring a deep understanding of their needs. We are committed to delivering exceptional work while supporting the personal and professional growth of our team members.

About Working at Space Inch

  • Global Footprint: Our team is around 80 people, primarily based in Croatia, but also with members in South America, the EU, and the US; the product team mostly being in the US, and engineering in Croatia and Brazil
  • Remote-First: We are remote-first, but occasional travel may be required, e.g. for our annual company retreat, or meeting the client
  • Long-Term Vision: We work on end-to-end projects with a long-term vision
  • True Work-Life Balance: We strongly support work-life balance for our team members, even though we work in different time zones

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in Vue.js and Python: these are the core technologies involved in the workstream but we also value your ability to adapt to new stacks if needed in the future and collaborate with the team to ship value
  • AI-Augmented Workflow: Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, etc.) as a natural part of your workflow, to accelerate development, learn new stacks quickly, and automate routine tasks
  • Ownership mindset: Capable of owning own workstream, making sure that the associated development work is "in the green" while keeping an eye open for any potential upgrades that would address client's outstanding needs
  • Communication: Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken; proactive in communicating with all involved stakeholders on the client side and internally at Space Inch
  • Adaptability: Ability to broaden or shift technical focus to meet evolving project goals - whether front-end, back-end, or new technologies
  • Must be based in Brazil
  • Must be available for daily overlap of 5-6 working hours with PST

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with clients and business stakeholders to deeply understand and clarify business needs and translate them into technical solutions
  • Navigate the entire product lifecycle as a full-stack engineer: from requirements gathering, scoping, and planning, through to implementation and deployment, leveraging advanced AI tools to accelerate and optimize every stage
  • Own the Workstream you'll be assigned - break down and explain technical concepts clearly during client interactions and team discussions while keeping development on track
  • Move fluidly across the application layers, utilizing AI tools to rapidly upskill and deliver on varied engineering challenges. While our primary stack is TypeScript/Vue.js on the frontend and Python on the backend, we value strong foundational engineering skills that allow you to adapt as project directions evolve.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code guided by strong development principles
  • Conduct code reviews and actively participate in team knowledge sharing

Typical Challenges You'll be Solving

  • Projects that span multiple technologies - you'll need to be a fast learner, not a deep specialist in everything
  • Stakeholders who can describe their desired direction of development, rather than a specific feature - you turn that into a specification
  • Making independent decisions when the answer isn't clear, and communicating your reasoning
  • Managing the balance between respecting deadlines and system stability, taking into account both quality and quantity

Qualities for Success

  • Communicative & Responsible: You embrace taking charge and responsibility for a workstream while taking care to keep all stakeholders looped in
  • Solutions-Driven Mindset: You’re proactive and focused on solving the client's actual problem rather than just writing code
  • Curious & Tech-Savvy: You actively experiment with AI tooling and modern workflows to boost your productivity

This Job is Right for You If

  • You are a versatile engineer who can tackle any problem with the right tools
  • You think in systems, not just features
  • You know how to maintain high engineering standards and thoughtful delivery, even when moving at a rapid pace
  • You're genuinely curious - about technology, about your clients' domain, about getting better

This Job is not Right for You If

  • You prefer to stay away from client communication
  • You're skeptical of AI tools and prefer to avoid them
  • You prefer to receive detailed specifications rather than shape them
  • You require constant supervision and need heavy direction to stay productive

Benefits

What's In It for You

  • Real Impact: Real influence on technical decisions, tooling choices, and project direction.
  • Compensation: $4.000,00 – $6.000/monthly for B2B engagement, based on experience and skills.
  • Remote-first setup
  • Health & Wellbeing: 100% paid sick leave + annual health checkup
  • Stay active: Wellness subsidy
  • Continuous Growth: An education budget specifically designed to fuel your learning and help you expand your knowledge base.
  • Extra perks: Referral bonus

Space Inch is not responsible for any job boards scraping this ad without showing the position as remote, but Brazil exclusive. Applicants from other countries will not be considered.

Space Inch is committed to providing an environment of equal employment opportunity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination. Space Inch believes in treating all employees and applicants with respect and dignity, fostering a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed

raw.description:
Introduction

Join us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact!

We’re problem solvers, driven by our curiosity and creativity, in endless pursuit of solutions for our customers. Together, we champion the strength of our global teams. And, as trusted advisors, we go above and beyond, working together in a supportive and collaborative environment to ensure customer satisfaction. 

Through the company's continued growth, we challenge ourselves to be better, continuously learning and growing in our dynamic environment. Helping others is at the core of our culture, join us in finding fulfillment by giving back to our local communities as the united team that is AIT.  Find out what our people deliver.® means when you come move the world with us! 

Hear directly from our teammates at AIT Worldwide Logistics and make us the next stop on your career journey.

Overview

The Senior Financial Analyst, Corporate Finance will partner with Operations, Global Account Management, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Treasury and other stakeholders to identify, analyze and address process inefficiencies that impact billing, collections, vendor payments and overall customer experience. This role will leverage financial expertise, freight forwarding operational knowledge, and large-scale data analysis to identify trends, uncover root causes, and provide actionable recommendations that improve performance and efficiency. The successful candidate will support cross-functional initiatives by developing reporting, analytics, and process controls that proactively identify issues, reduce errors, minimize manual effort, and enhance operational effectiveness. This individual will serve as a key resource in driving continuous improvement through data-driven insights, process optimization, and collaboration across Finance and Operations teams.

Responsibilities

  • • Partner with Global Account Management, Operations, Billing, Accounts Receivable, and Accounts Payable teams to analyze operational and financial data, identify process gaps impacting billing accuracy, invoice delivery, and collections performance, and provide recommendations to improve efficiency and customer experience (15%)• Lead projects sponsored by AR, AP leadership and the Senior Manager, Corporate Finance, supporting process improvements, operational efficiencies, and strategic initiatives (10%)• Review and analyze aged receivables for key global customers to identify root causes of collection delays and recommend corrective actions (8%)• Collaborate with Global Account Management and Global Billing teams to analyze billing disputes, invoice delivery challenges, and collection barriers, providing data-driven insights and recommendations (7%)• Develop and maintain reporting tools and dashboards to identify billing, collection, and operational issues before invoices become aged or uncollectible (15%)• Analyze shipment-level, operational, and financial data to identify process inefficiencies, root causes, and opportunities to improve billing, collections, and payables performance. (20%)• Partner with Accounts Receivable teams to evaluate collection challenges and develop analytical tools that improve the efficiency of issue identification and resolution. (5%)• Develop and utilize Excel, Power BI, and other analytical tools to validate billing accuracy against customer rates, tariffs, contracts, and automated rating systems. (5%)• Support Accounts Payable leadership by analyzing vendor billing trends, identifying processing inefficiencies, and recommending solutions that improve automation and workflow effectiveness. (4%)• Perform root cause analysis on recurring vendor and internal process issues and support initiatives designed to enhance automation, efficiency, and controls. (4%)• Support Accounts Payable process improvement initiatives that strengthen operational effectiveness, compliance, and fraud prevention controls. (2%)• Support ad hoc analyses, reporting requests, and financial projects while ensuring alignment between operational activity and financial reporting. (2%)• Monitor recurring operational and financial issues, identify trends, and recommend long-term solutions to eliminate repeat exceptions. (3%)• Disclaimer: The responsibilities and duties described above are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and priorities may change at any time based on business needs, operational requirements, and organizational objectives. Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed.
  • The wage range for this position is $92,700.00-$139,060.00 and may vary based on geography as well as relative knowledge, skills, abilities, and experience.

Qualifications

Education Qualifications• Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience Experience Qualifications• 7-10 years of experience in transportation, logistics, freight forwarding, or related operational finance functions.• Demonstrated experience supporting billing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, operational finance, or process improvement initiatives.• Experience working with cross-functional teams including Operations, Billing, Customer Service, Sales, and Finance. Skills and Abilities• Strong knowledge of freight forwarding operations and the shipment lifecycle.• Ability to identify operational and financial process gaps, perform root cause analysis, and develop reporting and analytical solutions that improve efficiency, billing accuracy, collections performance, and stakeholder decision-making.• Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to enhance data analysis, reporting, process improvement, and operational efficiency initiatives• Experience developing reports, dashboards, and analytics tools using Excel, Power BI, or similar technologies.• Ability to analyze and interpret large, complex datasets to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.• Ability to facilitate discussions among stakeholders and assist in resolving process-related challenges through fact-based analysis.• Experience communicating findings, recommendations, and project updates to senior leadership.• Experience with transportation management systems (TMS), including but not limited to WorldPort (AS400) and CargoWise.• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Power Query, lookups, and data analysis.• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.• High attention to detail and accuracy.

What AIT Can Offer You

In addition to your base compensation, you may be eligible for a bonus based on achievement of business and/or individual performance metrics (dependent on position). Benefits offered include Medical, Prescription, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, Disability, Supplemental Health, Employee Support, Paid Parental Leave, Pet Insurance, 401(k) and Tuition Reimbursement. In addition, teammates may be eligible for up to 10 to 20 days of vacation (depending on tenure), 2 personal days, 1 floating holiday, 5 sick days, 5 volunteer hours, and 6 company holidays (plus Veterans Day for Veterans) annually.

About AIT Worldwide

AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps companies grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure their raw materials, components and finished goods. For more than 40 years, the Chicago-based supply chain solutions leader has relied on a consultative approach to build a global network and trusted partnerships in nearly every industry, including aerospace, automotive, consumer retail, energy, food, government, high-tech, industrial, life sciences and marine. Backed by scalable, user-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door-to-door deliveries via sea, air, ground and rail—on time and on budget. With expert teammates staffing more than 150 worldwide locations in Asia, Europe and North America, AIT’s full-service options also include customs clearance, warehouse management and white glove services.

AIT Worldwide Logistics is an Equal Opportunity Employer – M/F/Veterans/Disabled. If you are unable to apply online due to a disability, contact Human Resources at 630-766-8300 ext 5218.

At Precision for Medicine, our uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical authorities, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology.

Due to growth we are seeking a Resource Manager. The Resource Manager will help manage and optimise the organisation’s resources and deliver resource management support to the business. This role will also contribute to resourcing strategy for the organization and assist with budgeting and forecasting activities to improve company performance.

On a day-to-day basis, the Resource Manager is responsible for executing all staffing processes and activities further defined below.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Oversee the allocation and assignment of global resources (both full time and contractor staff) to the appropriate projects, placing the right people in the right positions to ensure project success, across the PFMORD enterprise
  • Optimize utilization across the business units by making staffing recommendations and decisions in support of a deployment strategy
  • Work with senior leadership to understand key resource requirements and ensure the development of resourcing strategies to meet both current and future organizational needs
  • Focus on developmental opportunities for staff and plans for staff advancement
  • Evaluates opportunities for resource optimization and enhancement using specific tracking tools and integration into the company ERP system
  • Advise project teams and financial analysts on how to best navigate and employ the resource management process and provide recommendations to improve business performance
  • Contribute to budgeting and forecasting activities on an ongoing and annualized basis to maximize value for the company
  • Coordinate hiring plan execution with Human Resources and Finance to ensure appropriately prioritized hiring
  • Prepare metrics and summary reports on resourcing activities as necessary
  • Negotiate and resolve staffing conflicts to the satisfaction of all parties and identify creative alternatives to address identified issues
  • Escalate sensitive or high-risk staffing situations to the Business Operations leadership and Executive Team as necessary
  • Other duties as assigned

This position can be offered fully home based in the UK, Hungary, Poland, Serbia, Romania or Slovakia.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 4-year college degree, or equivalent experience ideally in a scientific or healthcare discipline
  • Proven experience managing resources within a Clinical Research Organisation (CRO)
  • Ability to manage workforce allocations for both full time and contractor resources
  • Supervisory experience and ability to manage Business Operations Associates
  • Ability to drive and availability for domestic and occasional international travel including overnight stays

Competencies:

  • Possesses strong organizational/written communication skills and the ability to multi-task and prioritize in a fast-paced environment
  • Appropriate financial acumen and understanding of budgets, forecasting, utilization and realization concepts
  • Creative and flexible problem solving and critical thinking abilities
  • Executes time-sensitive matters while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail
  • Exhibits high self-motivation, and is able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment
  • Demonstrates a high degree of professionalism
  • Displays sound business judgment and a proactive, independent work style
  • Works well independently and cooperatively with others to achieve common goals in a virtual environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence allowing the individual to identify collaborative solutions and resolve conflicts in a productive, professional manner
  • Displays operational and interpersonal flexibility to establish relationships and best practices in an integration-heavy environment
  • Develops, maintains, and strengthens relationships with others inside or outside of the organization who can provide information, assistance, and support
  • Ability to work with diverse environments, both globally and culturally

Precision medicine is revolutionizing the attack on cancer—and we are passionate about helping you harness its power. We strike tumors on a molecular level using biomarkers to link specific mutations to specific treatments. We combine deep science with deep data from advanced technological platforms, then layer on specialized expertise in the design and execution of targeted, adaptive clinical trials. Ultimately, we deliver robust insights that inform real-time decisions—and optimize the oncology development pathway.

raw.excerpt: Who We AreAt Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.
raw.description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

In CIO Incident Response & Forensics at Kyndryl, you will be critical in investigating and safeguarding our mission-critical enterprise environments. Your role will be to conduct deep-dive, end-to-end cybersecurity investigations—specifically across high-stakes cloud, identity, and hybrid systems—ensuring complex security events are thoroughly investigated, contained, and resolved.

Unlike a traditional security operations role focused on alert triage, you will lead comprehensive investigations into advanced threats, including malware and ransomware, credential theft, business email compromise (BEC), insider threats, and potential data exposure. Operating from anywhere in Canada in a flexible remote model, you will examine evidence across multiple platforms, determine root cause and initial access vectors, assess business and compliance risks, and provide actionable recommendations to leadership.

Your investigative prowess will be put to the test piecing together attack timelines from raw technical evidence, evaluating impact beyond technical alerts, and delivering defensible root-cause determinations to keep our environments resilient, secure, and compliant.

At Kyndryl, we are committed to operational excellence and protecting vital digital assets. As a Cybersecurity Incident Investigator, you will be an integral part of that mission. If you are passionate about digital forensics, solving complex security puzzles, and want to be part of a collaborative team defending critical infrastructure—then this role is for you.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Kyndryl's focus on innovative IT and security solutions means that in CIO Incident Response & Forensics, you will work with modern threat detection and forensic technologies while enjoying clear paths to grow your skills. You will collaborate with cross-functional technical teams, executive leaders, and regulatory stakeholders across Canada to lead high-visibility investigations and uphold the highest standards of operational resilience.

Who You Are

You are good at what you do and possess the required investigative experience to prove it. Equally important, you bring a curious mindset, dedication to digital integrity, and strong communication skills to articulate technical findings to both technical peers and business leadership.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Must hold, or be strictly eligible to obtain and maintain, a Government of Canada Security Clearance (Level 2 - Secret / Protected B). Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Proven track record and hands-on experience in cybersecurity incident response (IR), digital forensics, or complex security investigations (end-to-end investigation, not basic alert triage).
  • Strong technical expertise with identity and access architectures, specifically Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and hybrid cloud security.
  • Solid investigative foundation analyzing SIEM telemetry, forensic artifacts, network data, and operating system internals across both Windows and Linux.
  • Proven ability to establish defensible sequence-of-events attack timelines, initial access vectors, and root-cause determinations.
  • Strong experience assessing business risk, regulatory implications, and confidentiality impact alongside pure technical severity.
  • Demonstrated capability to produce clear, executive-ready investigation reports and brief non-technical stakeholders during high-severity events.
  • Ability to work effectively and autonomously in a remote, distributed team across Canadian time zones.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., GIAC GCFE, GCFA, GCIH, GNFA, or CISSP).
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise forensic tooling (e.g., Velociraptor, FTK, EnCase, Volatility, KAPE) and modern EDR/XDR platforms.
  • Practical understanding of threat intelligence and mapping attacker behaviors via frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.

Salary: $118,700 - $168,700 CAD

The above represents Kyndryl’s pay range for this role.

Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role. The range provided reflects the target compensation range for the position at the time of posting. Kyndryl’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards.


This position requires the employee to work on a regular basis with Kyndryl stakeholders located in other Canadian provinces, the United States, or internationally where English is the common language, making knowledge of the English language a requirement for this position in addition to fluency in French.

Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Job Title: Quality Assurance Engineer

Job Overview: We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Quality Assurance Engineer to join our software development team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software testing methodologies, excellent analytical skills, and a passion for ensuring the delivery of high-quality software products. As a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the software development life cycle by designing and executing comprehensive test plans, identifying and documenting defects, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the overall quality of our software solutions.

Responsibilities:

  1. Test Planning and Design:

    • Collaborate with development teams to understand project requirements and functional specifications.
    • Design, develop, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts.
    • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation related to testing activities.

  2. Manual and Automated Testing:

    • Perform manual testing of software applications to identify and document defects.
    • Develop and maintain automated test scripts to enhance testing efficiency and coverage.
    • Execute automated test suites and analyze results to ensure software meets quality standards.

  3. Defect Identification and Documentation:

    • Identify, document, and track software defects using established defect tracking tools.
    • Work closely with developers to isolate, reproduce, and resolve defects in a timely manner.

  4. Regression Testing:

    • Conduct regression testing to ensure that previously identified defects have been addressed and new features have not introduced new issues.

  5. Performance and Load Testing:

    • Plan and execute performance testing to evaluate the scalability, reliability, and responsiveness of software applications.
    • Analyze and report performance test results, identifying areas for improvement.

  6. Collaboration and Communication:

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business analysts, to ensure a comprehensive understanding of project requirements.
    • Clearly communicate test progress, test results, and any testing-related issues to relevant stakeholders.

  7. Continuous Improvement:

    • Stay current with industry trends and advancements in testing methodologies.
    • Propose and implement process improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the QA process.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in software quality assurance, including both manual and automated testing.
  • Familiarity with testing tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, JUnit, TestNG).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Knowledge of Agile development methodologies.

Education and Experience:

  • Minimum of [X] years of experience in software quality assurance.
  • Relevant certifications in software testing (e.g., ISTQB) are a plus.

If you are a dedicated Quality Assurance Engineer with a commitment to delivering high-quality software, we invite you to join our dynamic team and contribute to the success of our software development projects.

About the job

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Junior Analyst to support our Legal and Compliance team. In this role, you will work with internal teams and external stakeholders to provide accurate, timely, and compliant responses to legal and regulatory requests pertaining to asset recovery inquiries. This position provides a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience at the intersection of law, compliance, investigations, and blockchain technology.

You will thrive in this role if you enjoy analyzing complex cases, managing multiple priorities, collaborating across teams, and continuously learning in a fast-paced, global environment.

Responsibilities

  • Case Intake & Triage: Verify the authenticity and completeness of asset recovery requests, assign them to the appropriate team, and track deadlines for timely resolution.

  • Collaboration & Risk Management: Work closely with internal teams and external stakeholders to progress cases, identify risks, and escalate complex issues when needed.

  • Legal & Investigative Analysis: Synthesize findings, prepare recommendations for management, and oversee implementation of approved decisions.

  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain thorough case records, communication trails, and ensure adherence to internal and regulatory protocols.

  • Regulatory Awareness: Stay updated on developments in digital asset regulations (e.g., stablecoins) and support updates to internal processes and cross-border compliance activities.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Legal Studies, Compliance, Finance, or a related field.

  • 1–3 years of experience in legal, compliance, or investigative roles.

  • Solid understanding of AML/KYC, sanctions compliance, and digital asset regulations.

  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple tasks.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in investigations, asset recovery, or legal casework.

  • Exposure to regulatory authorities, prosecutors, or law enforcement agencies.

  • Familiarity with international legal frameworks, cross-border compliance, and digital asset regulations.

  • Knowledge of blockchain analytics or compliance technology is a plus.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

  • Develop reusable agents, skills, workflow components, and connectors that can be used across engineering teams.
  • Implement agent behaviors, tool calls, structured workflows, and integration logic that support AI-assisted SDLC use cases.
  • Apply standards for modularity, permissions, traceability, and maintainability.
  • Partner with more senior engineers to refine shared libraries and reduce duplicate AI engineering work across teams.

Implement Evaluation, Testing & LLMOps Workflows

  • Build and maintain evaluation workflows for prompts, agents, tools, and AI-generated outputs.
  • Develop automated tests, regression checks, quality benchmarks, and validation approaches for AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Support versioning, release management, rollback readiness, and lifecycle management for prompts, agents, and AI components.

Apply AI Security & Governance Controls

  • Embed approved logging, access control, data classification, and risk controls into AI-enabled workflows.
  • Work with security and governance partners to address implementation requirements for responsible AI use.
  • Validate that AI tools and agents are handling sensitive data appropriately and operating within defined guardrails.

Partner with Engineering Teams on AI-Assisted Delivery

  • Candidates should have experience building APIs, services, integrations, automated tests, and cloud-based applications.
  • Experience with LLM application patterns, prompt engineering, RAG, agent frameworks, LLMOps, evaluation techniques, or AI-assisted development tools is strongly preferred.

American Health Holding, Inc. (AHH), a division of Aetna/CVS Health, is a URAC-accredited medical management organization founded in 1993. We provide flexible, cost-effective care management solutions that promote high-quality healthcare for members.


Position Summary

Join our Utilization Management team as a Nurse Consultant, where you'll apply clinical judgment and evidence-based criteria to review inpatient and outpatient services. You'll collaborate with providers, authorize care, and escalate cases when needed, all while navigating multiple systems and maintaining accurate documentation. This role suits nurses who thrive in fast-paced environments, are highly organized, and comfortable with computer-based work.

Education

Overview

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description:

Are you looking to gain experience and jump-start your career in one of the fastest growing consulting and accounting firms in the country?

Would you like the ability to join a highly dynamic team focused on providing exceptional client service in the area of healthcare consulting and compliance?

If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly (BT) as a Healthcare Advisory Consultant! As a Healthcare Advisory Consultant, you will be a part of our internal healthcare advisory team where you will provide a variety of services including, but not limited to, analyzing client data, preparation of Medicaid and Medicare cost reports according to Federal and State regulations, and interaction with clients.

As one of the fastest growing firms in the nation, BT has the ability to offer you upward career trajectory, flexibility in how and where you get your work done and meaningful relationships with clients, teammates and leadership who truly care about you and your development.

You will enjoy this role if you:

  • Are considering a long-term career in professional services and want exposure to the industry
  • Value your development and want to work for a firm whose owners have both their clients’ and employees’ best interests in mind and are transparent in their decisions
  • Want to grow professionally and develop your client service and technical skills to build a strong foundation now, for tomorrow

Successful candidates will have: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Information Systems, Healthcare Management or Finance related degree
  • 1 year of related experience
  • Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, organizational, interpersonal, communication skills and solid Microsoft Suite skills required
  • Ability to provide exceptional client service, demonstrate commitment to continuous learning, display appropriate ethical knowledge and commitment and exhibit a sense of urgency and commitment to quality and the timely completion of duties
  • The ability to work effectively in a team environment with all levels of client personnel in various industries
  • Excellent written/verbal communications and collaboration skills
  • Be available to travel as needed for client projects
  • Eligibility to work in the U.S. without sponsorship

The pay range for this position is $57,800 to $95,600. This range represents a good-faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation the firm expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will depend on a variety of relevant factors, including an applicant’s skills, experience, qualifications, professional certifications, work arrangements, geographic location, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range, and compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. raw.title: Global Digital Marketing Director - 2025939
raw.excerpt: Are you a person of compassion?  An advocate for justice?
raw.description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?
If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.
At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.
If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.

ORGANIZATION SUMMARY

World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.
Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

POSITION SUMMARY:

World Relief seeks a Global Digital Marketing Director to take on the next stage of World Relief’s digital marketing growth - leading online brand strategy, fundraising, and governance, cross-channel digital execution, and the organization's unified global digital presence. Building on an established team, digital channels, and foundational systems, this role sets the long-term vision for scalable audience growth, digital brand amplification, integrated supporter journeys, and measurable fundraising impact.

The director oversees digital marketing strategy across web, email, paid media, organic social, digital analytics, and digital experience; partners closely with fundraising and content teams and local offices; and develops the people, processes, and measurement capabilities needed for sustained performance. The role combines strategic leadership, financial stewardship, experimentation, and cross-functional influence to amplify brand, deepen audience engagement, and drive digital fundraising.

As a team leader and experienced strategist, this role reports directly to the Vice President of Marketing & Brand and works closely with the content team and other local fundraising staff throughout the World Relief network. The ideal candidate is solution-based, kind-hearted, creative, and enjoys working in a collaborative environment.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

    Strategy, scale and growth

  • Design and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and conversion across all digital platforms.
  • Own and evolve a multi-year digital marketing roadmap aligned with organizational priorities and fundraising goals; translate it into annual priorities, investments, and measurable outcomes.
  • Ensure brand alignment and standards across Global website and US Office child sites
  • Identify scalable growth opportunities across existing and emerging channels, audiences, partnerships, and technologies; prioritize based on impact, feasibility, and capacity.
  • Guide integrated acquisition, engagement, and conversion strategies while ensuring channel experts have the authority and clarity to execute effectively.
  • Manage assigned digital marketing budgets, agency and vendor relationships, and resource allocation; evaluate effectiveness and return on investment.

    • Supporter lifecycle and fundraising performance

  • Oversee the execution of digital fundraising roadmaps across email marketing, SMS/text-to-give, paid media, and social channels.
  • Craft digital strategies that connect awareness, lead acquisition, nurturing, first donation, recurring giving, retention, and reactivation.
  • Partner with marketing and content teams to craft compelling impact stories that convert digital traffic into recurring or one-time gifts, and strengthen donor journeys and audience segmentation.
  • Set shared goals and improvement plans for new donors, qualified leads, online revenue, lead-to-donor conversion, and other agreed outcomes.
  • Guide rapid, coordinated digital responses to humanitarian emergencies and major campaigns.

    • Digital experience, platforms and innovation

  • Guide the strategic direction for website experience, search visibility, accessibility, and conversion rate optimization, with execution led by appropriate specialists.
  • Define marketing requirements and priorities for donation experiences, marketing automation, and platform improvements in partnership with technology and CRM owners.
  • Evaluate responsible uses of AI and emerging technologies to improve discoverability, efficiency, personalization, and performance.
  • Promote responsible supporter-data practices and collaborate with designated teams on privacy, security, and compliance.
    • Measurement, experimentation and operational excellence
  • Own the digital measurement framework, including KPIs, campaign tracking standards, attribution approaches, dashboards, and executive reporting.
  • Report on real-time campaign performance, donor acquisition cost (CAC), retention and upgrade rates, andA/B split tests
  • Use audience and performance insights to guide investment decisions, uncover friction in supporter journeys, and improve results.
  • Build a disciplined experimentation program with clear hypotheses, prioritization, documented learnings, and repeatable optimization practices.
  • Stay ahead of emerging digital trends, technologies, and consumer behaviors to keep the brand relevant and competitive.
  • Strengthen scalable workflows, documentation, quality assurance, and cross-training to reduce operational risk and improve consistency.

    • People leadership and organizational influence

  • Lead, coach, and develop an established multidisciplinary team of digital marketing experts; establish clear goals, decision rights, and accountability.
  • Build leadership capacity, delegate ownership, and create a culture of trust, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Assess team structure, skills, and capacity as organizational needs evolve; support succession planning and professional development.
  • Advise senior leaders and collaborate with Fundraising, Content, Technology, and local-office stakeholders on integrated priorities, change management, and shared outcomes.

    • This role is responsible for supervising others and includes responsibilities consistent with supervising employees including but not limited to monitoring daily work activities, tracking and approving timesheets including approving time off, monitoring performance including entering goals, progress check-ins, and weekly or bi-weekly check-ins, documenting performance concerns, entering staff promotions, transitions, and separations in HRIS within required time frame. Managers at World Relief are also considered spiritual leaders and are expected to lead staff in a manner consistent with our Christian values including but not limited to praying with staff, leading devotionals, and fostering a Christian environment in interactions with staff throughout World Relief.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Mature and personal Christian faith
  • Committed to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief
  • Desire to serve and empower the Church to impact vulnerable communities
  • Able to affirm and/or acknowledge World Reliefs Core Beliefs, Statement of Faith, Christian Identity and National Association of Evangelicals' For the Health of The Nation document
  • 10+ years of progressive digital marketing experience, including substantial strategic leadership responsibility.
  • Demonstrated success leading and developing specialized teams and delivering measurable audience or revenue growth.
  • Experience with marketing analytics, automation, CRM-connected journeys, and digital marketing technology ecosystems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Nonprofit fundraising experience preferred; bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience preferred.
World Relief offers a competitive benefits package and employee discount program for full-time employees.
World Relief is honored to be recognized with the Gold-level Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation for exceeding the core components of our well-being program including leadership and culture, program foundations and execution, and whole person health.

***

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.
For World Relief staff, strong commitment to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief is essential, and Christian faith is a prerequisite for employment, based upon United States federal guidelines provided in Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

raw.title: Director, Commercial
raw.excerpt: Arbital Health helps health plans understand and actively manage the financial performance of their value-based care contracts.
raw.description:
Arbital Health helps health plans understand and actively manage the financial performance of their value-based care contracts. Our actuarial AI platform brings together contracts, claims, attribution, and benchmarks to help teams measure performance, understand financial risk, identify opportunities, and act earlier.

Co-founded by Brian Overstreet and Travis May and backed by leading healthcare investors, Arbital combines actuarial expertise with technology to bring greater transparency, efficiency, and financial predictability to value-based care.

We hire driven, curious, and humble people who enjoy building, work collaboratively, and take ownership in a fast-paced environment.

About the Role

    We’re looking for an experienced enterprise sales executive to grow Arbital’s health plan business. This is an individual contributor role focused on acquiring new health plan customers, building executive relationships, and closing complex technology agreements.

    You will own the full sales cycle, from identifying target accounts and generating opportunities through discovery, demonstrations, proposals, negotiation, and contracting. You will engage CFOs, actuarial leaders, medical economics teams, and value-based care executives, connecting their business priorities to Arbital’s capabilities.

    The ideal candidate has a demonstrated record of selling enterprise technology to health plans, understands how payer organizations evaluate and purchase solutions, and can clearly communicate the financial value of a complex platform.

What You'll Do

    • Deliver revenue growth. Meet or exceed assigned sales targets by winning new health plan customers.

    • Build and manage your territory. Develop account plans, prioritize target health plans, and generate a qualified pipeline through direct outreach, industry relationships, marketing programs, and partner introductions.

    • Lead complex sales cycles. Own opportunities from initial engagement through signature, navigating executive sponsorship, business evaluation, procurement, security review, legal negotiations, and budget approval.

    • Develop relationships across the buying team. Build trusted relationships with finance, actuarial, medical economics, value-based care, and other stakeholders. Establish executive champions and a clear understanding of decision-making authority.

    • Run effective discovery. Understand each prospect’s current processes, financial priorities, contract complexity, and decision criteria. Determine where Arbital can deliver measurable value.

    • Demonstrate the platform. Deliver compelling presentations and tailored product demonstrations that connect Arbital’s capabilities to the prospect’s business needs.

    • Build the business case. Develop proposals and ROI narratives with support from actuarial, Delivery, Product, and Commercial colleagues.

    • Negotiate and close. Structure pricing and commercial terms within company guidelines and coordinate internal resources to move agreements to signature.

    • Maintain sales discipline. Keep CRM records, opportunity stages, next steps, and forecasts accurate. Identify risks early and maintain clear plans for advancing opportunities.

    • Support successful handoffs. Partner with Implementation, Delivery, and Client Success to ensure commitments, scope, and customer expectations are clearly documented.

    • Help strengthen our commercial approach. Share market feedback, refine messaging, and collaborate with Marketing and Partnerships on targeted campaigns and account strategies.

What You Bring

    • 8+ years of enterprise sales experience, including demonstrated success selling technology or SaaS solutions directly to health plans.

    • A consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota and closing complex, high-value agreements.

    • Experience engaging senior health plan executives and navigating multiple stakeholders, long buying cycles, and formal procurement processes.

    • The ability to explain complex financial, analytical, or data-driven concepts in clear business terms.

    • Strong discovery, presentation, product demonstration, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

    • Experience building your own pipeline alongside marketing and partner-generated opportunities.

    • A disciplined approach to account planning, qualification, forecasting, and CRM management.

    • The ability to operate independently, prioritize effectively, and seek coaching or support when needed.

    • A collaborative, entrepreneurial mindset and comfort working through ambiguity.

    • Preferred Experience

      • Selling solutions to health plan finance, actuarial, or medical economics teams.

      • Knowledge of value-based care, risk-based contracting, medical cost management, and health plan financial performance.

      • Experience selling actuarial, financial analytics, contract management, or related enterprise platforms.

      • Experience in a startup or rapidly growing healthcare technology company.

      • An established network of relevant health plan relationships.

Tools and Travel

    Comfort working in Google Workspace and CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce. Willingness to travel for customer meetings, industry events, and team gatherings.

raw.excerpt: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases.
raw.description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

The Talent Acquisition Specialist (TAS) is responsible for supporting global full-cycle talent acquisition. The TAS interfaces with a wide variety of stakeholders including HR, people leaders, candidates, vendors, and partner organizations. In addition, the TAS contributes to the creation of selection materials, employer branding, onboarding, and special HR projects as required.

Key Responsabilities

  • Full-Cycle Recruitment: Conduct high-volume talent acquisition including job posting, sourcing, screening, and interviewing.
  • Offer Negotiation & Compliance: Negotiate employment offers ensuring compliance with starting salary practices and pay equity.
  • Talent Pipeline Development: Apply industry-leading techniques to source passive and active candidates; Create and maintain talent pipelines for key opportunities.
  • Candidate Experience Management: Champion a positive candidate experience for internal and external job applicants.
  • Vendor & Partnership Management: Liaise with recruitment agencies, marketing/social media partners, and employment-focused community organizations.
  • Employee Referral Program: Champion the internal Employee Referral Program including promotion, tracking, and reporting.
  • Selection Materials Development: Create industry-supported, role-specific selection materials in conjunction with managers.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Undergraduate university degree (Specialty in HR) and 1-3 years' related experience with initial and on-going training
    OR College Diploma/Degree and 4-6 years related experience +substantial on-going job -related training.
  • Knowledge of labour legislation in LATAM.
  • Experience working in a global or multi-country organization, particularly within the life sciences, pharmaceutical, or contract research industry preferred.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Excellent time management and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality.
  • Fluent in the reading, writing and speaking of English (additional language skills are preferred).

What We Offer

    In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

    • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
    • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
    • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
    • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
    • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
    • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
    • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
    • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

      • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

    To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

    Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace.
