AARP is the nation's largest nonprofit, nonpartisan organization dedicated to empowering people 50 and older to choose how they live as they age. With a nationwide presence, AARP strengthens communities and advocates for what matters most to the more than 100 million Americans 50-plus and their families: health and financial security, and personal fulfillment. AARP also works for individuals in the marketplace by sparking new solutions and allowing carefully chosen, high-quality products and services to carry the AARP name. As a trusted source for news and information, AARP produces the nation's largest-circulation publications, AARP The Magazine and the AARP Bulletin.

Are you a journalism, advertising, public relations, or marketing student with strong communication skills and experience writing and sharing intriguing stories, managing projects, crafting videos, or creating presentations? Do you have database creation and management skills? Are you passionate, creative, and results-driven? OurNationwide Community Presence Communications teamis looking for someone to assist staff and volunteer teams in telling the story of AARP’s local work. As an intern, you will apply strategic, analytical, and creative thinking to many projects. We’ll challenge you to think and work in new ways. We are committed to your growth and will cultivate your development. This remote, paid internship is expected to start in January 2027, with the possibility of extending into additional semesters.

This is a fully remote position and can be performed from anywhere in the United States and its territories.


Responsibilities:
  • Apply innovative thinking and problem-solving to challenges in a matrix environment
  • Compile research and data analyses and write up findings
  • Assist as needed with writing, editing, and publishing articles through AARP's Content Management System
  • Organize creative assets and toolkits for use in local markets and for award applications
  • Audit, edit, and create internal communications tools and resources
  • Assist in the management of digital marketing campaigns and telling the story of learnings and successes
  • Assist in maintaining, monitoring, and improving the digital user flow as part of a marketing campaign, from viewing an ad to taking action online. This may include performing user testing, reviewing tracking mechanisms, reviewing and analyzing user feedback, and reviewing and analyzing web metrics
  • Support campaign-related emails as needed
  • Create and distribute attractive and eye-catching presentations and toolkits

Qualifications:
  • Pursuing a degree in journalism, advertising, public relations, marketing, or a related field
  • Prospective interns must be enrolled in a degree program at an accredited college or university as undergraduate juniors or seniors, graduate students, or postdoctoral students and remain academically enrolled throughout the internship
  • Technical proficiency in Microsoft Office and other organizational programs; knowledge of Canva and PowerPoint is a plus
  • Ability to work in an informal team situation that stretches across business units in a matrix way
  • Must be a self-starter and adaptable, with the ability to work under tight deadlines
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, anticipate project needs, and discern work priorities
  • Ability to work well with diverse populations, including gender, race, and sexual orientation
  • Writing samples and examples of prior video and other presentation projects requested

AARP will not sponsor an employment visa for this position.

Additional Requirements

  • Regular and reliable job attendance
  • Exhibit respect and understanding of others to maintain professional relationships
  • Independent judgement in evaluation options to make sound decisions
  • Home office environment with the ability to work effectively surrounded by moderate home environment noise

Compensation and Benefits

The hourly range is $18.40 for undergraduates, $21 for graduate students, and $28 for Ph.D. candidates. Internships are non-exempt positions and are not eligible for employee benefits.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description:

Are you looking to gain experience and jump-start your career in one of the fastest growing consulting and accounting firms in the country?

Would you like the ability to join a highly dynamic team focused on providing exceptional client service in the area of healthcare consulting and compliance?

If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly (BT) as a Healthcare Advisory Consultant! As one of the fastest growing firms in the nation, BT has the ability to offer you upward career trajectory, flexibility in how and where you get your work done and meaningful relationships with clients, teammates and leadership who truly care about you and your development.

You will enjoy this role if you:

raw.title: Global Digital Marketing Director - 2025939
raw.excerpt: Are you a person of compassion?  An advocate for justice?
raw.description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?
If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.
At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.
If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.

ORGANIZATION SUMMARY

World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.
Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

POSITION SUMMARY:

World Relief seeks a Global Digital Marketing Director to take on the next stage of World Relief’s digital marketing growth - leading online brand strategy, fundraising, and governance, cross-channel digital execution, and the organization's unified global digital presence. Building on an established team, digital channels, and foundational systems, this role sets the long-term vision for scalable audience growth, digital brand amplification, integrated supporter journeys, and measurable fundraising impact.

The director oversees digital marketing strategy across web, email, paid media, organic social, digital analytics, and digital experience; partners closely with fundraising and content teams and local offices; and develops the people, processes, and measurement capabilities needed for sustained performance. The role combines strategic leadership, financial stewardship, experimentation, and cross-functional influence to amplify brand, deepen audience engagement, and drive digital fundraising.

As a team leader and experienced strategist, this role reports directly to the Vice President of Marketing & Brand and works closely with the content team and other local fundraising staff throughout the World Relief network. The ideal candidate is solution-based, kind-hearted, creative, and enjoys working in a collaborative environment.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

    Strategy, scale and growth

  • Design and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and conversion across all digital platforms.
  • Own and evolve a multi-year digital marketing roadmap aligned with organizational priorities and fundraising goals; translate it into annual priorities, investments, and measurable outcomes.
  • Ensure brand alignment and standards across Global website and US Office child sites
  • Identify scalable growth opportunities across existing and emerging channels, audiences, partnerships, and technologies; prioritize based on impact, feasibility, and capacity.
  • Guide integrated acquisition, engagement, and conversion strategies while ensuring channel experts have the authority and clarity to execute effectively.
  • Manage assigned digital marketing budgets, agency and vendor relationships, and resource allocation; evaluate effectiveness and return on investment.

    • Supporter lifecycle and fundraising performance

  • Oversee the execution of digital fundraising roadmaps across email marketing, SMS/text-to-give, paid media, and social channels.
  • Craft digital strategies that connect awareness, lead acquisition, nurturing, first donation, recurring giving, retention, and reactivation.
  • Partner with marketing and content teams to craft compelling impact stories that convert digital traffic into recurring or one-time gifts, and strengthen donor journeys and audience segmentation.
  • Set shared goals and improvement plans for new donors, qualified leads, online revenue, lead-to-donor conversion, and other agreed outcomes.
  • Guide rapid, coordinated digital responses to humanitarian emergencies and major campaigns.

    • Digital experience, platforms and innovation

  • Guide the strategic direction for website experience, search visibility, accessibility, and conversion rate optimization, with execution led by appropriate specialists.
  • Define marketing requirements and priorities for donation experiences, marketing automation, and platform improvements in partnership with technology and CRM owners.
  • Evaluate responsible uses of AI and emerging technologies to improve discoverability, efficiency, personalization, and performance.
  • Promote responsible supporter-data practices and collaborate with designated teams on privacy, security, and compliance.
    • Measurement, experimentation and operational excellence
  • Own the digital measurement framework, including KPIs, campaign tracking standards, attribution approaches, dashboards, and executive reporting.
  • Report on real-time campaign performance, donor acquisition cost (CAC), retention and upgrade rates, andA/B split tests
  • Use audience and performance insights to guide investment decisions, uncover friction in supporter journeys, and improve results.
  • Build a disciplined experimentation program with clear hypotheses, prioritization, documented learnings, and repeatable optimization practices.
  • Stay ahead of emerging digital trends, technologies, and consumer behaviors to keep the brand relevant and competitive.
  • Strengthen scalable workflows, documentation, quality assurance, and cross-training to reduce operational risk and improve consistency.

    • People leadership and organizational influence

  • Lead, coach, and develop an established multidisciplinary team of digital marketing experts; establish clear goals, decision rights, and accountability.
  • Build leadership capacity, delegate ownership, and create a culture of trust, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Assess team structure, skills, and capacity as organizational needs evolve; support succession planning and professional development.
  • Advise senior leaders and collaborate with Fundraising, Content, Technology, and local-office stakeholders on integrated priorities, change management, and shared outcomes.

    • This role is responsible for supervising others and includes responsibilities consistent with supervising employees including but not limited to monitoring daily work activities, tracking and approving timesheets including approving time off, monitoring performance including entering goals, progress check-ins, and weekly or bi-weekly check-ins, documenting performance concerns, entering staff promotions, transitions, and separations in HRIS within required time frame. Managers at World Relief are also considered spiritual leaders and are expected to lead staff in a manner consistent with our Christian values including but not limited to praying with staff, leading devotionals, and fostering a Christian environment in interactions with staff throughout World Relief.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Mature and personal Christian faith
  • Committed to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief
  • Desire to serve and empower the Church to impact vulnerable communities
  • Able to affirm and/or acknowledge World Reliefs Core Beliefs, Statement of Faith, Christian Identity and National Association of Evangelicals' For the Health of The Nation document
  • 10+ years of progressive digital marketing experience, including substantial strategic leadership responsibility.
  • Demonstrated success leading and developing specialized teams and delivering measurable audience or revenue growth.
  • Experience with marketing analytics, automation, CRM-connected journeys, and digital marketing technology ecosystems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Nonprofit fundraising experience preferred; bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience preferred.
World Relief offers a competitive benefits package and employee discount program for full-time employees.
World Relief is honored to be recognized with the Gold-level Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation for exceeding the core components of our well-being program including leadership and culture, program foundations and execution, and whole person health.

***

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.
For World Relief staff, strong commitment to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief is essential, and Christian faith is a prerequisite for employment, based upon United States federal guidelines provided in Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

raw.description:
Arbital Health helps health plans understand and actively manage the financial performance of their value-based care contracts. Our actuarial AI platform brings together contracts, claims, attribution, and benchmarks to help teams measure performance, understand financial risk, identify opportunities, and act earlier.

Co-founded by Brian Overstreet and Travis May and backed by leading healthcare investors, Arbital combines actuarial expertise with technology to bring greater transparency, efficiency, and financial predictability to value-based care.

We hire driven, curious, and humble people who enjoy building, work collaboratively, and take ownership in a fast-paced environment.

About the Role

    We’re looking for an experienced enterprise sales executive to grow Arbital’s health plan business. This is an individual contributor role focused on acquiring new health plan customers, building executive relationships, and closing complex technology agreements.

    You will own the full sales cycle, from identifying target accounts and generating opportunities through discovery, demonstrations, proposals, negotiation, and contracting. You will engage CFOs, actuarial leaders, medical economics teams, and value-based care executives, connecting their business priorities to Arbital’s capabilities.

    The ideal candidate has a demonstrated record of selling enterprise technology to health plans, understands how payer organizations evaluate and purchase solutions, and can clearly communicate the financial value of a complex platform.

What You'll Do

    • Deliver revenue growth. Meet or exceed assigned sales targets by winning new health plan customers.

    • Build and manage your territory. Develop account plans, prioritize target health plans, and generate a qualified pipeline through direct outreach, industry relationships, marketing programs, and partner introductions.

    • Lead complex sales cycles. Own opportunities from initial engagement through signature, navigating executive sponsorship, business evaluation, procurement, security review, legal negotiations, and budget approval.

    • Develop relationships across the buying team. Build trusted relationships with finance, actuarial, medical economics, value-based care, and other stakeholders. Establish executive champions and a clear understanding of decision-making authority.

    • Run effective discovery. Understand each prospect’s current processes, financial priorities, contract complexity, and decision criteria. Determine where Arbital can deliver measurable value.

    • Demonstrate the platform. Deliver compelling presentations and tailored product demonstrations that connect Arbital’s capabilities to the prospect’s business needs.

    • Build the business case. Develop proposals and ROI narratives with support from actuarial, Delivery, Product, and Commercial colleagues.

    • Negotiate and close. Structure pricing and commercial terms within company guidelines and coordinate internal resources to move agreements to signature.

    • Maintain sales discipline. Keep CRM records, opportunity stages, next steps, and forecasts accurate. Identify risks early and maintain clear plans for advancing opportunities.

    • Support successful handoffs. Partner with Implementation, Delivery, and Client Success to ensure commitments, scope, and customer expectations are clearly documented.

    • Help strengthen our commercial approach. Share market feedback, refine messaging, and collaborate with Marketing and Partnerships on targeted campaigns and account strategies.

What You Bring

    • 8+ years of enterprise sales experience, including demonstrated success selling technology or SaaS solutions directly to health plans.

    • A consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota and closing complex, high-value agreements.

    • Experience engaging senior health plan executives and navigating multiple stakeholders, long buying cycles, and formal procurement processes.

    • The ability to explain complex financial, analytical, or data-driven concepts in clear business terms.

    • Strong discovery, presentation, product demonstration, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

    • Experience building your own pipeline alongside marketing and partner-generated opportunities.

    • A disciplined approach to account planning, qualification, forecasting, and CRM management.

    • The ability to operate independently, prioritize effectively, and seek coaching or support when needed.

    • A collaborative, entrepreneurial mindset and comfort working through ambiguity.

    • Preferred Experience

      • Selling solutions to health plan finance, actuarial, or medical economics teams.

      • Knowledge of value-based care, risk-based contracting, medical cost management, and health plan financial performance.

      • Experience selling actuarial, financial analytics, contract management, or related enterprise platforms.

      • Experience in a startup or rapidly growing healthcare technology company.

      • An established network of relevant health plan relationships.

Tools and Travel

    Comfort working in Google Workspace and CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce. Willingness to travel for customer meetings, industry events, and team gatherings.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

The TAS interfaces with a wide variety of stakeholders including HR, people leaders, candidates, vendors, and partner organizations. In addition, the TAS contributes to the creation of selection materials, employer branding, onboarding, and special HR projects as required.

Skills & Qualifications

    OR College Diploma/Degree and 4-6 years related experience +substantial on-going job -related training.
  • Knowledge of labour legislation in LATAM.
  • Experience working in a global or multi-country organization, particularly within the life sciences, pharmaceutical, or contract research industry preferred.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Excellent time management and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality.

title: Senior Product Engineer - Tools & Activation
description: Hello.  We're Prismic. We believe the future is all about autonomous websites and hyper-personalised user journeys.

raw.title: Senior Product Engineer - Tools & Activation
raw.excerpt: Hello.  We're Prismic. We believe the future is all about autonomous websites and hyper-personalised user journeys.
raw.description:
Hello. We're Prismic.

We believe the future is all about autonomous websites and hyper-personalised user journeys.

We're building the Autonomous Website Experience. Today you choose tools, model content, write code, and fix bugs by hand. Tomorrow you say what you want, and the system builds, fixes, and improves the site with you, from the first demo to the daily updates.

The Tools and Activation Team

Our mission: build the tools that let developers, marketers, and AI agents, use Prismic efficiently, and design the most frictionless onboarding for different personalities and personas.

We own two sides of that problem.

  • The tools. The CLI and MCP are how agents work with Prismic. An agent in Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or Codex should be able to do everything you can do in the UI, without guessing, getting stuck, or inventing glue code. The developer tooling is what closes the loop - how developers deliver slices and manage their day to day work. We make those surfaces reliable, complete, and efficient.

  • The first mile. People don't just arrive from different places. They also arrive with different experience and different knowledge of Prismic. Everyone should be able to onboard. We design those paths for that range of people, and we are responsible for making them the best.

What we measure

We measure two things.

Activation with our tools. How many developers and agents activate with the MCP, whether they stay, and how often they come back.

Onboarding to production. How many people start with Prismic and deploy their website to production.

The problems you'd pick up

Here's what's actually on the table right now.

CLI and MCP that make humans and agents first-class users of Prismic. The CLI is how agents set up projects, model content, and stay in the codebase. The MCP is how they read, edit, and operate on content. Together they should cover the full surface of the product, not a thin slice of it. The hard part is not exposing an API. It is making people and agents efficient: the right tools, the right defaults, the right errors, and a path that doesn't fall apart past the happy path.

Developer tooling that stays out of the way. This is how developers actually interact with Prismic day to day: scaffolding projects, modeling data, developing Slices and syncing with remote server. You would help shape that interactions so people can do their work without fighting the tool.

Onboarding that works for different people. People arrive from different sources and they arrive with very different experience. All of them should be able to onboard. You would help design those paths and keep them coherent.

Why this role is interesting

  • You build the technology, and you build it fast. We prototype quickly, learn from it, and keep what works. An idea goes from POC to something customers use without a long chain of handoffs.

  • You talk to customers directly. Product Engineers here don't wait for a spec. You talk to users, decide what to build, ship it, and see whether it moved the numbers.

  • Your users are humans and agents. Designing for developers, marketers, and AI agents at once is a new problem. There is no established playbook, so you help write it.

  • Your impact is easy to see. Activation and websites in production are numbers you can watch move because of what you shipped.

Role 💫

We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Tools and Activation Team.

We chose the title Product Engineer on purpose. We're not looking for someone who ships clean code against a spec. We want someone who owns the outcome: talks to users, decides what to build with product, ships it, and is accountable for whether it moved the numbers. It's less about handoffs and more about owning the work end to end.

This is an individual contributor role. You'll have a lot of autonomy over both product and technical decisions, while working closely with product, design, and the rest of the engineering team.

Are you the one? 🧠

This role leans backend. You will spend most of your time on services, APIs and CLIs. Frontend is part of the job when the path to activation lives in a UI, but it is not the centre of gravity.

Ideally, you:

  • Are a strong backend engineer in TypeScript, comfortable designing APIs and CLIs

  • Have built developer-facing surfaces like CLIs or SDKs. You’re used to commands that compose, contracts that stay stable, output that tells you what to do next, and errors specific enough to recover from.

  • Have built agent-facing surfaces before. The client of our products is not always a human. Agents get stuck on interactive prompts, vague errors, and incomplete tools. You understand the problems and know how to solve them.

  • Are at home with ambiguous problems and short feedback loops. You can take an idea to a POC quickly, learn from it, and decide what to keep.

You also bring the baseline every Product Engineer here shares:

  • You're full-stack enough to work across the stack when the problem requires it, including databases and infrastructure.

  • You handle complex integrations and product problems without waiting to be told what to do.

  • You have hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, or strong curiosity about them.

  • You care about quality engineering: testing, observability, traceability.

We weigh competencies over years of experience or job titles.

Bonus points

  • You've shipped or maintained an MCP server, or a CLI designed for both humans and agents.

  • You've worked on developer experience in a product company.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care about how you think, how you build, and how you raise the level of the system around you.

Technologies and tools we use daily

  • TypeScript (NodeJS)

  • React

  • AWS

  • SST

  • Serverless architecture

  • PostgreSQL

  • LangChain / LangGraph

  • Playwright / Vitest

  • GitHub Actions

  • Cursor / Claude Code / Codex

How we hire

Our process tests what the job actually involves.

  1. Intro call with our talent partner.

  2. Technical exercise - you'll work in TypeScript, and we look at async behaviour and code quality alongside the AI-specific parts.

  3. System design. Deliberately not AI-specific. We want to see how you think about APIs, servers, databases, and architecture in general.

  4. Meet the team, including your future manager.

You're welcome to use AI tools throughout. That's how we work, so it's how we interview.

What are the perks? 🎉

  • MacBook: get top-notch tech to work with.

  • Home office budget: set up your ideal workspace.

  • Yoga classes: online and onsite, 3x a week.

  • Yearly company gatherings to connect with international teams.

Other benefits may depend on the country you're based in.

Work across borders. Come together in Paris 🌍

We’re an international team, with Paris as our hub for collaboration and connection. Every quarter, everyone at Prismic meets in Paris for our In-Office Week. To build together, share ideas and have fun as a team. Attendance is expected, with dates shared well in advance so everyone can plan.

You’ll work from your country of employment, with arrangements depending on your role and location:

  • Based in Paris: join us in the office once a week.

  • Elsewhere in France: join us in Paris once a month.

  • Outside France: work primarily remotely, alongside our quarterly Paris get-togethers.

Ready to help build the future of the web?

Apply now to become a Senior Product Engineer at Prismic and help us make publishing a team effort.

raw.description:
About Us

We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.

Our working culture is fast-moving, hands-on and shaped by short decision cycles, evolving priorities and limited resources. We need someone who enjoys this environment, takes initiative and remains composed and effective when deadlines are tight or plans change.

You will help shape the product, build the brand and bring the app to market. Initially, you will personally deliver much of the work across marketing, content, partnerships and automation. As the business develops, the role may expand to include building and leading a team.

Job Description

You will play a central role in deciding how the app is positioned, how the brand looks and communicates, which audiences we serve and how the product develops to meet their needs.

Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.

You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.

Exceptional practical expertise in AI is essential. You must be able to use AI to produce high-quality work independently and build reliable content pipelines and automations. n8n and similar tools should be part of your everyday workflow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape the product: Research user needs, competitors and market opportunities. Help define the product's value proposition, contribute to roadmap priorities and turn insights into clear feature proposals and briefs.
  • Improve the user experience: Work with the product and development teams on onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and monetization. Help define experiments and assess whether changes improve the experience.
  • Build the brand: Develop brand positioning, messaging, tone of voice, visual direction and storytelling. Translate these into a consistent identity across the app and all marketing channels.
  • Own go-to-market: Develop and execute the pre-launch, launch and growth strategy, including target audiences, market selection, channel priorities and campaign planning.
  • Create marketing content: Personally plan, produce, edit and publish the content the business needs, including websites, landing pages, social posts, advertising assets, graphics, email campaigns, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts and other short-form video.
  • Build content pipelines: Use AI and automation to support research, scripting, visual production, video editing, repurposing, publishing and performance analysis while maintaining creative quality.
  • Develop influencer marketing: Identify suitable creators, establish relationships, negotiate collaborations, develop campaign briefs and measure results.
  • Establish partnerships: Find and develop relevant brand, community, event and distribution partnerships that support awareness, trust and user acquisition.
  • Drive measurable growth: Run acquisition and lifecycle experiments across paid, organic, referral and community channels. Connect marketing activity to activation, retention and commercial outcomes.
  • Automate operations: Build and maintain n8n workflows and integrations that reduce repetitive work across marketing, content production, partnerships and reporting.
  • Support future team growth: As needs and resources develop, help identify hiring priorities, document effective workflows and onboard colleagues or external specialists.

Required Qualifications

  • Substantial hands-on experience launching and growing consumer mobile apps, with a demonstrable personal contribution to apps reaching six-, seven- or eight-figure download totals.
  • Evidence of your own impact: the decisions you owned, the work you delivered and the measurable results achieved.
  • Experience contributing directly to product development through user research, feature definition, prioritization, experimentation and collaboration with designers and developers.
  • Strong brand-building ability, including positioning, messaging, visual judgment and consistent execution across product and marketing.
  • Exceptional practical AI skills across research, writing, design, image generation, video production, editing and content workflows.
  • The ability to independently produce marketing content across multiple formats, including social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, websites and advertising creatives.
  • Hands-on experience with influencer marketing, creator collaborations and partnership development.
  • Strong practical knowledge of n8n or comparable automation platforms, including APIs, webhooks, integrations and reliable workflow operation.
  • A solid understanding of mobile acquisition, attribution, activation, retention, customer acquisition cost and lifetime value.
  • The judgment to prioritize the channels and activities that matter most, balancing quality, speed and limited startup resources.
  • A willingness to take ownership across disciplines and personally execute the work required at an early-stage business.
  • Resilience under pressure, strong prioritization skills and the ability to maintain quality and sound judgment during demanding launch phases.
  • Comfort working with uncertainty, changing priorities and limited startup resources, with the confidence to communicate trade-offs, flag constraints early and propose practical solutions.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Experience with dating apps, social discovery products or consumer platforms that depend on network effects.
  • Growing mobile apps to millions or tens of millions of downloads.
  • Taking a product from pre-launch through launch and subsequent growth.
  • Building local user density, communities and market-by-market launch strategies.
  • Developing a brand from the beginning and carrying it consistently into the product experience.
  • Building a YouTube presence, repeatable video formats or creator-led acquisition channels.
  • Establishing partnerships that delivered measurable distribution, engagement or revenue.
  • Growing from an individual contributor into a team leadership role within a startup.

What We Offer

  • A central role in shaping the product, brand and market launch of a new mobile dating app.
  • Broad responsibility across creative work, product decisions, marketing and growth.
  • The opportunity to build practical systems and workflows from the beginning.
  • The potential to help build and lead a team as the business grows.

How to Apply

Please share your CV and selected examples demonstrating:

  • Mobile apps you helped launch or scale, their download totals and your personal contribution.
  • Product decisions or improvements you helped shape, including the user insight behind them and the outcome.
  • Branding and marketing content you personally created, ideally covering multiple formats.
  • AI-powered content workflows or automations you built.
  • Influencer campaigns or partnerships you developed and the results they produced.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please respect the confidentiality of previous employers and clients.

Role Title: Senior Metallurgist / Welding Inspector

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (US based preferred)

We are engaging expert Senior Metallurgists and Welding Inspectors to participate in a high-impact project for a customer in advanced manufacturing and materials engineering. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Evaluate and interpret metallographic microstructures to determine material acceptability and conformance to standards.
  2. Conduct heat treatment process analysis and acceptance reviews in accordance with AMS 2750, ASTM E112, and related US specifications.
  3. Assess weld quality through macro etch evaluation and apply CWI acceptance criteria to real-world case studies.
  4. Perform coating inspection tasks aligned with NACE/AMPP and SSPC protocols, ensuring surface integrity and protection requirements are met.
  5. Review and disposition additive manufacturing (LPBF) defects based on detailed build and cross-sectional data.
  6. Provide clear, well-documented written and verbal feedback on accept/reject decisions, supporting data-driven insights for AI model training.
  7. Reference and apply NADCAP, AWS, ASTM, and AMS standards to a variety of metal samples, weldments, coatings, and AM builds.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. At least 8 years of hands-on experience making high-stakes accept/reject calls on micrographs, weld macros, fracture surfaces, coatings, or LPBF additive builds.
  2. Advanced knowledge of US and international standards including ASTM, AMS, AWS, NADCAP, NACE/AMPP, and SSPC.
  3. Current or prior AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) credentials, or equivalent metallurgical certification.
  4. Proven experience in metallographic analysis, heat treatment evaluation, weld inspection, and industrial coating assessment.
  5. Familiarity with additive manufacturing processes, especially laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) and associated defect mechanisms.
  6. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a keen eye for detail and the ability to explain technical reasoning clearly.
  7. Experience in remote or digital project collaboration, with strong self-direction and accountability for deliverables.

How to apply

Apply here with your profile. We will then email you a link to complete yourapplication on the hiring platform — your application is only considered oncethat final step is done.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As a Cyber & AI Risk Analyst, you will play a critical role in strengthening Alpaca’s security, compliance, and AI risk posture across the organization. Reporting to the Cyber GRC Lead, you will support the identification, assessment, and documentation of cybersecurity and AI-related risks that impact our infrastructure, products, trading systems, and internal operations.

You will contribute to the design and execution of our risk management framework across traditional cyber domains (cloud security, infrastructure, application security, third-party risk, regulatory compliance) while also helping establish foundational governance controls for AI systems, models, and AI-enabled product features.

This role sits at the intersection of cybersecurity, emerging AI governance, regulatory expectations, and financial services risk management. You’ll collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and IT teams to ensure Alpaca remains resilient, compliant, and forward-looking in how we manage both Cyber and AI risk.

We’re looking for someone curious, organized, and eager to grow. If you enjoy learning how technical systems work, translating risk into clear language, and building structured programs from the ground up, then this role is for you. Prior GRC experience is a plus, but not required; we’re happy to invest in the right candidate.

Things You Get To Do:

  • Support the execution of Alpaca’s cybersecurity risk management program
  • Conduct cyber risk assessments across cloud infrastructure , APIs, trading systems, and internal platforms
  • Assist in identifying, documenting, and evaluating AI-related risks (model risk, data privacy, bias, explainability, adversarial threats, model misuse)
  • Help develop and maintain AI governance controls aligned with evolving regulatory expectations such as the EU AI Act
  • Perform third-party/vendor security and AI risk assessments
  • Contribute to control testing across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, CSA Star, NIST CSF, and emerging AI governance standards
  • Track remediation efforts and maintain risk registers and reporting dashboards
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation and evidence
  • Monitor regulatory developments related to cybersecurity, financial services, and AI governance
  • Help mature policies, standards, and procedures for both cyber and AI domains
  • Support the development of a repeatable AI tool/model evaluation process (intake → review → decision) for new and in-use AI tools
  • Support Alpaca's AI usage guidance and standards, including safe use of AI-enabled developer tools and assistants
  • Help maintain AI logging/monitoring standards (audit logging, evidence) for AI systems
  • Use AI tools in day-to-day work and help test how well AI-related controls are working

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • 1+ years of experience in cybersecurity, risk management, IT audit, GRC, or a related field - internships, coursework, or equivalent experience is welcome
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity principles (network security, cloud security, IAM, application security, vulnerability management)
  • Familiarity with common frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar
  • Understanding of AI/ML concepts and associated risks (data governance, model bias, hallucinations, prompt injection, model misuse, etc.) - you don’t need to be an expert, just curious
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to assess technical risks and clearly communicate them to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering and product teams
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced environment
  • Genuine curiosity about AI and a strong desire to learn, actively experiments with AI tools, and wants to grow AI fluency as the field evolves
  • Comfort using AI tools daily and willingness to learn newer agentic / assistant-based tooling

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Academic background, personal interest, or real world experience in fintech, financial services, or trading platforms
  • Exposure to AI governance, model risk management, or responsible AI programs
  • Familiarity with emerging AI regulatory frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act concepts, model governance practices)
  • Experience with GCP or other major cloud platforms
  • Experience supporting or observing SOC 2, ISO 27001, or regulatory audits
  • Security certifications (e.g., Security+, SSCP) or early-stage GRC certifications
  • Interest in pursuing advanced certifications (CISA, CRISC, CISSP, or AI governance certifications)
  • Experience working remotely or in distributed teams
  • Hands-on experience with AI/agentic tooling (e.g., AI coding assistants, LLM apps, or similar)
  • Personal projects or self-study in AI/ML that show initiative and interest

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

raw.title: Financial Analyst - Accounting & Advisory
raw.excerpt: About the ClientWe’re helping a boutique professional services and advisory firm based in Nassau, The Bahamas find a Financial Analyst to support its growing portfolio of clients.
raw.description:
About the Client

We’re helping a boutique professional services and advisory firm based in Nassau, The Bahamas find a Financial Analyst to support its growing portfolio of clients.

The firm works with entrepreneurs, established businesses, institutions, and international clients across strategic and financial advisory, corporate services, accounting and bookkeeping, back-office administration, and project management. Its clients span a variety of industries, including healthcare, professional services, government, and other service-based businesses.

The Role

We’re looking for a Financial Analyst – Accounting & Advisory to support the financial reporting, analysis, and research that underpin the firm's strategic advisory work.

The role sits at the intersection of accounting operations, financial analysis, and advisory support. You’ll work across multiple client businesses, preparing and analyzing P&Ls, balance sheets, cash flow statements, monthly financial packs, and straightforward forecasts while ensuring the senior advisory team has accurate and well-structured financial information to work from.

This is not primarily a valuation or complex financial modeling role. Instead, you'll develop a strong understanding of the financial operations of different businesses and turn their numbers into useful insights and structured outputs that support strategic decision-making.

There may also be research, commercial analysis, and project work depending on the needs of each client. As you develop, there is an opportunity to become increasingly involved in the strategic advisory side of the business.

Role Details

Commitment: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Working Hours: Bahamas working hours

Location: Fully Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Start Date: ASAP

Monthly Rate: $1,800-$2,400 (can be higher, depending on level of experience)

What You’ll Do

Financial Reporting & Accounting Support

  • Prepare and maintain P&Ls, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and other financial reports across multiple client accounts.

  • Prepare recurring monthly financial and management reporting packs using established templates and processes.

  • Review and organize financial information to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

  • Analyze financial performance and identify relevant trends, movements, discrepancies, and areas requiring attention.

  • Support the financial back-office requirements of non-finance businesses across different industries.

  • Maintain well-organized financial information and supporting documentation across client accounts.

  • Learn and work with client-specific accounting systems, processes, and proprietary software where required.

Forecasting & Financial Analysis

  • Prepare and maintain straightforward financial forecasts and projections.

  • Support cash flow planning and other forward-looking financial analysis.

  • Analyze historical and current financial performance to help inform business decisions.

  • Assist with financial analysis relating to commercial credit, loan financing, and other business requirements where needed.

  • Translate financial data into clear and structured information for senior team members.

  • Flag unusual movements, inconsistencies, or areas that warrant further investigation.

The modeling requirements for this role are relatively straightforward. You won't be expected to build complex valuation or transaction models; the emphasis is on strong financial fundamentals, accurate reporting, practical forecasting, and understanding what the numbers mean for the business.

Strategic Advisory & Research Support

  • Prepare financial information and analysis used by senior team members in client-facing strategic advisory work.

  • Conduct business, financial, market, or industry research where required for client assignments.

  • Gather and structure information needed to support strategic recommendations.

  • Help turn financial and research findings into clear reports, presentations, and other client-facing materials.

  • Support senior team members with ad hoc analysis for different business challenges and opportunities.

  • Develop an understanding of each client's business model, operations, and commercial environment rather than looking at financial information in isolation.

Client & Project Support

  • Work across multiple client accounts and adapt to different industries, business models, and reporting requirements.

  • Support project coordination, documentation, and follow-up across advisory engagements.

  • Manage recurring deliverables and ensure financial information is prepared accurately and on time.

  • Assist with broader analytical and administrative requirements connected to client projects.

  • Take increasing ownership of client work as your understanding and capabilities develop.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Ideally 3–5 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, accounting, FP&A, management reporting, corporate services, or a similar finance-focused environment. However, practical capability is more important to us than a specific number of years.

  • Academic background in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of P&Ls, balance sheets, and cash flow statements and how they work together.

  • Hands-on experience preparing and analyzing financial reports and management information.

  • Comfortable preparing straightforward forecasts and financial projections.

  • Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills and confidence working with financial data.

  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

  • Ability to identify trends, inconsistencies, and relevant insights from financial information.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients, assignments, and deadlines.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, and recognize when issues need to be escalated.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in professional services, corporate consultancy, accounting, FP&A, or financial advisory.

  • Experience supporting multiple external client accounts.

  • Experience working with SMEs or service-based businesses.

  • Exposure to healthcare, medical, dental, government, or other professional-services clients.

  • Understanding of commercial lending, loan financing, or credit analysis.

  • Experience preparing management reports and financial projections.

  • Previous exposure to strategic advisory or consulting projects.

  • Experience conducting business, market, or industry research.

  • Experience managing or supporting financial back-office operations for non-finance businesses.

  • Experience working across multiple industries.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You’re someone who is strong with numbers but also interested in the business behind them.

You can confidently work with P&Ls, balance sheets, and cash flows, prepare reliable financial reporting, maintain forecasts, and spot when something doesn’t look right. At the same time, you’re curious about why the numbers are moving and what they mean for the business.

You may come from accounting, FP&A, financial analysis, consulting, or even a more traditional financial analyst background. What matters most is that you're comfortable with the practical financial work involved and genuinely interested in supporting businesses across a range of financial and strategic challenges.

This could also be a good fit for someone with a more modeling- or transaction-oriented finance background who is looking to move into a role with less emphasis on complex modeling and transactions and greater exposure to ongoing business operations and strategic advisory.

You’re organized, adaptable, commercially curious, and comfortable switching between financial reporting, forecasting, research, and project work across different client engagements.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a reliable extension of the advisory team who can independently manage high-quality financial preparation and analysis across multiple clients.

You’ll progressively reduce the financial preparation required from senior team members by ensuring reports, financial packs, forecasts, research, and supporting information are accurate, well-structured, and ready for use in strategic discussions.

As your understanding of the clients and advisory work develops, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility across financial analysis, research, strategic advisory, and project support.

Why Join?

  • Gain exposure to the financial operations and strategic challenges of multiple businesses and industries.

  • Work closely with experienced professionals on real-world client advisory engagements.

  • Build experience beyond traditional accounting or financial reporting into research and strategic advisory.

  • Take meaningful ownership of client work rather than being limited to one narrow finance function.

  • Develop a broader understanding of how financial information supports business strategy and decision-making.

  • Opportunity to grow into greater advisory and project responsibilities over time.

  • Join a fully remote team with a long-term opportunity for professional development.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview with Bamboo Works

  2. Client Interview

  3. Practical Financial Assessment for Finalists

  4. Offer & Onboarding

The practical assessment will take place after the client interview stage and will only be completed by final shortlisted candidates.

raw.title: Product Lead, Self-Serve Growth - Remote
raw.excerpt: About ZyteZyte is a leader in web data extraction.
raw.description:
About Zyte

Zyte is a leader in web data extraction. Our full-stack Zyte API and world-class data services help thousands of companies, from individual developers to global enterprises, turn the web into reliable, structured data. We're a remote-first, globally distributed team that ships fast and lets results speak.

This is a transformative moment for web data, and AI is reshaping both sides of the market. The world needs web data more than ever: to train models, power agents and feed AI applications, so the audience for web data is exploding - creating new personas and new buying journeys almost overnight. At the same time AI is changing how that data is collected - from manual work by engineers to automation with AI.

Zyte is unique in solving both challenges of web data - the software needed for reliable access to websites and the AI and skills needed to turn web content into structured data. We have an important mission in the AI revolution.

The role

We're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to lead our self-serve acquisition and growth journeys across the channels used by personas hungry for web data. Our users are engineers, data teams and the builders of AI agents, and your job is to understand what they seek, what they try first and what convinces them to stay.

You'll lead conversion and growth across channels: our website, agents an the developer ecosystem. You'll be product owner for the website and application UI and will take a data driven approach to customer acquisition and growth, from traffic through trial, activation and subscription, right up to an account-managed relationship.

Our goal is to engage 500,000 developers next year who need web data and this role is central to converting them. In this role you'll shape the rhythm of funnels and experiments, ideating and iterating with a talented team on how we can improve experiences, find truths in data and build on the insight of customers to figure out the next growth step. You'll be fascinated by how engineers evaluate tools, how AI is changing the way they build and what it takes to earn their trust. You'll work to explode an audience in a market that is itself exploding, and to be able to point at the growth curve and say "I did that".

What you'll do

Manage the self-serve funnel end-to-end. Define, measure and improve every stage: signup, trial, activation, conversion to paid and expansion.

Be product owner for the website and product UI. Set the roadmap and priorities for our web presence and platform UX, working directly with the development lead, engineers and designers to ship improvements that capture demand and drive funnel activity.

Optimise the funnel as a conversion mechanism - design and run experiments, work closely with our design and product marketing teams on formats, copy and narratives for conversion.

Optimise PLG journeys that start in the developer ecosystem. Optimise the buying journeys that begin in open source and in the emerging ecosystems of agents, turning developer adoption and ecosystem presence into activation and growth. This means deeply understanding developer workflows: docs, SDKs, code examples and the first ten minutes of hands-on experience.

Build intelligent customer data and nurture growth. Build customer data based on usage and firmographics, and use this to nurture customers for growth with tailored onboarding, relevant content and (with our RevOps function) identify when our sales professionals should reach out and make contact. .

Run a rigorous experimentation practice. Develop hypotheses, ship A/B tests and funnel experiments, and report results honestly, doubling down on what works and killing what doesn't.

Requirements

  • Proven results driving growth and managing funnels in a B2B SaaS or developer-focused business with a self-serve or PLG motion.
  • A deep curiosity about how engineers work and adopt tools. You've marketed or built for technical audiences and know that developers don't respond to marketing; they respond to products that respect their time.
  • Experience with developer tools, APIs, data products or technical audiences.
  • You prototype your own ideas: you use AI coding tools to vibe-code experiments, mockups and working demos rather than waiting for engineering capacity.
  • A track record of making websites effective engines for capturing demand and driving funnel activity; you've owned conversion, not just traffic.
  • Demonstrated success in customer growth and nurture: activation, free-to-paid conversion, expansion and churn reduction.
  • Intelligent, practical use of data: comfortable defining metrics, instrumenting funnels, segmenting customers and combining product signals with messaging and human outreach.
  • Experience working as a product owner or growth PM with engineering and design teams: writing clear requirements, prioritising ruthlessly and shipping iteratively.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; you can align marketing, product, CS, RevOps and sales around a shared funnel.
  • 5–8+ years in growth, growth product management or lifecycle/funnel roles.

Nice to have

  • You've written production code or contributed to open source.
  • Familiarity with experimentation platforms, product analytics (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), marketing automation and CRM tooling.
  • Experience building product-led sales (PQL) motions or platform-to-enterprise upgrade paths.

How we'll measure sucess

Signup-to-activation rate, trial-to-paid conversion, self-serve revenue and expansion revenue, funnel velocity and the quality of PQLs handed to sales.

Benefits

By joining the Zyte team, you will:

  • Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team
  • Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work
  • Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe
  • Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools

raw.description:
Remote · Part-time (4–6 hours/day) · Pacific Time, 9:00 AM–2:00 PM

About the role

Our client is a vacation rental business that needs a detail-oriented, tech-savvy bookkeeper to keep their books accurate and up to date. You'll own the day-to-day accounting, from reconciliations to owner payouts, and work directly with the owner, with support from an external accountant and a CPA at tax time.

This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership, catches small details before they become problems, and looks for ways to work faster and with fewer errors, using integrations, copy-paste and automation instead of manual data entry.

Requirements

  • Manage the daily bookkeeping in QuickBooks, including transactions coming in from booking platform integrations.
  • Complete bank and account reconciliations accurately and on time.
  • Prepare owner payouts each month, which is the busiest week of the month.
  • Maintain the balance sheet and track the P&L so the owner always has a clear view of the business.
  • Support the CPA with tax preparation, organizing documents and records.
  • Check in daily and send an end-of-day report with what was completed, what's pending and any issues.
  • Spot errors and inconsistencies early and propose better ways to keep the books clean.

What success looks like

  • First month: You've taken ownership of the day-to-day books, you catch the small details, and the owner can trust your accounting work.
  • By month 3: Owner payouts and reconciliations are completed on time, and the balance sheet and P&L are up to date.
  • By month 6: You're supporting the CPA with tax preparation.
  • Tools you will use
    • QuickBooks: primary accounting tool, with integrations from booking platforms
    • Property management system
    • Google Sheets and Google Drive
    • Slack and WhatsApp: daily communication
  • Who you are
    • Experienced bookkeeper or accountant: solid accounting knowledge and hands-on experience with reconciliations, balance sheets and P&L.
    • QuickBooks proficient: comfortable working in QuickBooks every day, including bank feeds and integrations.
    • Strong in spreadsheets: confident with Google Sheets for tracking, reconciling and reporting.
    • Tech-savvy and accurate: you avoid manual entry errors by using integrations, copy-paste and smart workflows.
    • Proactive and self-directed: you take ownership, flag issues before you're asked, and keep the owner informed.
    • Clear communicator: strong written and spoken English, and comfortable sending concise daily updates.
    • Available on Pacific Time from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
  • Strong plus: US tax experience.
  • Nice to have: accounting experience in real estate, vacation rentals (Airbnb, VRBO) or hotels, including owner payouts.
  • Schedule
    • Part-time, 4–6 hours per day, tentatively 9:00 AM–2:00 PM Pacific Time.
    • Steady workload, with one busier week each month during owner payout preparation.
    • Part-time in the long term, with openness to revisit hours as the business grows.

Benefits

  • Fully remote
  • Weekly pay

ELEKS Information Security Office is looking for a Security Operations Supervisor in Lviv, Ternopil, Kyiv, or Ivano-Frankivsk.

Security Operations Supervisor is responsible for designing, implementing and maintenance of ELEKS Security Operations Center (SOC) and related ISMS processes. Specifically, Security Operations Supervisor objective is to ensure efficient execution of Incident Management, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management and Patch Management activities.

REQUIREMENTS

    • Working experience in architecture, design and implementation of security systems and countermeasures (e.g. SIEM, EDR, DLP, UEBA, IDS/IPS, vulnerability scanners, anti-virus and anti-malware, firewalls, encryption)
    • Knowledge of Security Operation Center processes, ability to perform supervision of SOC and perform continuous improvement of its operations
    • Working experience in planning and conducting of technical security audits.
    • Knowledge of Information Security (IS) standards/frameworks (ISO 27001/2, SOC2, Cyber Essentials, PCI DSS, HiTrust), ability to establish IS processes in line with these standards
    • Network architecture, security principles, technologies, and tools
    • Detailed technical knowledge of Windows and UNIX operating systems
    • Virtualization technologies and security
    • Identity and access management principles and technologies
    • Subnetting, DNS,DHCP, VPNs, VLANs, VoIP and other network routing methods
    • Network and web related protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, IPSEC, HTTP, HTTPS, etc.)
    • Solid knowledge of secure coding practices, application security and cryptography technologies, ethical hacking, threat modeling, secure SDLC process
    • Solid knowledge of disaster recovery and business continuity planning
    • Strong analytical and conceptual skills balanced by broad perspective on how security efforts to support realization of business goals and customer satisfaction
    • Proven leadership capabilities and strong communication and interpersonal skills
    • English – upper-intermediate or higher

RESPONSIBILITIES

    • Develop and maintain short- and long-term goals and objectives for ELEKS Security Operations Center aligned with Information Security goals
    • Define activities and projects supporting continuous improvement of ELEKS Security Operations Center, addressing the IS gaps identified and enhancing ELEKS security overall
    • Evaluate new technologies and processes that enhance security capabilities. Design, architect, test, analyze, evaluate and implement new security systems and processes
    • Perform program and project management activities to ensure successful execution of ISMS projects assigned.
    • Coordinate the development and review of ISMS policies relevant to SOC activities and other supporting documents, such as Hardening Baselines, IS standards/procedures
    • Effectively inform stakeholders about the status of the ELEKS information security posture. Perform periodic security reporting (both: executive and technical)
    • Coordinate handling of the information security incidents, coordinate investigation activities, communicate with clients and, if needed, escalate to ELEKS senior management, and contact authorities (Police, CERT-UA, etc.)
    • Plan, control, and perform installation, configuration, technical support and administration of security systems and countermeasures (e.g. SIEM, EDR, DLP, UEBA, IDS/IPS, vulnerability scanners, anti-virus and anti-malware, firewalls, encryption)
    • Supervise and perform system hardening, security testing, and vulnerability management
    • Prevent, detect, investigate and respond to cyber threats for the organization’s assets
    • Build and establish plans and controls to protect digital files and information systems against unauthorized access, modification and/or destruction
    • Coordinate configuration, management and running the phishing simulation campaigns
    • Plan, manage and optimize the capacity of ELEKS SOC
    • Provide leadership, training and technical advice to SOC team. Identify/address training and career development needs, provide feedback and conduct performance assessment of subordinates
    • Management of access rights for SOC by participation in approval, review, and removal of access rights (in case of specialist termination, role change and on a regular basis as per Access Control Policy)
    • Resolve security incidents within the SOC team and, if necessary, perform disciplinary actions in conjunction with HR team
