raw.title: Sr. Director, VAR & Channel Partnerships
raw.excerpt: As Sr.  Director, VAR & Channel Partnerships at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just signing reseller agreements; you are building and leading the global partner channel that lets the world’s AI infrastructure resellers sell tenant isolation without us in the room.
raw.description:
As Sr. Director, VAR & Channel Partnerships at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just signing reseller agreements; you are building and leading the global partner channel that lets the world’s AI infrastructure resellers sell tenant isolation without us in the room.

Enterprises do not buy AI infrastructure one product at a time. They buy it from the reseller who already holds the paper, the services capacity, and the trust. Your first targets are the partners where our path to the money is right now: WWT and Computacenter, then SHI, CDW, and the national and regional VARs that actually sell AI infrastructure. You can pull in distributors, and the OEM and ISV partners your peers own, where they accelerate a deal; the global system integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, EY) stay with the VP.

This is a founding, zero-to-one role on a first-year partner program. You start as an individual contributor: there is no channel to inherit, and you will carry the first partners and the first number yourself. As the channel proves out, you will hire and lead the team that scales it globally. Success is measured in partner-sourced bookings, transacting partners, and registered deals that close. Not in logos signed.

As Sr. Director, VAR & Channel Partnerships, your role will include:

  • Global partner leadership: You will own vCluster’s global VAR and channel partnerships end to end: the strategy, the executive relationships, and the commercial results. You will be vCluster’s senior voice with partner leadership across North America, EMEA, and APJ, and you will decide where we invest and where we do not.

  • Recruitment and activation: You will recruit against a filter, not for coverage. A short list of VARs who can actually source AI infrastructure and platform engineering deals beats a long list who cannot. You will own the path from first conversation to first transaction: agreement, track admission, enablement, first registered deal, and first close. You will also retire non-performing partners without drama. Time from signature to first dollar is your headline metric.

  • Transaction mechanics: You will own the partner commercial model: tier discounts, deal-registration uplift, renewal margin, volume incentives, and named-account bonuses. You will run deal registration and Partner of Record, including regional PoR, active-engagement standards, renewal rights, and conflict resolution that holds up when two partners claim the same account. You will build distribution where it scales the motion, while keeping the quoting and order path clean enough that partners do not route around it.

  • Field alignment: You will make co-sell comp-neutral so our sellers get full quota credit and never fight the channel. You will build named-account maps between vCluster sellers and partner sellers, with deal registration the field trusts. You will give partner sellers a reason to lead with vCluster: margin they can count on, services attach they can sell, and a technical story their SEs can carry.

  • Multi-party plays with the ecosystem: You will connect VAR opportunities to the NVIDIA alliance and the OEM and ISV design wins your peers land, so a WWT or Computacenter seller can quote a validated stack with vCluster already inside it. Where a distributor accelerates a deal, you bring them in.

  • Enablement, marketing, and MDF: You will own sales and technical certification for your partners and hold the tier requirements. You will run joint marketing with pipeline objectives attached: field events, webinars, named-account campaigns, and customer stories. You will approve MDF against pipeline outcomes and enforce proof of performance. Discretionary spend earns its return or it stops.

  • Building the team: You will design the channel organization: the roles, the hiring sequence, and the coverage model by region and partner tier. As partner revenue grows, you will hire and lead partner managers and partner engineers, starting with the roles that unlock the most revenue.

  • Owning the channel number: You will run MEDDPICC on every partner-attached opportunity and inspect pipeline weekly. Partner attribution is queryable from day one; pipeline we cannot query is pipeline we do not have. QBRs run on a fixed cadence with a fixed agenda: bookings against plan, named-account inspection, certification status, marketing execution, renewal health, and the forward-quarter plan. This is a first-year partner program with team MBOs and OKRs. You report your KPIs without being asked: transacting partners, sourced and attached pipeline and bookings, registration volume and win rate, certified resources, and MDF return.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Channel leadership with a number behind it: 8+ years in channel, reseller, or partner sales in infrastructure software, AI infrastructure, or cloud. You have a record of building a partner channel from early stage to producing revenue, ideally across more than one region: partners recruited, activated, and transacting, with the bookings to show for it. You can name the partners you activated and the revenue they produced.

  • Executive partner relationships: Direct, current relationships with leadership at national and regional VARs, not just their field teams. That means WWT, Computacenter, SHI, CDW, Insight, Presidio, AHEAD, ePlus, Connection, Softcat, Mark III, and Pacific Teck. You have the depth to open a conversation in your first week. You know which partners actually sell AI infrastructure and which ones talk about it, and how a VAR makes money and how its sellers get paid. You know what has to be true for a rep to lead with your product instead of the one they already know.

  • Channel mechanics: Working command of tier and discount structures, deal registration, Partner of Record, renewal rights, distribution, and MDF governance. You can defend a discount structure, resolve a channel conflict without losing either partner, and tell a partner no.

  • AI infrastructure fluency: Working understanding of Kubernetes, cloud-native architecture, and GPU and AI infrastructure. Enough depth to earn credibility with a partner SE, and enough range to translate it into margin and services opportunity for their leadership.

  • Builder of teams as well as channels: You are comfortable starting as a player with no team underneath you. You have hired and led partner managers or channel teams before, or you are clearly ready to, and you know which hire comes first and why.

  • Influence without authority: Proven ability to mobilize sales, marketing, legal, and enablement teams on both sides of a partnership without direct organizational control. You write the program terms; you do not forward the ask.

  • Operating rigor and a builder’s instinct: Disciplined qualification (MEDDPICC or equivalent), forecast hygiene, and reporting discipline. You pair this with comfort in an ambiguous, high-velocity environment with no inherited program. You compress timelines rather than manage them. Running an established channel is a different job; we are hiring for the build. A builder, not a caretaker.

Bonus points for:

  • NVIDIA partner ecosystem experience, including NCP and reseller-facing programs

  • Distribution experience with Arrow, TD SYNNEX, Ingram Micro, or regional equivalents

  • Channel experience across EMEA and APJ as well as North America

  • Public sector, sovereign, or regulated-industry channel experience

  • Open-source commercial model experience: how a channel sells against a free tier

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

raw.description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?
If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.
At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.
If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.

ORGANIZATION SUMMARY

World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.
Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

POSITION SUMMARY:

World Relief seeks a Senior Portfolio Development Manager (PDM) for a portfolio of high-impact U.S. offices responsible for more than 70% of the organization's private fundraising revenue that is generated by local offices. As a strategic leader, the PDM serves as the primary liaison between the home office and this designated portfolio, providing support to activate private revenue growth. In this role, you'll guide external engagement strategies that integrate donor development, church partnerships, major donor fundraising, and private fundraising initiatives. PDMs are trusted advisors who ensure each office's plans align with World Relief's broader mission while honoring the unique context and strengths of local teams. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, project management, relationship-building, and mission driven leadership.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

    Strategic Planning & Implementation
  • With U.S. Office Advancement leadership, co-develop and implement integrated Advancement strategies, including church engagement, donor acquisition, and private fundraising to achieve financial goals
  • Provide strategic counsel to each office in the development and execution of major donor fundraising plans, leveraging donor insights, market opportunities, and relationship strategies to increase philanthropic support and long-term donor engagement
  • Guide the execution of donor acquisition and brand amplification strategies tailored to local office strengths and opportunities
  • Lead cross-functional advancement initiatives from strategy through implementation, working with the U.S. Advancement Project Manager to establish clear project plans, timelines, and accountability structures to ensure successful execution across teams, channels, and offices
  • Provide thought leadership to the portfolio of offices, building relational capital and exercising sound judgment in navigating advancement strategy for each office
    • Capacity Building, Coaching & Resourcing the Local Office
  • Monitor and support local offices in achieving quarterly lead and lag indicators and annual fundraising goals comprehensive of donor/church partner acquisition, pipeline development and retention
  • Work with Communications Support Officer (CSO) to identify strengths and gaps in local messaging and branding, including story collection, social media, email marketing, and adherence to brand guidelines
  • Allocate centralized support through the Development Support Officer (DSO) for all breadth stewardship and local office development needs
  • Collaborate with the Church Engagement Manager and Marketing Strategy & Acquisitions Manager to equip local office staff with the strategies, tools, and coaching needed to strengthen church engagement, expand donor acquisition efforts, and accelerate private revenue growth
    • Campaign & Product Leadership
  • Champion the full adoption of major national campaigns across assigned offices— serving as the lead advocate and liaison to ensure every office fully understands, implements, and aligns with campaign goals, messaging, and deliverables
  • Lead campaign readiness and execution across assigned offices, coordinating major donor and mass marketing strategies, managing timelines and deliverables, and ensuring teams have the resources, tools, and support necessary to achieve campaign goals.
    • Tools & Data-Informed Portfolio Development
  • Provide training and support in the use of HubSpot, Dynamics, RENXT and other CRM tools to build and manage donor pipelines and ensure proper usage
  • Assist in portfolio analysis, goal setting, and opportunity tiering to optimize fundraising efforts
  • Coach local fundraising staff on sales processes, meeting scheduling, pitch development, and partner care strategies
  • Act as a liaison with Strategic Partnership Directors, Partnership Trust Impact Team and Corporate and Foundations Team to assist offices in developing proposals, and reports for major donors and foundations as opportunities arise
  • Facilitate cross-office learning and best practice sharing to strengthen national fundraising capacity
  • Provide instruction on portfolio management practices, including use of NXT, annual forecasting, donor strategy guides and portfolio tiering
  • In collaboration with Sales Process and Pipeline team, provide U.S. offices with prospective leads based on and wealth research offering support and training on lead cultivation
    • SUPERVISORY POSITIONS:
    This role is responsible for supervising others and includes responsibilities consistent with supervising employees including but not limited to monitoring daily work activities, tracking and approving timesheets including approving time off, monitoring performance including entering goals, progress check-ins, and weekly or bi-weekly check-ins, documenting performance concerns, entering staff promotions, transitions, and separations in HRIS within required time frame. Managers at World Relief are also considered spiritual leaders and are expected to lead staff in a manner consistent with our Christian values including but not limited to praying with staff, leading devotionals, and fostering a Christian environment in interactions with staff throughout World Relief.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Mature and personal Christian faith
  • Committed to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief
  • Desire to serve and empower the Church to impact vulnerable communities
  • Able to affirm and/or acknowledge World Reliefs Core Beliefs, Statement of Faith, Christian Identity and National Association of Evangelicals' For the Health of The Nation document
  • Bachelors degree, preferably in Business Administration, Non-Profit Management, Marketing, Communications, or a related field
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in nonprofit fundraising including major gift pipeline development
  • 2+ years of direct supervisory experience, including performance management, goal tracking, professional development, and team coaching
  • Strong project management skills with proven track record of seeing projects from ideation through implementation to completion
  • Requires travel to offices across the United States approximately 3-4 times per year, as well as attendance at divisional meetings twice annually

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Results driven orientation with strategic acumen and an ability to shape plans and activities to align with strategic goals
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, leverage personal influence to reach goals, and foster strong collaboration
  • Strong people management skills, with a passion for working through a team to engage stakeholders with giving opportunities
  • Possess excellent communication skills and emotional intelligence, with the ability to step into challenging interpersonal situations, address conflict and maintain long-term relationships
  • Experience with Raisers Edge NXT
  • Experience with HubSpot
  • Experience with Asana
  • Ability to use with fluency all Microsoft programs such as Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook
World Relief offers a competitive benefits package and employee discount program for full-time employees.
World Relief is honored to be recognized with the Gold-level Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation for exceeding the core components of our well-being program including leadership and culture, program foundations and execution, and whole person health.

We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.
For World Relief staff, strong commitment to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief is essential, and Christian faith is a prerequisite for employment, based upon United States federal guidelines provided in Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

Crystalia Glass LLC is a U.S.-based manufacturer and provider of premium custom glass solutions for residential, commercial, and institutional projects. For more than 9 years, we have operated as a full-cycle company, managing every stage of the process—from design and manufacturing to sales, delivery, and installation. With production facilities in both the United States and Europe, we deliver high-quality solutions to customers across the U.S.

As our business continues to grow, we are expanding our Supply Engineering team and are looking for an experienced Supply Engineering Team Lead to help scale our operations, optimize supply processes, and lead a high-performing team.

The Role

The Supply Engineering Team Lead will report directly to the Chief Technical Officer and lead a team of four Supply Engineers.

Approximately 80% of the role focuses on team leadership, coordination, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration, while 20% involves hands-on supply engineering activities to support the team during peak workload, employee absences, or complex projects.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring efficient procurement operations, developing internal processes, and maintaining strong relationships with suppliers across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Please note: previous professional experience working with the US market is required for this position. We are specifically looking for candidates with hands-on procurement/sourcing experience involving US-based suppliers and international markets.

Responsibilities

1. Procurement operations

  • Launch production by coordinating glass orders and ensuring the availability of required hardware and materials.
  • Plan inventory levels and forecast procurement needs.
  • Review technical drawings and specifications to prepare accurate material lists.
  • Verify dimensions, finishes, and quality requirements before placing orders.
  • Track engineering documentation and procurement changes throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure procurement documentation and component orders are completed before production and container arrivals.

2. Supplier management

  • Source, evaluate, and develop relationships with suppliers across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
  • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules.
  • Manage purchasing activities for production, warehouse, and installation operations.
  • Monitor supplier performance and resolve quality, logistics, and delivery issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve procurement efficiency, supplier performance, and cost optimization.

3. Cross-functional collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Project Managers, Engineers, Estimators, Warehouse, and Installation teams.
  • Support engineering changes, material substitutions, and procurement planning.
  • Provide procurement expertise, material recommendations, and pricing information for projects.
  • Ensure purchased materials meet project specifications and technical documentation.

4. Team leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four Supply Engineers.
  • Assign tasks, prioritize workloads, and monitor project deadlines.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings and provide coaching and performance feedback.
  • Review procurement documentation, material lists, and purchase orders prepared by the team.
  • Support engineers with complex sourcing challenges and supplier escalations.
  • Coordinate procurement activities with internal stakeholders across departments.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and optimize procurement workflows.
  • Report progress, risks, and operational updates to the Chief Technical Officer.

Requirements

    • 3+ years of experience in procurement, sourcing, or supply chain within the glass, glazing systems, architectural hardware, or closely related industries.
    • 3+ years of people management experience, including direct leadership of procurement, sourcing, or supply teams.
    • Proven experience building or scaling a procurement/sourcing function from scratch, including processes, workflows, supplier management standards, reporting, KPIs, and team structure.
    • Experience designing and implementing procurement processes, policies, and operating procedures across the full purchasing cycle.
    • Strong experience working with international suppliers and markets, ideally across multiple regions such as Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and North America.
    • Hands-on experience with sourcing and procurement of glass, glazing components, aluminum or steel systems, architectural hardware, fittings, accessories, or other closely related materials.
    • Experience managing supplier relationships, negotiations, pricing, lead times, quality issues, and supply risks.
    • Experience with international logistics, import/export, customs, and cross-border procurement.
    • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and engineering documentation.
    • Experience implementing or improving procurement tools, task management systems, reporting, and cross-functional workflows.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and PDF tools.
    • Fluent English is a must.
    • Fluent Russian will be a plus.

Personal qualities

  • Confident and proactive leader.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • High level of ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Work Location

  • Remote
  • Monday–Friday.
  • Working hours: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • Paid Time Off:
    1. 5 paid vacation days during the first year.
    2. 15 paid vacation days annually starting from the second year.
    3. Paid Sick Leave: 5 days per year.
    4. Protected Time Off: 32 hours per year.

Why Join Crystalia Glass

  • Join a growing U.S.-based company with 9 years of experience delivering custom glass solutions for residential, commercial, and institutional projects.
  • Take ownership of a key operational function and help shape procurement processes as the company continues to scale.
  • Lead a talented Supply Engineering team and make a direct impact on efficiency, collaboration, and business growth.
  • Work closely with executive leadership and have the opportunity to influence decisions and process improvements.
  • Be part of a full-cycle company managing everything from design and manufacturing to sales, delivery, and installation.
  • Work on complex, high-quality custom projects for customers across the United States.
  • Collaborate with an international team and build relationships with suppliers across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
  • Grow professionally in a fast-paced environment where your expertise and ideas can make a real difference.

Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

raw.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Associate Director, Billing Customer Support provides strategic and operational leadership for all patient- and client-facing billing support within Revenue Cycle Management, including the billing contact center, escalated inquiries and complaints, regulatory responses, and billing communications. This role brings billing operations and customer support together into one scalable service model, leading Managers and Supervisors to deliver accurate, compliant, and compassionate billing experiences while improving efficiency and revenue outcomes. The Associate Director partners with RCM, Client Services, Compliance, Finance, and Technology leaders to translate organizational priorities into measurable results. This role may evolve as organizational needs change.

  • Purpose: Unify billing and customer support into a strategic, data-driven function that resolves patient and client billing questions accurately, quickly, and in compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Impact: Patients, providers, and clients; Billing Customer Support Managers, Supervisors, and their teams; RCM leadership and cross-functional partners across Client Services, Compliance, Finance, Quality, Analytics, and Technology.
  • Success: Billing support consistently meets or exceeds service-level, first-contact resolution, quality, and patient satisfaction targets; escalations, complaints, and regulatory inquiries decline and are resolved within required timelines; billing communications are clear and consistent; and leaders are developed and succession-ready.
  • Supervision: Leads Managers, Supervisors, and their teams across billing customer support; accountable for the end-to-end billing support experience.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Strategic Leadership

o Set the vision, strategy, and annual operating plan for billing customer support in alignment with Revenue Cycle Management and organizational goals.

o Integrate billing operations and customer support workflows into a single service model that reduces handoffs and improves first-contact resolution.

o Lead complex initiatives affecting billing workflows, systems, and service channels (e.g., self-service payment options, IVR and omnichannel enhancements) from planning through adoption.

• Operational Excellence & Performance

o Own performance outcomes for billing support, including service levels, average speed of answer, abandonment rate, first-contact resolution, quality scores, and patient satisfaction.

o Partner with RCM leadership to forecast billing contact volume and align staffing models, schedules, and coverage to demand.

o Establish KPI dashboards and analyze trends, root causes, and customer insights to deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, accuracy, and cash outcomes.

  • Customer Experience & Escalation Management

o Serve as the senior escalation point for complex billing inquiries, disputes, and complaints from patients, providers, and clients.

o Oversee timely, compliant resolution of Department of Insurance (DOI), Better Business Bureau (BBB), and other external complaints in partnership with Compliance and internal stakeholders.

o Set standards for clear, patient-friendly billing communications, including notification templates, process overviews, and client-facing resources.

• Leadership & Talent Development

o Lead, coach, and develop Managers and emerging leaders; build succession readiness and bench strength across the function.

o Oversee training, quality assurance, and enablement programs, ensuring documentation and training materials (including visual content) remain current and effective.

o Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

o Act as the key billing support stakeholder for cross-functional initiatives with Client Services, Billing, Finance, Compliance, Quality, Analytics, and Technology.

o Influence decisions on service design, billing system enhancements, and operational readiness to improve the patient and client experience.

• Compliance & Risk Management

o Ensure the team complies with HIPAA, applicable federal and state billing and consumer protection regulations, company policies, and the Baylor Genetics Code of Conduct.

o Identify, mitigate, and report compliance risks and concerns within billing support operations.

  • Perform other duties as assigned to support team and organizational objectives.
  • Comply with all company policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, finance, or a related field
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in Revenue Cycle Management, patient billing, or healthcare customer operations, including 5+ years of people leadership experience leading managers or multiple teams, ideally in a call center or patient communications setting

• No license or certification required

  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into operational plans; strong command of billing processes and contact center performance metrics; strong data analysis and KPI management skills; proven change management, process documentation, and cross-functional leadership experience; working knowledge of HIPAA
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Preferred:

• Master’s degree (e.g., MBA, MHA)

  • Leadership experience in Revenue Cycle Management within a diagnostic, clinical laboratory, or genetic testing environment
  • Certification such as HFMA Certified Revenue Cycle Representative (CRCR), Certified Professional Biller (CPB), Lean/Six Sigma, project management (PMP), or customer experience

COMPETENCIES

  • Strategic Thinking – Connects billing and support operations to revenue and patient experience goals
  • Results Oriented – Owns outcomes across service quality, efficiency, and financial performance
  • Customer Focus & Communication – Translates complex billing topics into clear, patient-friendly language
  • Data-Driven Decision Making – Uses KPIs and trend analysis to make sound, timely decisions
  • Talent Development & Succession Planning – Builds leaders and bench strength
  • Change Management – Leads people and processes through change to adoption

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

• Location: [Onsite / Hybrid / Remote]

  • Physical demands: Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer; frequent use of phone, headset, video conferencing, and keyboard
  • Work environment: Standard office or remote home-office environment; schedule flexibility may be required to support coverage, peak volumes, or business needs
  • Travel Requirements: Minimal (less than 10%); occasional in-person meetings or trainings
  • Special conditions: Regular access to protected health information (PHI) and patient financial information; must complete required HIPAA and privacy training and adhere to all confidentiality requirements

EEO STATEMENT

Baylor Genetics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, childbirth, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you need an accommodation during the application process, please contact our Human Resources team.

Note to Recruiters:

We value building direct relationships with our candidates and prefer to manage our hiring process internally. While we occasionally partner with select recruitment agencies for specialized roles, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or agencies without a written agreement executed by the authorized signatory for Baylor Genetics ("Agreement"). Any resumes submitted to Baylor Genetics in the absence of an Agreement executed by Baylor Genetics' authorized signatory will be considered the property of Baylor Genetics, and Baylor Genetics will not be obligated to pay any associated recruitment fees.

raw.description:
A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr

  • Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities around the world.
  • We are a global team, united by our desire to connect diverse people with common values for boldr impact.

LET’S START WITH OUR VALUES

  • Excellent. Being excellent at what we do sets us apart. It happens when we care about our work and how it lands, set clear standards, and hold each other accountable. We don't stop at meeting the standard; we keep raising the bar.
  • Authentic. Real connection happens when we show up as our best, truest selves, help others do the same, and stand by each other through the harder times.
  • Curious. Curiosity keeps us innovative. Better understanding comes from asking helpful questions, seeking to understand before we act, and building on each other's thinking.
  • Dynamic. Growth is central to our purpose, and it only happens in dynamic environments where we stay flexible, adaptable and open.
  • Empathetic. Great partnerships happen when we take the time to understand the people we work with, our teams, our clients and our communities, for better outcomes for each.

WHAT IS YOUR ROLE

As a Platform Engineering Specialist, you build and run the internal platform that Boldr teams use to ship software safely. You lead our cloud foundations, delivery pipelines and platform security, sharing ownership with the team so more than one person can always run them, so that engineers and non-engineers who build with AI can deploy to secure, governed environments without having to become infrastructure experts.

You will design the paved road: AWS environments, CI/CD, environment promotion, automated security checks, access control and observability. You will work with the Product lead and engineers who build on the platform, turn their needs into reusable tooling, and share your infrastructure knowledge across the team.

You are also a full-stack engineer. Alongside platform work, you will build and ship features across our web applications, APIs and integrations with the rest of the Product team, and pick up whatever the current priority needs.

This is a hands-on senior role. You set direction for your area, make sound technical calls on your own, and are accountable for the reliability, security and cost of the platform and the quality of the code you ship.

You'll be working with the Product Team Lead to deliver technical solutions to deliver Boldrific platform solutions. You will collaborate with producing design decisions, supporting team members on shared goals, and providing guidance on engineering best practices across the Product team to deliver solutions for internal and external stakeholders.

WHY DO WE WANT YOU

We are currently looking for impact-driven individuals who are passionate in helping Boldr grow and achieve our Purpose. We expect our Team to become our ultimate partners to success by always giving their 110% in everything, sharing their talents and quirks, and championing our core values: Curious, Dynamic and Authentic.

WHAT WILL YOU DO

Full-stack product engineering

  • Design, build and maintain web applications, API services, serverless functions and scheduled background jobs, front end and back end.
  • Build custom RESTful APIs, middleware and third-party integrations using webhooks, websockets and queues.
  • Design and manage databases, and work with data teams to improve software functionality.
  • Own projects end to end across the Software Development Life Cycle, from design to deployment.
  • Debug production issues, find root causes and tell code problems apart from data problems.
  • Test and optimize applications for performance and user experience.
  • Review code to enforce coding standards and engineering best practices.

Cloud Foundations

  • Own a multi-account AWS organization (dev, prod and shared accounts): IAM, networking, DNS and certificates (Route 53, ACM), and account guardrails.
  • Define and manage infrastructure as code for all platform environments.
  • Monitor and optimize cloud cost, and report on it.

Delivery and environments

  • Build reusable CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) that teams can adopt by default.
  • Design environment promotion across personal dev, sandbox and production, with automated checks that block promotion when they fail.
  • Automate app provisioning: build, database, health checks, sign-in checks and DNS.

Platform security and access

  • Own the security posture of our GitHub organization: access, branch and Actions policy, OIDC federation to AWS, and secret scanning.
  • Integrate security, secrets and sensitive-data scanning into the delivery path.
  • Work with our central identity provider to give every deployed app consistent authentication and access control.

Reliability and operations

  • Set up logging, monitoring and alerting across platform environments.
  • Lead incident response for platform issues, find root causes and prevent repeats.
  • Write and maintain runbooks and platform documentation that other people can follow.
  • Cross-train teammates so platform work is shared, and prepare areas for handover to future team members.

Team and ways of working

  • Pair with engineers to grow infrastructure and DevOps skills across the team.
  • Take part in technical design, architecture discussions and roadmap planning.
  • Review infrastructure and pipeline changes to enforce standards and best practices.
  • Create, update and manage tickets on a kanban board, and take part in grooming and planning in an Agile Scrum setup.
  • Adopt emerging practices, including AI/LLM-assisted engineering workflows.

Requirements

YOU ARE…

  • Curious and authentic, just like us! #beboldr
  • Proactive and highly self-motivated
  • Able to pay attention to even the most minute of details, while still keeping our long-term vision in mind
  • Able to adapt to change and learn quickly
  • Eager to learn and expand their current working knowledge with regards to other wider aspects of Software Engineering
  • A team player who can communicate with ease and gives and receives feedback with grace
  • Effective in multitasking and prioritizing tasks in a fast-paced and high-pressure environment
  • Thorough functional knowledge and coding experience
  • Creative and solutions-oriented
  • Possesses strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly for complex, multi-system issues.
  • Demonstrates architectural thinking and the ability to design scalable, robust, and maintainable software solutions.

YOU HAVE…

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years in software engineering, including production full-stack development, with 3+ years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps or platform engineering.
  • Strong full-stack skills in TypeScript, JavaScript or Python, with front-end and back-end frameworks (NodeJS, NestJS, Vue/Nuxt or similar).
  • Experience building RESTful APIs, third-party integrations and relational database designs (SQL).
  • Strong hands-on AWS experience: Organizations and multi-account setups, IAM, VPC, ECS or other container services, RDS, CloudWatch, Route 53.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK or CloudFormation).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with Docker and containerized deployments.
  • Experience with secrets management and security scanning in the delivery path.
  • Experience implementing authentication and authorization across systems, ideally with a central identity provider (OIDC/OAuth2).
  • Experience with database administration, backups and scaling in production.
  • Demonstrated understanding of secure and ethical use of LLMs in software development.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in 55 countries, including United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, India, France, Netherlands, Singapore.

Pay: $30–$70/hr

Role Title: Voice Actor/Coaches

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

We are engaging Voice Actor/Coaches to participate in a high-impact project supporting advanced AI voice and speech technology. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Analyze short speech recordings and produce precise, structured written assessments using professional voice terminology.
  2. Identify and describe vocal characteristics such as age, gender, accent or dialect (when confident), vocal quality, resonance, phonation type, pitch, intonation, breath support, rhythm, and tempo.
  3. Evaluate emotional tone, energy, articulation clarity, and overall delivery style, noting nuances between scripted, spontaneous, or conversational samples.
  4. Assess audio production aspects, including room sound, device type (microphone, headset, phone), and recording environment quality (studio or home).
  5. Deliver observations in clear, detailed written reports, using consistent technical language to facilitate AI model training and evaluation.
  6. Collaborate asynchronously via digital platforms, providing objective, high-quality input to enhance voice and speech systems.
  7. Maintain confidentiality and accuracy throughout all analyses and documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Professional background in voice acting, voice coaching, dialect coaching, vocal pedagogy, or similar fields.
  2. Strong understanding of speech analysis, prosody, intonation, phonetics, accent and dialect variation, and vocal quality assessment.
  3. Experience with audio or sound engineering, especially in evaluating recording quality and acoustic environments.
  4. Familiarity with technical vocal concepts such as resonance, placement, and breath control.
  5. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
  6. Fluency in English (B2 or higher); native proficiency in any language is welcome.
  7. Reliable internet connection and high-quality headphones to ensure accurate audio assessment.

Why join: This is an opportunity to contribute your specialized knowledge to a pioneering AI initiative, rewarding true voice expertise. You'll influence cutting-edge technology while enjoying flexible, remote participation and engaging, meaningful work that values accuracy, nuance, and a passion for the art and science of voice.

About TaskUs:TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.


The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.


It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment’s notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.


What We Offer:At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.

Job Description

What can you expect in an Associate Data Engineer role with TaskUs:

So what does an Associate Data Engineer do? Think of yourself as someone responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines, and data warehouses for use by the analytics infrastructure, so not just anyone is qualified for this role! We make sure we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our employees are top-notch. So come on, now we need your full concentration because it’s time to imagine what it’s like being an Associate Data Engineer.

Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: you will assist in making accurate and meaningful data available for consumption of TaskUs Business Intelligence reporting methodology. As you tackle your new tasks for the day, you know that it will lead to one thing: that everything you do is to meet an enterprise’s data delivery, business analysis, and reporting needs.

Key Responsibilities:

As an Associate Data Engineer, you will:

  • Configure

    • Configures and sets up solutions based on pre-approved patterns to move data from operational and external environments to the business intelligence environment.

    • Management of data integration & ETL jobs – consolidation, aggregation, filtering, validation, data quality routines, dimension creation, etc.

    • Configure and Deploy automation of jobs based on pre-approved and reusable patterns framework. Executes production-level jobs by considering data dependencies, schedules, validation routines, data stream updates.

    • Design, develop and verify the data model according to the business requirements, and continuously optimize the model.

    • Collaborate with technical users to define data requirements & establish business rules to be applied

    • Collaborate with key business stakeholders to deliver and continually enhance the BI platform to provide relevant and accurate insights through the delivery of new datasets

  • Test

    • Validate and verify the data model according to the business requirements, and continuously optimize the model.

    • Performs unit and system integration testing, on development projects.

    • Undertaking peer reviews, assisting with testing, and ensuring documentation is current.

  • Monitor

    • Monitor Error Handling and Logging tools and processes. Troubleshoot configuration and data errors.

    • Monitor Performance and raise appropriate flags.

    • Identify opportunities to optimize the ETL environment, and implement monitoring, quality, and validation processes to ensure data accuracy and integrity.

Qualifications:

  • At least 2 years of experience in Data Engineering.

  • Knowledgeable with Python, Apache Kafka, AWS Redshift, AWS Glue, AWS S3, and Pentaho Data Integration.

  • Strong knowledge of Data Warehousing concepts with understanding of traditional and MPP database designs, star and snowflake schemas with at least 2 years of data modeling.

  • At least 2 years of hands-on development experience using ETL Tools such as Pentaho, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Fivetran or Airflow.

  • Knowledge on the architecture, design and implementation of MPP Databases such as Teradata, Snowflake or Redshift.

  • 3-year development using Cloud-based analytics solutions preferable AWS or GCP.

  • Knowledge of designing and implementing streaming pipelines using Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, or Segment.

  • Knowledgeable in Database Tuning and ETL tuning.

  • Experience of using Python in a cloud-based environment is preferred.

  • Knowledge on NoSQL DBs is preferred.

  • Knowledge, experience and exposure to AI tools is preferred but not required.

  • Someone who has the ability to work effectively across internal functional areas in ambiguous situations.

  • Someone who is a structured thinker and effective communicator.

Education / Certifications:

  • Bachelor's/College Degree in Computer Science/Information Technology, Engineering (Computer/Telecommunication) or 4-8 years experience in place of a degree.

Work Location / Work Schedule / Travel:

  • Site Location: Any TaskUs IND Site (Remote)

  • Work Setup: Work from Home

As the largest private-sector power producer in the world and the nation's largest producer of clean and reliable energy, Constellation is focused on our purpose: lighting the way to a brilliant tomorrow for all. We have been the leader in clean energy production for more than a decade, and we are cultivating a workplace where our employees can grow, thrive, and contribute. Now integrated with Calpine, our portfolio includes 55 gigawatts of capacity from nuclear, natural gas, geothermal, hydro, wind and solar facilities, with the generating capacity to power the equivalent of 27 million homes.

Our culture and employee experience make it clear: We are powered by passion and purpose. Together, we're creating healthier communities and a cleaner planet, and our people are the driving force behind our success. At Constellation, you can build a fulfilling career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact. By doing our best work and meeting new challenges, we can accomplish great things. Join us in meeting the country's energy needs today and tomorrow.


Total Rewards

Constellation offers an extensive selection of benefits and rewards to help our employees thrive professionally and personally. We provide competitive compensation and a wide-range of benefits that support both employees and their families, helping them prepare for the future. In addition to highly competitive salaries, eligible employees are offered a bonus program, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase program; comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, including robust wellbeing programs; disability and life insurance benefits; paid time off for vacation, holidays, and sick days; and much more.

Expected salary range of $122,400 to $136,000, varies based on experience, along with comprehensive benefits package that includes bonus and 401(k).

Primary Purpose of Position

Performs advanced technical/engineering problem solving in support of Power plant operations. Responsible for technical decisions. Possesses excellent knowledge in functional discipline and its practical application and has detailed knowledge of applicable industry codes and regulations.

Primary Duties and Accountabilities

  • Provide remote technical support, troubleshooting equipment failures, reviewing root cause investigations, and coordinating corrective actions with site teams, OEMs, and contractors.
  • Provide in-depth technical expertise to develop, manage and implement engineering analysis, activities and programs.
  • Provide technical expertise and consultation through direct involvement to identify and resolve equipment and system problems.
  • Provide complete task management of engineering issues.
  • Perform engineering tasks as assigned by supervision applying engineering principles.
  • Accountable for the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of work ensuring proper configuration management and assuring that standard design criteria, practices, procedures and codes are used in preparation of plans and specifications.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering (Chemical, Civil/Structural, Electrical, Industrial, or Mechanical) with 5 years technical experience or related engineering experience
  • Maintain minimum access requirements, as applicable, and favorable medical examination and/or testing in accordance with position duties

Preferred Qualifications

Proficiency in leading cross functional initiatives at an asset/plant.

  • Familiarity with electrical protection and controls, SCADA, plant controls/PPC, and utility/grid interconnection requirements.
  • Knowledge of applicable IEEE, NFPA, NEC, NERC standards
  • Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to oversee multiple operating sites and technical issues simultaneously.
  • Strong working knowledge of solar PV and battery energy storage technologies, including inverters, PCS, BMS, MV collection systems, transformers, switchgear, and substation equipment.

In this role, you will lead a dedicated team of product managers while partnering with Engineering, UX/Design, and Go-To-Market teams to deliver mission-critical reporting capabilities for CFOs, Chief Sustainability Officers (CSOs), ESG controllers, and Risk leaders worldwide.


Our platform serves as the single source of truth for enterprise trust and transparency. We are seeking a leader who can translate evolving global sustainability regulations into intuitive, audit-ready workflows while operationalizing pragmatic AI capabilities—including agentic workflows and automated disclosures—to reduce manual operational burdens for global enterprises.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Customer-Centric Vision: Serve as the strategic voice of sustainability stakeholders—including CFOs, CSOs, and ESG controllers—translating complex reporting workflows into a cohesive, high-impact product roadmap

The Commercial Manager serves as the operational backbone for the company, taking full operational ownership of job costing, progress billing, cash flow forecasting, and renewable project administration. Solar & Renewable Energy Operations Administration

Requirements

  • 5+ years of direct experience in construction commercial management, project financial control, contract administration, or quantity surveying within an electrical, civil, or commercial subcontracting business.
  • Demonstrated mastery of construction job costing, including tracking daily labor burn rates, WIP (Work In Progress) allocations, and material reconciliation.
  • Proven hands-on experience submitting progress claims and variations under standard commercial subcontracts and Australian statutory requirements.
  • Proficiency with cloud accounting and construction platforms, specifically Xero, SimPRO (or equivalent systems like Jobpac, AroFlo, or Procore), and advanced Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong commercial diplomacy: the assertiveness to track down supplier invoices, negotiate claim certifications with head contractors, and enforce timesheet compliance with field teams.
  • High autonomy: track record of establishing financial processes and reporting cadences from the ground up without daily supervision.

raw.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Security Architect versterk je de secure-by-design besluitvorming binnen een complex en onderling verbonden landschap van applicaties, integraties, platformen en cloud- en hybride omgevingen. Je vertaalt securitybeleid en risicovereisten naar praktische architectuurprincipes, referentiepatronen en ontwerpgerichte richtlijnen.

Positionering van de rol

Je werkt nauw samen met enterprise- en solutionarchitecten, ontwikkelteams, platformteams en andere relevante stakeholders. De rol is functioneel afgestemd op de informatiebeveiligingsfunctie en ondersteunt de vertaling van securityvereisten naar architectuur en ontwerp.

De CISO of verantwoordelijke voor informatiebeveiliging blijft verantwoordelijk voor beleid, controlframeworks, risicogovernance en formele risicoaanvaarding. Jij vertaalt deze vereisten naar architectuurstandaarden, ontwerprichtlijnen en oplossingsgerichte aanbevelingen. Structurele risico’s en terugkerende control gaps escaleer je waar nodig naar de CISO en de bevoegde governanceorganen.

Kernverantwoordelijkheden

  • Definiëren, onderhouden en uitdragen van securityarchitectuurprincipes, standaarden en herbruikbare referentiepatronen.
  • Beoordelen van ontwerpen voor applicaties, API’s, integraties, platformen, cloudoplossingen en hybride oplossingen op basis van securityvereisten en architecturale good practices.
  • Vertalen van beleids-, risico- en compliancevereisten naar praktische architectuurrichtlijnen en ontwerpbeslissingen.
  • Adviseren over identity and access management, authenticatie, autorisatie, secrets- en keymanagement, encryptie, logging, monitoring en auditability.
  • Ondersteunen van threat modeling, architectuurrisicobeoordelingen en secure-by-design besluitvorming tijdens de project- en productlevenscyclus.
  • Begeleiden van teams bij veilige integratiepatronen, zero-trustprincipes, segmentatie en securitycontrols voor moderne gedistribueerde omgevingen.
  • Bijdragen aan de doelarchitectuur voor security binnen cloud- en hybride platformen.
  • Identificeren van structurele securityrisico’s, ontwerpzwaktes en terugkerende tekortkomingen, en deze escaleren naar de passende governanceorganen en stakeholders.
  • Samenwerken met architecten, engineeringteams en securitystakeholders om de consistentie, schaalbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid van securityontwerpbeslissingen te verbeteren.
  • Bijdragen aan architectuurgovernance door duidelijke securityinput te leveren voor projecten, roadmaps en belangrijke wijzigingen.

📝 Jouw profiel

Je hebt aantoonbare relevante ervaring als Security Architect en als enterprise-architect met een specialisatie in informatiebeveiliging. Daarnaast beschik je over de volgende kennis en ervaring:

  • Ervaring met secure design reviews, architectuurbeoordelingen en threat modeling.
  • Sterke architecturale en conceptuele vaardigheden.
  • Kennis van securitykaders zoals ISO 27001/27002, NIS2 en CyFun.
  • Kennis en ervaring met MS Office-pakketten.
  • Ervaring met business solutioning en het voorstellen van kosteneffectieve businessoplossingen die aansluiten bij de security risk appetite van de organisatie.
  • Ervaring binnen de publieke sector, gereguleerde omgevingen of omgevingen met hoge assurance-eisen, bijvoorbeeld met toepassing van het informatieclassificatieraamwerk van de Vlaamse overheid.
  • Ervaring met het uitvoeren en coördineren van pentesten en met het gebruik van AI-securitytools.
  • Kennis van federatieve identiteitsoplossingen en publieke bouwstenen zoals ACM/IDM op basis van SAML en OpenID Connect.
  • Kennis van security binnen Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure en hybride cloudomgevingen.
  • Je beheerst het Nederlands op Europees CEFR-niveau C2.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Metronome is the leading usage-based billing platform built for modern software companies. With Metronome, now a Stripe product, companies can launch products faster, offer any pricing model, and streamline finance workflows without writing code.

Our platform computes hundreds of millions of invoices per billing period and continues to scale rapidly to accommodate new customers. We save them days of development time and manual invoicing, enabling them to use their billing data to better serve their customers. Our customers love our product and approach, and we’re humbled to work with amazing companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, NVIDIA, TogetherAI, HuggingFace, and many others.

You'll be joining an experienced team that includes founders who have successfully built and sold startups before. Our Stripes have direct experience building and scaling teams through massive growth at companies like Dropbox, Palantir, and MongoDB. You'll be joining Stripe and be part of the holistic Stripe platform approaching monetization.

What you’ll do

The Metronome AI Native Solutions team operates at the intersection of technical sales, implementation, and customer success, purpose-built for the velocity and unique needs of AI-first companies. Unlike traditional sales engineering roles, this position owns the large parts of if not all of the deal cycle - from first call through technical win - and gets hands-on with implementation to ensure customers go live quickly.

As an AI Native Solutions Architect, you'll be the primary technical owner for fast-moving AI companies that may need to launch usage-based billing on tight timelines. This means:

Owning the technical win:

  • Taking qualified inbound leads and driving them through discovery, demo, POC, and technical win
  • Using efficient discovery to quickly understand billing challenges, product launch timelines, and technical requirements
  • Bringing energy and urgency to every engagement—proactively driving deals forward, identifying blockers early, and building relationships across the customer organization (engineering, finance, product) to create champions
  • Running streamlined demos tailored to technical founders and product/engineering teams

Driving hands-on implementation:

  • Providing customers with clear, actionable implementation plans to implement their usage-based billing launches
  • Writing code snippets, configuration examples, and integration guides to accelerate customer time-to-value
  • Pair programming or working alongside customer teams during POCs and initial setup
  • Designing up/downstream integrations into prospect systems with a bias toward pragmatic solutions that get them live quickly

Building deep AI market expertise:

  • Building relationships with technical founders, engineering leaders, product, and finance teams at AI companies
  • Understanding the unique monetization challenges facing LLM providers, generative AI companies (image, video, audio), and AI tooling/wrapper companies and providing consultative guidance when prospects need direction on pricing and packaging strategy and implementation
  • Staying current on AI industry trends, pricing models, and competitive dynamics

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in high-velocity environments, loves solving technical problems in real-time, and wants to be on the front lines of how AI companies monetize their products. Metronome directly influences how the next generation of AI infrastructure gets built—and our AI Native Solutions team drives this influence with our fastest-growing customer segment.

The Metronome team still operates very much like a startup. As such, there's a lot still to figure out and tremendous room for high-agency, curious individuals to impact our direction and strategy, build processes from zero to one, and generally make a difference. If this excites you as much as it excites us, let's talk.

Who you are

This is roughly the set of things we’re looking for - if you’re interested in this role and don’t meet some of these on paper, err on the side of applying!

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in technical, customer-facing roles involving SaaS products (for example, sales engineering, solutions architecture, technical account management, implementation consulting)
  • Experience working with, at, or selling to AI companies - you understand how AI-first companies operate, their unique challenges, and the market landscape
  • Proven ability to own and drive customer-facing engagements and relationships independently
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to quickly learn new systems, write code snippets, and guide technical implementations
  • Experience working in high-velocity environments where speed-to-value matters and customers need to launch quickly
  • Excellent communication skills with technical buyers (engineers, product managers, technical founders)

Preferred qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of the quote-to-cash space, including integrating with or otherwise interacting with tools like Salesforce, NetSuite, CPQs, etc.
  • Experience as a software engineer, product manager, or in other technical roles.
  • Experience in a pure sales role, particularly selling to technical buyers in engineering and product organizations or selling as a founding or early salesperson at a startup.
  • Familiarity and enthusiasm for AI developer tooling (Cursor, Lovable, Vercel, LangChain, etc.) and the broader AI infrastructure ecosystem

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI monetization at one of the world's leading fintech companies. Join us in defining how the next generation of AI businesses will scale and succeed.
