Want to deliver tech with purpose, with people who care?

Join us in our mission to create solutions that help keep children safe online.

Who are we?

Headquartered in Perth, Australia, with offices around the world, Qoria is an ASX-listed global leader in child digital safety technology and services. We are a purpose-driven business operating under the Linewize brand in North America and Asia Pacific, the Smoothwall brand in the UK, the Qustodio brand in EMEA, and Qoria LK in Sri Lanka.

Our solutions are used by schools, school districts, and parental communities to protect children from harmful online content, identify students at risk based on their digital behaviours, and help teachers maintain focus and safe learning environments in the digital classroom. Today, 30,000 schools and 7 million parents rely on our solutions to help keep 25 million children safe across 180 countries worldwide.

What’s the opportunity:

Every school we work with carries a serious responsibility: keeping children safe and thriving in their online lives. This role helps more schools across Australia, New Zealand and East Asia find the practical support they need to do that well. The campaigns you build reach principals, wellbeing leaders and ICT teams when they are looking for help, so your work connects directly to safer, more confident learning for students.

This role plans and delivers integrated B2B campaigns that build awareness, engage schools and generate qualified leads across Australia, New Zealand and East Asia. The role creates the campaigns and content that drive our regional MQL target, covering new business and cross-sell into existing schools, and supports our expansion into international schools in East Asia.

AI is central to how this person works, but it is never the whole answer. AI handles the speed: researching audiences, drafting and adapting content, testing variations and turning results into improvements. The creativity and human understanding are yours: knowing what a principal is worried about at the end of term, what an ICT manager needs to hear before they change providers, and which idea will make a busy school leader stop and pay attention. The role combines campaign ownership with hands-on execution, working closely with the Marketing Director, Marketing Manager, sales and shared creative resources.

Here’s how you’ll do it:

Campaigns

  • Deliver our demand generation strategy across Australia, New Zealand and East Asia, producing the campaigns and content that drive the regional MQL target across new business and cross-sell into existing schools, and helping us improve what works over time.
  • Combine analytical thinking with storytelling to identify and engage the right schools and decision makers, rather than simply flooding the top of the funnel.
  • Plan and execute lead generation campaigns across email, webinars, content, social and paid channels, aligned with regional priorities, school calendars and agreed budgets.
  • Build nurture journeys and conversion opportunities that help schools move from initial interest to a meaningful sales conversation.
  • Create cross-sell and onboarding campaigns and content for existing schools, working with Account Management.
  • Support entry into East Asian markets by adapting campaigns for international school audiences and building familiarity and trust in Linewize.
  • Support events led by the Marketing Manager, including pre-event campaigns, on-the-day support and post-event lead follow-up.

Content

  • Turn technical topics into clear emails, landing pages and LinkedIn content that school leaders and ICT teams want to read and share.
  • Ramp up content marketing and social media: plan and create regular content for LinkedIn and other social channels, including short-form video, that builds brand presence and engagement with school leaders, and write landing page and blog content optimised for SEO and AEO so schools find us in Google and AI answer engines.
  • Develop a strong understanding of our products, school decision makers and buying journeys. Turn customer needs into clear messages and relevant offers.
  • Write campaign copy and briefs, and work with design and regional colleagues to adapt existing assets and develop new materials.
  • Produce sales enablement assets such as one-pagers, email templates and presentations for sellers.

AI and campaign improvement

  • Bring the creative idea and the human insight that AI cannot: original campaign concepts, a clear point of view, and messages grounded in real conversations with schools, sales and customers.
  • Build repeatable AI workflows for audience research, content development, campaign variations and analysis, helping a small team deliver across markets.
  • Investigate and test new tactics, formats and channels, and bring fresh ideas to each campaign. Review AI outputs for accuracy, brand voice and audience relevance, and follow company data and privacy requirements.

Cross-team collaboration and performance

  • Work with sales on lead quality, campaign follow-up and conversion, using feedback to improve targeting and messaging.
  • Partner with the Marketing Manager on HubSpot campaign builds, segmentation, automation and tracking. The Marketing Manager owns platform infrastructure, events and core reporting.
  • Use campaign reporting to see what each campaign delivers, and recommend changes to improve the next one. Run A/B tests on emails and landing pages, and use the results to improve conversion.
  • Own each campaign from brief to launch, keeping contributors on track and flagging risks early.

What you will bring:

This role requires:

  • One to three years of marketing experience, including hands-on campaign and content delivery. B2B experience, particularly with long buying cycles and multiple decision makers, is highly regarded.
  • Awareness of how children and young people use technology and emerging platforms, and how today's ICT and school leaders find and share information would be desirable.
  • You will be able to evidence campaigns and content you have created and launched, together with the results achieved.
  • You should be able to show how you've improved output using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, and design or video tools such as Canva, Adobe or CapCut, in marketing workflows.
  • Exceptional copywriting and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain technical products clearly to both school leaders and ICT audiences.
  • Experience with email marketing (EDM), nurture journeys, webinars, social media and digital marketing channels, and the ability to select channels for a defined audience and objective.
  • Working knowledge of marketing automation and CRM platforms, preferably HubSpot, including segmentation, campaign builds and performance reporting.
  • Confidence interpreting data in tools such as HubSpot and Google Analytics, extracting useful insights and recommending practical changes.
  • Experience supporting events, including pre-event promotion and post-event follow-up.
  • Strong organisation and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a small team.
  • A degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Based on the East Coast of Australia, Sydney preferred, with the ability to travel within the region as needed.
  • Experience in SaaS or EdTech, international markets or marketing to schools would be an advantage.

Ways of working

You take ownership from planning through delivery, ask questions and adapt when the evidence points to a better approach. You work well with colleagues across regions and care about the impact our products have on children, schools and families.

This is a role for someone who wants their work to matter, and to see it. In a small team, you will see the results of your campaigns in the schools that choose to work with us. You will have room to shape how an AI-first marketing team works across a growing region, with colleagues who care about doing this well and will back you to try new things.

Why choose Qoria?

In this role, you can expect:

  • Great Benefits
  • Enhanced holiday & family leave
  • Tech Allowance
    .... and much more

More importantly, you'll:

Support tech with purpose...

At Qoria, your work truly matters. With every customer interaction, you’ll be helping children stay safe online. It feels good to do good.

With people who care...

One of our values is ‘Care, Always’. Our Support Team lives and breathes that, every day. We also look after each other and help create a supportive environment for all.

Through work that you love...

Being an (job title) takes skill, energy and resilience. It can also be incredibly rewarding. Here, your efforts will be visible and you’ll love the impact you have.

And a career that you own...

A proven career path forward, with real opportunities to progress your career into other teams and departments within the company. Exposure to industry leading tech, developed in-house by an amazing engineering team. Regular company wide lunch and learn sessions

We'd love to hear from you. Please submit your application if you would like to be considered for this opportunity.

We pair that technology with the irreplaceable expertise of our people to help hospitals, health systems and medical groups improve financial performance, simplify administrative complexity and create better experiences for patients and providers.

Here, collaboration fuels progress, adaptability sparks innovation and every voice can help shape what’s next for R1 and the future of healthcare.

As our Underpayments Analyst you have the primary role of validating and reviewing hospital accounts which are believed to have additional revenue opportunity. Every day you will confirm claim reimbursement, ensure there are no additional variables impacting reimbursement, diagnose the root cause of the underpayment and work with other support teams to achieve this purpose. To thrive in this role, you should enjoy working with data and researching payment issues.


Responsibilities:

  • Document the account to provide information and details to support appeal and resolution effort.
  • Diagnose and understand how the underpayment occurred and what our client could have done to prevent it.
  • Meet required benchmarks for production, accuracy, and efficiency.

Required Qualifications:

  • Candidates without a Bachelor’s degree may qualify with a high school diploma or equivalent and 2+ years of relevant experience in hospital billing, resolution, revenue cycle, or data analytics.
  • Organized and analytical self-starter with strong critical thinking skills and attention to detail

title: Head of Support Services
description: Cincom is bringing its Level 1 support together into one 24/7 cross-product Support function, reporting directly to the COO.

raw.title: Head of Support Services
raw.excerpt: Cincom is bringing its Level 1 support together into one 24/7 cross-product Support function, reporting directly to the COO.
raw.description:
Cincom is bringing its Level 1 support together into one 24/7 cross-product Support function, reporting directly to the COO. It covers all of our product lines, including CPQ, Eloquence, and Cincom Smalltalk, Mantis, Supra and Control, and more, and the customer environments we host and manage.

Today, Level 1 support works differently from one product to the next. Processes, tools and standards vary, and too much depends on a few people who know a product inside out. We want one modern, professional support function that runs around the clock and that customers experience the same way, whichever product they use.

We are looking for someone to build it and lead it. You will set the operating model, bring the team together, own escalations through to resolution, and put the tooling, processes and measures in place to run Support as a true 24/7 value added service. It is a leadership role, but you will need to stay close enough to the work to know what good looks like and to step in when it counts.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Leadership & People Management

  • Lead the Level 1 support team, and the senior Hosted Services roles that reports to you, and build Level 2 knowledge over time.
  • Hire, develop and coach the team, and cross-skill people across products so we are not reliant on any one person.
  • Set clear objectives, give regular feedback, and build a team that takes ownership of the customer's problem.

Building a 24/7 Support Function

  • Design and run Support as a true 24/7 service, with coverage, rotas and on-call arrangements that match our customer commitments.
  • Build follow-the-sun and out-of-hours models that make good use of the team across time zones, without burning people out.
  • Replace product-by-product ways of working with one consistent model for intake, triage, severity and prioritisation.
  • Bring in modern support practice, including ITIL-aligned incident, problem and change management and knowledge-centred support.
  • Work with the Hosted Services team to build. Managed Services approach for our hosted platforms

Escalation Management to Level 2 and 3

  • Own the escalation process from Level 1 into Level 2/3: product engineering teams for product issues, and Services consultants for issues in project deliverables.
  • Set clear criteria for when and how issues escalate, so they arrive with the right information, and nothing gets lost in the handover.
  • Track every escalated issue through to resolution, keep customers informed, and chase when timescales slip.
  • Review escalation trends with the product heads, push recurring issues back for permanent fixes, and make sure what we learn is captured in the knowledge base.

Hosted Services

  • Hold overall accountability for support of the customer environments Cincom hosts and manages, delivered through the senior Hosted Services roles.
  • Make sure hosted services meet their commitments on availability, monitoring, backups, patching, disaster recovery and incident response, around the clock, providing a true Managed Service.

Tooling, Automation & AI

  • Make Zoho Desk the single platform for support, configured properly and used consistently across every product, with integrations into other Cincom operational platforms as required.
  • Build and maintain a knowledge base (working with Cincom AI tools) that customers and the team actually use and expand self-service where it saves everyone effort.
  • Work with our AI team to explore and develop AI-assisted Level 1 support, including local-language support, with validation before answers reach customers.

Performance, Reporting & Compliance

  • Set and track SLAs and internal service levels for response and resolution, by severity.
  • Report on ticket trends by product, customer, region, severity and SLA tracked resolution time, not just ticket status, and review them monthly with the COO.
  • Lead the response to major incidents, with clear and timely communication to customers following a well-documented process.
  • Make sure support processes provide the evidence we need for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 and support our obligations to customers in regulated sectors.

Requirements

Mandatory Experience

  • Experience leading Level 1 and Level 2 support for enterprise software customers, ideally across more than one product.
  • A track record of building or reshaping a support function, not only running an existing one.
  • Experience running or building a 24/7 support operation, including on-call and potential follow-the-sun models.
  • Experience managing escalations into engineering teams and holding them to agreed timescales.
  • Experience running SLA-based support for business-critical customer systems.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong grounding in incident, problem and change management (ITIL or equivalent).
  • Working understanding of hosted and cloud environments, Azure or similar, including monitoring and alerting and management of guaranteed up-time.
  • Comfortable with service desk platforms, reporting and automation.

Leadership & Interpersonal Skills

  • Calm and clear with customers and senior colleagues, especially when things go wrong.
  • Uses data to manage performance and to make the case for change.
  • Builds trust across Engineering, Delivery and Client Success, and gets things done without relying on authority.
  • Fluent Business English communication.

Desirable

  • Hands-on experience with Zoho Desk or a comparable service desk platform.
  • Experience introducing AI-assisted support, knowledge-centred support or self-service.
  • ITIL 4 certification.
  • Additional languages, particularly French, German, Italian.
  • Experience supporting customers in regulated sectors such as financial services and insurance, and familiarity with ISO 27001 and SOC 2.

WHY THIS ROLE

This is a new function with a direct line to the COO. You will shape it from the start, with real backing to change how we work and a clear mandate to build a professional support service that customers value.

The role is remote and the location is open. Because Support will run 24/7, you will take part in senior escalation cover for major incidents, and potentially travel occasionally to meet the team and customers.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 3 Months

  • A clear picture of how support works today across every product, with the main gaps and risks identified.
  • One triage and escalation process agreed and live across all products.
  • A plan for 24/7 coverage agreed, and baseline metrics in place in Zoho Desk.

By 12 Months

  • Support running as a 24/7 service, with SLA and trend reporting by product, customer and region.
  • Measurable improvement in response times, resolution times and customer satisfaction.
  • Fewer avoidable escalations to Level 2/3, and a team that can cover more than one product.
  • A working knowledge base, and AI-assisted Level 1 support live on at least one product.

Benefits

  • Independent Contractor (Contractor is responsible for applicable taxes and statutory obligations, subject to the agreement and local law)
  • Full-time role
  • Availability for occasional short travels
  • Payment in USD
  • Equipment provided by the company
  • Contractor fee range - $2,900–$5,000 USD per month

Equal Opportunity Employer

PartnerOne is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

AI Use Disclosure

During our recruitment process, we may use technology, including AI-assisted tools, to support application review or scheduling. These tools support our recruiting team and do not replace human decision-making. Where required, candidates will receive additional information about the tool and applicable rights.

title: Senior Accountant
description: Senior Accountant Counterpart is the first Agentic Insurance™ platform, combining trusted insurance expertise with cutting-edge AI to deliver tailored management and professional liability solutions.

raw.title: Senior Accountant
raw.excerpt: Senior Accountant Counterpart is the first Agentic Insurance™ platform, combining trusted insurance expertise with cutting-edge AI to deliver tailored management and professional liability solutions.
raw.description:
Senior Accountant

Counterpart is the first Agentic Insurance™ platform, combining trusted insurance expertise with cutting-edge AI to deliver tailored management and professional liability solutions. By integrating Agentic Underwriting™, Agentic Broker Services™, Agentic Risk Mitigation™, Agentic Claims Management™, Agentic Coverage™, and Agentic Capacity™ into one powerful platform, Counterpart empowers brokers - and the businesses they serve - to do more with less risk. Backed by A rated carriers, Counterpart has been recognized by CB Insights as a 2025 “Top 50 Insurtech,” by Great Place to Work, and by Business Insurance as one of its 2025 “Best Places to Work.”

As Senior Accountant, you execute the day-to-day financial operations within Agentic Finance - premium accounts receivable and cash application, accounts payable, bank and balance sheet reconciliations, bordereau and premium reconciliation, carrier and claims payments, expense management, and audit and tax support - that keep Counterpart, Agentic Programs™, and Counterpart Insurance Company running. You support premium cash application, accounts payable, bank reconciliations, expense management, and vendor administration, and you prepare the bordereau, carrier payment, close, and audit work that the Accounting Manager and Controller review. You build and use the agents that make this execution more efficient as the company scales. You report to the Controller and work closely with the Accounting Manager.

YOU WILL:

Support Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Reconciliations, and Vendor Administration

  • Assist with premium accounts receivable from brokers - invoicing and installment billing, daily cash application against policies and endorsements, unapplied cash and unidentified deposit research, and aging and collections follow-up - so premium owed to Counterpart is collected on time and applied accurately.
  • Assist with the reconciliation of broker premium remittances into the premium trust account, clearing unapplied cash before it ages and escalating past-due balances and write-off candidates to the Accounting Manager and Controller.
  • Prepare the monthly reconciliation of policy-level premium receivable and premium payable detail from Counterpart's reporting platform to the general ledger, and support the recurring AR aging attestations required by carrier partners.
  • Assist with day-to-day accounts payable within Counterpart's spend-management platform - invoice intake, coding, approval routing, payment runs, and card-spend policy enforcement.
  • Assist with monthly bank reconciliations across operating, premium trust, and loss fund accounts, and prepare balance sheet account reconciliations for the Accounting Manager's review as part of the monthly close.
  • Assist with employee expense reimbursement administration, reviewing submissions against policy before sign-off by the Controller.
  • Assist with vendor records and documentation management, including W-9 collection and year-end 1099 preparation and filing, and support the relationships behind recurring vendor and brokerage-fee payments.
  • Support recurring program-level reimbursement invoicing, from calculation through submission.

Support Bordereau, Carrier Payment Operations, and Claims Payments

  • Prepare bordereau assembly and premium reconciliations across carrier and reinsurance relationships, researching and resolving discrepancies before they reach the Accounting Manager and Controller.
  • Maintain the carrier payment calendar and prepare weekly and monthly carrier premium remittance and sweep calculations, including premium trust segregation tracking, for the Controller's approval.
  • Prepare monthly loss fund reporting to carrier partners - bank-to-book reconciliation, top-up requests, and check registers - resolving variances directly with carrier contacts.
  • Execute claims payments from loss fund accounts under the Controller's payment authority, partnering directly with the Claims team on payment timing and exceptions.
  • Support the monthly net commission, claims-handling fee, and revenue estimate calculations by program, including true-ups when final bordereaux arrive.

Support Audit Administration

  • Prepare and compile supporting documentation for the annual company audit, carrier audit financial requests, and the R&D tax credit - pulling schedules, drafting responses, and tracking the deadline calendar, while the Controller leads the auditor and tax-advisor relationships.
  • Support Counterpart Insurance Company's statutory (STAT) reporting cadence and regulatory filings, providing the underlying data and documentation the Controller needs for CIC's STAT close.
  • Maintain and continuously improve the accounting due dates calendar.

Support Monthly Close and Financial Reporting

  • Execute assigned monthly close tasks - journal entries, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations - against the close checklist and timeline.
  • Help prepare the recurring carrier partner reporting package - unaudited financials, cash position summaries, and other standard deliverables on a monthly and quarterly basis, for the Accounting Manager's and Controller's review and sign-off.
  • Document and maintain step-by-step accounting procedures and clear, audit-ready workpapers so processes are repeatable and scalable as the accounting function grows.

Drive Agentic Automation Across Accounting Operations

  • Build and use agents to automate premium receivable cash application, bank reconciliations, bordereau assembly, premium reconciliation, and claims payment processing.
  • Feed clean, structured financial data and workflows into Counterpart's Intelligence System.
  • Identify where agents can replace manual work versus where judgment is still required, and partner with the Accounting Manager and technical platform team to build and continuously improve those workflows.

YOU HAVE:

  • 3-5 years of progressive accounting experience, ideally at a high-growth company; insurance, insurtech, or fintech experience is a plus but not required.
  • A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Working knowledge of GAAP, with exposure to STAT (Statutory Accounting Principles) a plus, and comfort operating within a regulated, multi-entity insurance business.
  • Experience owning core accounting processes - such as cash application, accounts payable, and reconciliations - and a drive to improve them, not just execute them.
  • Hands-on experience with an accounting system or ERP (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or similar) and an AP/spend platform (Ramp, Bill.com, or similar).
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools or agents to streamline reconciliations, payment processing, and routine bookkeeping.
  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills; experience reconciling data from reporting or BI tools (Looker or similar) to the general ledger is a plus.
  • Comfort managing recurring payments, reconciliations, and deadline-driven filings across multiple systems and counterparties - including direct communication with banks, brokers, carriers, tax agencies, and auditors.
  • High attention to detail and a bias toward getting the numbers right the first time.
  • Clear written and verbal communication - you can represent Counterpart directly with broker, carrier, and audit contacts.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH:

  • Rob Hamilton, Controller
  • Dave Fanger, VP of Finance

COUNTERPART'S VALUES

  • Conjoin Expectations - it is the cornerstone of autonomy. Ensure you are aware of what is expected of you and clearly articulate what you expect of others.
  • Speak Boldly & Honestly - the only failure is not learning from mistakes. Don't cheat yourself and your colleagues of the feedback needed when expectations aren't being met.
  • Be Entrepreneurial - control your own destiny. Embrace action over perfection while navigating any obstacles that stand in the way of your ultimate goal. Leverage AI ruthlessly. We measure success by outcomes, not lines of code written. Use every available AI tool to ship faster and think more strategically.
  • Practice Omotenashi ("selfless hospitality") - trust will follow. Consider every interaction with internal and external partners an opportunity to develop trust by going above and beyond what is expected.
  • Hold Nothing As Sacred - create routines but modify them routinely. Take the time to reflect on where the business is today, where it needs to go, and what you have to change in order to get there.
  • Prioritize Wellness - some things should never be sacrificed. We create an environment that stretches everyone to grow and improve, which is fulfilling, but is only one part of a meaningful life.

WE OFFER

  • Fully remote workplace
  • Unlimited Vacation: We offer flexible time off, allowing you to take time when you need it.
  • Work from Anywhere: Counterpart is a fully distributed company, meaning there is no office. We allow employees to work from wherever they do their best work, and invite the team to meet in person a couple times per year.
  • Stock Options
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Parental Leave
  • Home Office Allowance: to set up your home office with the necessary equipment and accessories.
  • Wellness Stipend
  • Book stipend
  • Professional Development Reimbursement
  • No working birthdays: Take your birthday off, giving you the opportunity to relax, enjoy your special day, and spend time with loved ones.
  • Charitable Contribution Matching

Our estimated pay range for this role is $110,000 to $130,000. Base salary is determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to, market data, location, internal equitability, and experience.

We are committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported and connected at work - regardless of who you are or where you come from. We value and celebrate our differences and we believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work of our lives.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. raw.excerpt: The Thuma team is looking for a Customer Experience Associate to join our effective, lean, quickly growing team.
raw.description:
The Thuma team is looking for a Customer Experience Associate to join our effective, lean, quickly growing team. We hire for integrity, initiative, collaborative spirit, open mindedness, and willingness to learn.
As a Customer Experience Associate, you'll deliver exceptional 6-star service to our customers, creating a luxurious and seamless experience. You'll remove obstacles, provide support, and make empowered decisions to "do the right thing." This role is perfect for a polished individual passionate about service, design, and bedroom furnishings.
Thuma’s Headquarters is based in the historic Presidio neighborhood of San Francisco. This role is flexible and can be based in San Francisco or remote. The schedule for this position is Saturday through Wednesday. Applicants must be able to work weekends.

You Will

  • Address customer inquiries promptly and accurately within our SLA.
  • Deliver an unparalleled 6-star customer experience through our various channels, such as email, phone, and social media.
  • Track order statuses, resolve service issues, and coordinate with shipping carrier companies as needed.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to find solutions and exceed customer expectations.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate records of customer interactions, flagging trends to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Build brand loyalty and drive revenue by staying up to date about all products, services, policies, pricing, delivery times, and marketing promotions.
  • Meet individual and team goals and metrics weekly.
  • Be present and communicative on Slack and email.
  • Report emerging issues or problems to the CX team manager.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned by the management team.

This Might Describe You

  • Availability to work occasional holidays.
  • 1-2 years of previous experience in customer support, retail, hospitality, or a similar service role.
  • Strong communication skills with an inquisitive nature.
  • Proficiency in working cross-functionally.
  • Familiarity with Shopify and Gladly is a plus.

Why Join Us

  • 401(k): Participation in our 401(k) program with company matching up to 6% of your contributions.
  • Benefits*: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with generous employer contributions, 100% paid parental leave, and company-sponsored One Medical and WellHub memberships.
  • Equity: Participation in employee stock option plan.
  • Paid Time Off: We operate with a high-performance mindset and we believe healthy, happy, relaxed people do better work.
  • Time to Recharge: teams receive select paid holidays, including key company closure days, along with holiday pay when working on designated holidays.
  • Employee Discount**: 40% off almost all Thuma products.
  • Cell Phone Stipend: $100 per month to support work-related phone use.
  • Commute Reimbursement*: Up to $150 per month for commuting to our office.
  • Room Upgrade: A complimentary product credit upon joining, valued at up to $3,000.
    • ** Some exclusions may apply
    * Eligibility for compensation, benefits, and perks may vary based on employment status (e.g., full-time, part-time, temporary), work schedule, and applicable holiday policies, and are subject to the terms of the relevant plans and company guidelines.

Who We Are

Thuma is a modern design company specializing in furniture and home goods. We believe simplicity is the ultimate luxury. That the details matter. And that good design is good hospitality.

We recognize that people come with a wealth of knowledge and are talented beyond the scope of a functional role. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t precisely match our job description. We hire for integrity, initiative, collaborative spirit, open mindedness, and willingness to learn.

Thuma is dedicated to going above and beyond to bring people with diverse perspectives and unique experiences together to do great work. We strive to create a sense of belonging by creating an inclusive culture where everyone can be their authentic self and by treating each and every team member with kindness, equity, and respect, always.
